programme.title: Golden League / Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Our guests today have been friends since childhood. Their paths diverged briefly forty years ago. One went to America, the other stayed in Croatia. The American of Croatian descent became a respected writer and university professor. The one who stayed in Croatia became a respected politician, writer, journalist and university professor. We are particularly pleased to host Boža Kovačević and Josip Novaković. / Naši današnji gosti prijatelji su još od djetinjstva. Putevi su im se, nakratko, razišli prije četrdesetak godina. Jedan je otišao u Ameriku, drugi je ostao u Hrvatskoj. Amerikanac hrvatskog podrijetla postao je cijenjeni pisac i sveučilišni profesor. Onaj koji je ostao u Hrvatskoj postao je cijenjeni političar, pisac, novinar i sveučilišni profesor. S osobitim zadovoljstvom ugošćujemo Božu Kovačevića i Josipa Novakovića.

programme.title: Mary Berry's classic recipes / Klasični recepti Mary Berry
programme.desc: This six-part series will show why Mary Berry is a fantastic cook, teacher and inspiration. Each food-filled episode will be dedicated to a specific type of dish, some of which are well-known and some of which are completely new. But Mary will use her unique cooking style to prepare all the dishes, which includes simple skills and processing methods, a small number of ingredients and easy-to-apply tricks for easier preparation. No one else can prepare simpler and more delicious dishes, and all of them will be in the classic Mary Berry style. --- Mary Berry will demonstrate her favorite soul-warming homemade dishes, from the simplest to the decadent. At the same time, they will enjoy preparing food on an open fire with Swedish chef Niklas Ekstedt. / Ova šestodjelna serija pokazat će zašto je Mary Berry fantastična kuharica, učiteljica i nadahnuće. Svaki nastavak ispunjen hranom bit će posvećen određenoj vrsti jela, od kojih su neka dobro poznata, a neka posve nova. No Mary će za pripremu svih jela primijeniti svoj jedinstveni stil kuhanja, koji uključuje jednostavne vještine i načine obrade, mali broj sastojaka i trikove za lakšu pripremu koje je lako primijeniti. Nitko drugi ne može pripremiti jednostavnija, a slasnija jela, a sva će biti u klasičnom stilu Mary Berry. --- Mary Berry pokazat će omiljena domaća jela koja griju dušu, od najjednostavnijih do dekadentnih. Ujedno će uživati u pripremi hrane na otvorenoj vatri sa švedskim kuharom Niklasom Ekstedtom.

programme.title: Dr. Beck / Dr. Beck
programme.desc: As many as 70 to 90 percent of adolescents in puberty have a problem with acne, but they are not a problem only in that period of life. What is their cause and how to properly treat and cure them, we find out in the show. dr. Dermatologist Gaby Novak Bilić, beautician Zdenka Mihelj, singer Zsa Zsa and nutritionist Ivona Brodić are guests of Natko Becka. / Čak 70 do 90 posto adolescenata u pubertetu ima problem s aknama, no one nisu problem samo u tom životnom razdoblju. Što im je uzrok i kako ih pravilno tretirati i izliječiti otkrivamo u emisiji. Dr. Natku Becku u goste stižu dermatologinja Gaby Novak Bilić, kozmetičarka Zdenka Mihelj, pjevačica Zsa Zsa i nutricionistic Ivona Brodić.

programme.title: TV calendar / TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Diary 1 / Dnevnik 1
programme.desc: Current information and the latest news from the country and the world in the midday Dnevnik. / Aktualne informacije i najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta u podnevnom Dnevniku.

programme.title: Sport / Sport
programme.desc: Daily sports reports and reports. / Dnevni sportski izvještaji i reportaže.

programme.title: Time / Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Susana tries to explain that she never intended to harm Cacao or Marquinha while helping Simone in the hospital. But Soraia accuses her anyway. Marlene tells Sal that she doesn't know where Majoris is, but that she could find out if she was bribed. Soraia reveals that she knows about the alliance between Susana and Simone. Marlene and Rui cannot find Majoris and suspect that she may have helped Simone in Justin's murder. / Susana pokušava objasniti da nikada nije namjeravala nauditi Cacau ni Marquinhu dok je pomagala Simone u bolnici. Ali Soraia je svejedno optužuje. Marlene kaže Sal da ne zna gdje je Majoris, ali da bi mogla saznati jesu li je potkupili. Soraia otkrije da ona zna za savezništvo između Susane i Simone. Marlene i Rui ne mogu naći Majoris i slute da je možda pomagala Simone u Justinovu ubojstvu.

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana demands that Cruz and Leocadia tell her the truth. Samuel decides to leave La Promesa. Ángela and Curro kiss. Manuel returns from a trip to Italy... and finds Jana shot and bleeding. / Jana zahtijeva od Cruz i Leocadije da joj kažu istinu. Samuel odluči otići s La Promese. Ángela i Curro se poljube. Manuel se vrati s putovanja u Italiju... i nađe Janu kako nastrijeljena krvari.

programme.title: In Suzy's kitchen / U kuhinji kod Suzy
programme.desc: Suzy Josipović let us into her home where she prepares a simple dish in the kitchen in front of the cameras and shares her culinary knowledge and experience with us. / Suzy Josipović pustila nas je u svoj dom gdje u kuhinji ispred kamera sprema jednostavno jelo te dijeli s nama svoje kulinarsko znanje i iskustvo.

programme.title: Don't forget to leave a review / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Tourists believe that a rented apartment is not only a place to sleep, but a small piece of the city and country they have arrived in. However, private accommodation is actually a mirror of our society. Cities on the coast live on positional rent: the sea is a currency, and a square meter is worth gold. In places where everyone wants to vacation, it is becoming more and more difficult to live. The old cores are transformed into scenes of seasonal earnings, and the hosts will huddle at mom's in the summer to let tourists into their beds. One star with the comment "the room was desperate". Apart from the price, nothing was good _ and the whole season can go down the drain. When a home becomes a business plan _ a review can change everything. / Turisti vjeruju da unajmljeni apartman nije samo mjesto za spavanje, već mali komadić grada i zemlje u koju su stigli. No, privatni smještaj je zapravo ogledalo našeg društva. Gradovi na obali žive od položajne rente: more je valuta, a kvadrat vrijedi kao zlato. U mjestima gdje svi žele ljetovati, postaje sve teže živjeti. Stare jezgre pretvaraju se u kulise sezonske zarade, a domaćini će se ljeti stisnuti kod mame kako bi u svoje krevete pustili turiste. Jedna zvjezdica s komentarom "soba je bila očajna". Osim cijene, ništa nije bilo dobro _ i cijela sezona može pasti u vodu. Kada dom postane poslovni plan _ recenzija može promijeniti sve.

programme.title: Police witnesses / Policijske priče
programme.desc: Murders in the crime milieu are often full of unanswered questions. In order to get answers to them, Domagoj Zaradić, together with his colleagues, has to contact people from all walks of life and thus portrays the real "Face of the city". / Ubojstva u krim miljeu često su puna neodgovorenih pitanja. Kako bi na njih dobio odgovore, Domagoj Zaradić zajedno sa svojim kolegama mora kontaktirati osobe iz svih sfera života i tako oslikava stvarno "Naličje grada".

programme.title: Our little parties / Naše male fešte
programme.desc: The episode takes us to Cvelferija, a charming plain in Srijem, where the "Sung Cvelferija" takes place every year, an event that celebrates the Shoka tradition through music, dance and togetherness. We follow the preparations for this event, from decorating the village to the arrival of choirs and tambura bands. The event brings a wealth of cultural performances, from children's sections to guests from other parts of Croatia and abroad. The day ends with a large joint circle, where all participants celebrate the Šoká heritage, and the atmosphere is filled with joy, tradition and pride in the cultural identity of this region. / Epizoda nas vodi u Cvelferiju, šarmantnu ravnicu u Srijemu, gdje se svake godine održava "Raspjevana Cvelferija", manifestacija koja slavi šokačku tradiciju kroz glazbu, ples i zajedništvo. Pratimo pripreme za ovaj događaj, od ukrašavanja sela do dolaska zborova i tamburaških sastava. Manifestacija donosi bogatstvo kulturnih nastupa, od dječjih sekcija do gostiju iz drugih dijelova Hrvatske i inozemstva. Dan završava velikim zajedničkim kolom, gdje svi sudionici slave šokačku baštinu, a atmosfera je ispunjena veseljem, tradicijom i ponosom na kulturni identitet ovog kraja.

programme.title: Around the world by train / Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Sir Tony Robinson will take the train to the unknown, traveling from Canada to Alaska. He looks forward to meeting Canadians and exploring the great wilderness in this part of the world, from the Rocky Mountains to the beautiful glaciers of Alaska. The journey begins in the high-tech city of Seattle, home to Amazon, Microsoft and Starbucks. The Amtrack Cascades train will take him across the border into Canada, where he will immediately be surprised by the beauty of Vancouver and the warmth of Canadians. / Sir Tony Robinson će se vlakom zaputiti u nepoznato putujući iz Kanade u Aljasku. Veseli se upoznavanju Kanađana i istraživanju velike divljine u ovom dijelu svijeta, od planina Stjenjaka do prelijepih glečera Aljaske. Putovanje počinje u gradu visoke tehnologije Seattleu gdje sjedišta imaju Amazon, Microsoft i Starbucks. Vlak Amtrack Cascades prevest će ga preko granice u Kanadu gdje će ga odmah iznenaditi ljepota Vancouvera i toplina Kanađana.

programme.title: RIGHTS - promet info / HAK - promet info
programme.desc: Current information about road and ferry traffic, with announcements from the Croatian Auto Club. / Aktualne informacije o cestovnom i trajektnom prometu, uz javljanja iz Hrvatskog autokluba.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: A short overview of news from Croatia and the world. / Kratki pregled vijesti iz Hrvatske i svijeta.

programme.title: Regional diary / Regionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: HTV teams from all Croatian counties bring the most interesting current events and stories from all over the country, and there is also a detailed regional weather forecast. / Ekipe HTV-a iz svih hrvatskih županija donose najzanimljivije aktualne događaje i priče iz cijele zemlje, a tu je i detaljna regionalna vremenska prognoza.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Pursuit / Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: Time / Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. In addition to sports news, see the detailed weather forecast for the following days. / Najvažnije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta, brojne reportaže, gostovanja istaknutih stručnjaka i komentatora u Dnevniku 2, u najgledanijoj informativnoj emisiji HTV-a. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Heart 7 / Loto 7
programme.desc: Follow the Lot 7 draw live. / Pratite izravno izvlačenje Lota 7.

programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Raising the young generation in the intricate jungle habitat requires ingenuity _ parents must master their habitat and know how to use every opportunity to provide a future for the new generation. In faraway Bhutan, a pair of red-throated hornbills live in a lifelong partnership built on trust and commitment. The mother remains imprisoned in the tree for a hundred days and relies on the male as the breadwinner of the family. In Sri Lanka, the bold snub-nosed frog shares a home with a large poisonous tarantula. This unexpected union consists of a harmonious tandem: the tarantula acts as a living bodyguard, and the tiny frog keeps to the house and keeps their shared home clean. In Jamaica, a genius mother shrimp works tirelessly to raise a brood of tiny shrimp. With professional precision, with the help of the resources available in the forest, he creates favorable conditions for his nursery. Elsewhere, jungle parents need room to move _ and others are forced to adapt to changes in the habitat around them. In Australia, the cassowary leads its birds through new dangers in the oldest rainforest in the world. Forest fires in the Amazon drive a rarely seen female tapir in search of new territory and vital minerals, and in China, griffon langurs barely survive on the edge of life. The limestone peaks they live on are surrounded by cultivated land and the langurs have to fight for what is left so that their offspring have a safe habitat to grow. Unexpectedly, new science shows that ancient trees in jungles are not only a source of life for their offspring, but also for countless other rainforest families, from the tops of the crowns, all the way down to the leafy undergrowth. Their influence will be the key to our survival. / Podizanje mladog naraštaja u zamršenom staništu džungle iziskuje domišljatost _ roditelji moraju zagospodariti svojim staništem i znati iskoristiti svaku priliku da bi novom naraštaju omogućili budućnost. U dalekom Butanu par crvenogrlih kljunorožaca živi u doživotnom partnerstvu izgrađenom na povjerenju i predanosti. Majka stotinu dana ostaje zatočena u stablu i pouzdaje se u mužjaka kao hranitelja obitelji. U Šri Lanki odvažna tuponosa žaba dijeli dom s velikom otrovnom tarantulom. Taj neočekivani spoj sastoji se od skladnog tandema: tarantula djeluje kao živi tjelohranitelj, a sitna žaba drži se kuće i održava čistoću njihova zajedničkog doma. Na Jamajci genijalna majka račica neumorno radi na podizanju legla sitnih račića. Stručnom preciznošću s pomoću resursa dostupnih u šumi stvara povoljne uvjete za svoje gojilište. Drugdje roditelji u džungli trebaju prostor za kretanje _ a drugi su prisiljeni prilagoditi se promjenama staništa oko njih. U Australiji kazuar vodi svoje ptiće kroz nove opasnosti u najstarijoj prašumi na svijetu. Šumski požari u Amazoniji tjeraju rijetko viđenu ženku tapira u potragu za novim teritorijem i vitalnim mineralima, a u Kini bjeloglavi languri jedva se održavaju na rubu života. Vapnenački vrhunci na kojima žive okruženi su obrađenom zemljom i languri se moraju boriti za ono što je preostalo kako bi njihovo potomstvo imalo sigurno stanište za rast. Neočekivano, nova znanost pokazuje da drevna stabla u džunglama nisu izvor života samo za svoje potomstvo, nego i za nebrojene druge prašumske obitelji, od vrhova krošnji, sve do lisnatog nastora. Njihov će utjecaj biti ključ našeg opstanka.

programme.title: My flesh and blood / Moja krv i meso
programme.desc: After her boyfriend, a drug lord, accuses her of stealing a huge sum of money from the cartel, 16-year-old Lydia (E. Moriarty) runs away with her elderly father, the only person who supports her in this world. Her father John Link (M. Gibson) was once a drunkard, a drug addict and an outlaw, and at one time also a prisoner, but now he has decided to do the right thing at least once in his life and protect his daughter from evil... / Nakon što je njezin dečko, narkobos, optuži da je kartelu ukrala golemu svotu novca, 16-godišnja Lydia (E. Moriarty) bježi zajedno sa svojim postarijim ocem, jedinom osobom koja joj je na ovome svijetu podrška. Njezin je otac John Link (M. Gibson) nekoć bio pijanac, ovisnik o drogi i odmetnik, a svojevremeno i zatvorenik, ali sada je odlučio bar jednom u životu postupiti kako treba i zaštititi svoju kćer od zla...

programme.title: Bay / Zaljev
programme.desc: Julie's life begins to fall apart further when Craig's lies surface, although he tries very hard to explain where he was the night Hannah was killed. That said, Tommy seems to know more about what Craig has been up to than he's letting on. And while the people of Morecambe want to know they are safe in the town, Karen's actions at Hanna's vigil put her job at risk. Manning is under increasing pressure, dissatisfaction in the team is growing, and the investigation is falling into place. Jenn has more and more problems at home, and her relationship with Chris is on even shakier feet. New information about Hanna and Cal comes to light, and the team finds an unexpected clue. / Julien život počinje se dodatno raspadati kad na površinu isplivaju Craigove laži, premda se on silno trudi objasniti gdje je bio one noći kad je Hannah ubijena. Uz to, čini se da Tommy zna više o tome što je Craig radio negoli što govori. I dok stanovnici Morecambea žele znati da su u gradu sigurni, Karen zbog postupanja na bdijenju za Hannu ugrozi svoje radno mjesto. Manning je pod sve većim pritiskom, nezadovoljstvo u ekipi raste, a istraga tapka na mjestu. Jenn ima sve više problema kod kuće pa je njezina veza s Chrisom na još klimavijim nogama. Na vidjelo izlaze nove informacije o Hanni i Calu, a ekipa nalazi neočekivani trag.

programme.title: Lewis / Lewis
programme.desc: A teenage girl, Beatrice, was found wandering the meadows of Oxford naked. She doesn't remember anything, but forensics reveal that she was raped after the criminal drugged her with an anti-insomnia drug. Lewis and Hathaway narrow down the list of suspects and eventually reach the computer science teacher at Beatrice's school. But the suspect Oswald Cooper has a solid alibi, moreover, he is vouched for by three men, well-known pillars of society. When Cooper is found murdered and castrated, revenge is the obvious motive for the attack on Beatrice, but the police can't prove that Cooper was the attacker, and Lewis tries hard to find a hole in Cooper's alibi. / Tinejdžerica Beatrice pronađena je kako gola luta livadama Oxforda. Ne sjeća se ničega, ali forenzičari otkrivaju da je silovana nakon što ju je zločinac drogirao lijekom protiv nesanice. Lewis i Hathaway sužavaju popis osumnjičenih i naposljetku dolaze do profesora informatike u Beatriceinoj školi. Ali osumnjičeni Oswald Cooper ima čvrst alibi, štoviše, za njega jamče tri čovjeka, poznati stupovi društva. Kada Coopera pronađu ubijenog i kastriranog, očit je motiv osveta za napad na Beatrice, ali policija ne može dokazati da je Cooper bio napadač, a Lewis uza sav trud ne uspijeva pronaći rupu u Cooperovu alibiju.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly decides to start dating again, but soon realizes that adult relationships are complicated and full of pitfalls. Barry discovers a new passion. / Beverly odlučuje ponovno krenuti na spojeve, no ubrzo shvaća da su odnosi među odraslima komplicirani i prepuni zamki. Barry otkriva novu strast.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Erica is thinking about what she will do in life. She finds inspiration in the movie "Baby Boom" and thinks she has discovered how to have it all. Adam is shooting a remake of the music video for the song "Uptown Girl". He meets Carmen's father and decides to ingratiate himself with him by pretending to be something he is not. / Erica razmišlja čime će se baviti u životu. Nadahnuće pronađe u filmu "Baby Boom" te misli da je otkrila kako imati sve. Adam snima remake spota za pjesmu "Uptown Girl". Upoznaje Carmenina oca i odlučuje mu se dodvoriti glumeći da je nešto što nije.

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Just when he thinks his life is on the way, Adam receives a letter from New York University that changes everything. When Barry finds out that his boys are hanging out with people outside of their circle, he fears that this is the end of their friendship. / Taman kad pomisli da mu je krenulo u životu, Adamu stiže pismo sa Sveučilišta u New Yorku koje sve mijenja. Kad Barry dozna da se njegovi dečki druže i s ljudima izvan njihova kruga, boji se da je to kraj prijateljstva.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam takes Beverly to her graduation anniversary and decides to make sure she doesn't end up with the wrong man. Barry and Joanne make an unexpected decision to show everyone how serious their relationship is. / Adam odvede Beverly na proslavu godišnjice mature i odluči se pobrinuti da ne završi s pogrešnim muškarcem. Barry i Joanne donose neočekivanu odluku kako bi svima pokazali koliko je njihova veza ozbiljna.

programme.title: Escape to the countryside / Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Emotions run high in West Yorkshire as Nicki Chapman helps a Hertfordshire lady find a new home in the beautiful county where she grew up. There, Nicki meets a couple who three years ago moved from London to a beautiful old farm with as much as two and a half hectares of land. / Emocije su na vrhuncu u Zapadnom Yorkshireu dok Nicki Chapman pomaže gospođi iz Hertfordshirea pronaći novi dom u prekrasnoj grofoviji u kojoj je odrasla. Ondje Nicki upoznaje i par koji se prije tri godine preselio iz Londona na prekrasnu staru farmu s čak dva i pol hektara zemlje.

programme.title: The most wonderful homes in the world / Najčudesniji domovi na svijetu
programme.desc: Hosts Piers Taylor and Caroline Quentin will travel to Portugal in search of four extraordinary homes. This country is known for its great design and quality of workmanship, as well as for its modesty. The first house was located on the Portuguese Riviera, an exclusive area west of Lisbon. The second house is in Gateira, and the owners are Britons Neil and Shirley. The house was built in Penela, an agricultural area in the center of Portugal. From the outside it looks like an outbuilding, but behind the front door hides a modern home. The third house is among the dunes, and it was built in a pine forest near the Atlantic coast. "Casa Geres" is hidden in a national park in a mountainous forest area. / Voditelji Piers Taylor i Caroline Quentin otputovat će u Portugal u potrazi za četiri izvanredna doma. Ta je zemlja poznata kako po sjajnom dizajnu i kvaliteti izrade, tako i po skromnosti. Prva se kuća smjestila na portugalskoj rivijeri, ekskluzivnom području zapadno od Lisabona. Druga je kuća u Gateiri, a vlasnici su Britanci Neil i Shirley. Kuća je izgrađena u Peneli, poljoprivrednom području u središtu Portugala. Izvana izgleda kao gospodarska zgrada, a iza ulaznih se vrata skriva suvremeni dom. Treća je kuća među dinama, a izgrađena je u borovoj šumi u blizini atlantske obale. "Casa Geres" skrivena je u nacionalnom parku na planinskom šumskom području.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon's Guide to Home Cooking continues the theme of delicious yet healthy meals. We will see fantastic cereal that has been soaked overnight and a great soup "gazpacho". Gordon's youngest daughter Tilly will help him prepare irresistible healthy salmon in teriyaki sauce. / Gordonov vodič za kuhanje kod kuće nastavlja se temom slasnih, a zdravih jela. Vidjet ćemo fantastične žitne pahuljice koje su se namakale preko noći i odličnu juhu "gazpacho". Gordonova najmlađa kći Tilly pomoći će mu da pripremi neodoljivog zdravog lososa u umaku "teriyakiju".

programme.title: Garden saviors / Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Norline and Wendell have only been married for a short time. They want a new garden for relaxation and socializing, and also for Wendell's great passion: cooking! Charlie and Flo accept the challenge to make their dreams come true. Flo's design was chosen and the team soon set about building a garden that would remind the couple of their Caribbean heritage. There's a handmade brick barbecue support, a Fern Gully-inspired fern bed and a beautiful rose-wrapped bench. Charlie helps out with a Mondrian-style flower bed, and Norline gets a big surprise: her mother's favorite flower from when she was growing up in Jamaica. / Norline i Wendell tek su kratko vrijeme u braku. Žele novi vrt za opuštanje i druženje, a ujedno i za Wendellovu veliku strast: kuhanje! Charlie i Flo primaju se izazova da ostvare njihove snove. Izabran je Floin dizajn i ekipa se ubrzo laća izgradnje vrta koji će par podsjećati na njihovo karipsko naslijeđe. Tu je ručno rađen cigleni nosač za roštilj, gredica s paprati nadahnuta Fern Gullyjem i prekrasna klupica obavijena ružama. Charlie pomaže izradom gredice u stilu Mondriana, a Norline dočeka veliko iznenađenje: najdraži cvijet njezine majke iz vremena kad je odrastala na Jamajci.

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue welcomes Charlotte Church, prepares chicken skewers and goes back to basics to make the perfect omelet and the best scrambled eggs with John's help. / Prue dočekuje Charlotte Church, pripremaju pileće ražnjiće i vraća se osnovama kako bi uz Johnovu pomoć napravila savršen omlet i najbolju kajganu.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: How can a person best meet foreigners even if he does not speak their language? He will sit in the car with them. That's exactly what Samuel Hade did. In two months, this filmmaker hitchhiked across Japan in search of adventure. His motto is: I don't refuse any invitation and I accept everything new. Hitchhiking through Japan is a special trip with overnight stays in a coin laundromat or, secretly, in a university library. It's a journey with cold days, lonely roads and bathing in the hot springs of Noboribetsu. / Kako će čovjek najbolje upoznati strance iako ne govori njihov jezik? Sjest će k njima u automobil. Upravo to učinio je Samuel Hade. Ovaj je filmaš sam za dva mjeseca autostopom proputovao Japan u potrazi za pustolovinama. Njegovo geslo glasi: ne odbijam nijedan poziv i prihvaćam sve novo. Autostopom kroz Japan poseban je izlet s noćenjima u praonici rublja na kovanice ili, potajno, u sveučilišnoj knjižnici. Putovanje je to s hladnim danima, samotnim cestama i kupanjem u vrućim izvorima Noboribetsua.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Emotions run high in West Yorkshire as Nicki Chapman helps a Hertfordshire lady find a new home in the beautiful county where she grew up. There, Nicki meets a couple who three years ago moved from London to a beautiful old farm with as much as two and a half hectares of land. / Emocije su na vrhuncu u Zapadnom Yorkshireu dok Nicki Chapman pomaže gospođi iz Hertfordshirea pronaći novi dom u prekrasnoj grofoviji u kojoj je odrasla. Ondje Nicki upoznaje i par koji se prije tri godine preselio iz Londona na prekrasnu staru farmu s čak dva i pol hektara zemlje.

programme.title: The most wonderful homes in the world / Najčudesniji domovi na svijetu
programme.desc: Hosts Piers Taylor and Caroline Quentin will travel to Portugal in search of four extraordinary homes. This country is known for its great design and quality of workmanship, as well as for its modesty. The first house was located on the Portuguese Riviera, an exclusive area west of Lisbon. The second house is in Gateira, and the owners are Britons Neil and Shirley. The house was built in Penela, an agricultural area in the center of Portugal. From the outside it looks like an outbuilding, but behind the front door hides a modern home. The third house is among the dunes, and it was built in a pine forest near the Atlantic coast. "Casa Geres" is hidden in a national park in a mountainous forest area. / Voditelji Piers Taylor i Caroline Quentin otputovat će u Portugal u potrazi za četiri izvanredna doma. Ta je zemlja poznata kako po sjajnom dizajnu i kvaliteti izrade, tako i po skromnosti. Prva se kuća smjestila na portugalskoj rivijeri, ekskluzivnom području zapadno od Lisabona. Druga je kuća u Gateiri, a vlasnici su Britanci Neil i Shirley. Kuća je izgrađena u Peneli, poljoprivrednom području u središtu Portugala. Izvana izgleda kao gospodarska zgrada, a iza ulaznih se vrata skriva suvremeni dom. Treća je kuća među dinama, a izgrađena je u borovoj šumi u blizini atlantske obale. "Casa Geres" skrivena je u nacionalnom parku na planinskom šumskom području.

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue welcomes Charlotte Church, prepares chicken skewers and goes back to basics to make the perfect omelet and the best scrambled eggs with John's help. / Prue dočekuje Charlotte Church, pripremaju pileće ražnjiće i vraća se osnovama kako bi uz Johnovu pomoć napravila savršen omlet i najbolju kajganu.

programme.title: Lewis / Lewis
programme.desc: Lewis investigates the gruesome murder of a young waitress after she leaves her professor's book launch. As Lewis and Hathaway delve deeper into the mystery of the crime, the line between fantasy and reality becomes ever thinner as the murder begins to mirror the content of the professor's books. / Lewis istražuje stravično ubojstvo mlade konobarice nakon što je napustila predstavljanje knjige svoga profesora. Kako Lewis i Hathaway poniru dublje u zagonetku zločina, granica između fantazije i stvarnosti postaje sve tanja jer ubojstvo počinje zrcaliti sadržaj profesorovih knjiga.

programme.title: TV calendar / TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Stories from Croatia / Priče iz Hrvatske
programme.desc: This time, the stories from Croatia are painted in autumn colors. Let's meet the queen of autumn _ Her Majesty the pumpkin. Autumn is the ideal time for a blanket, a book and a hot drink. Perhaps you are attracted to romance _ an increasingly popular literary genre that combines love and heroic stories, in which, of course, the whole world is saved. And speaking of rescue, Croatia also has its own superhero! He wears a red and blue costume, he is fearless and always ready to help _ meet Spiderman from Velika Gorica. / Priče iz Hrvatske ovoga su puta obojane jesenskim bojama. Upoznajemo kraljicu jeseni _ Njezino Veličanstvo bundevu. Jesen je idealno vrijeme za dekicu, knjigu i topli napitak. Možda vas privuče romantasy _ sve popularniji književni žanr koji spaja ljubavnu i herojsku priču, u kojoj se, naravno, spašava cijeli svijet.A kad smo već kod spašavanja, i Hrvatska ima svog superheroja! Nosi crveno-plavi kostim, neustrašiv je i uvijek spreman pomoći _ upoznajte Spidermana iz Velike Gorice.

programme.title: Super Pottery / Superpotjera
programme.desc: In the Superchase, hunters join a super team _ five top experts who act as one. Having created one of the most powerful quiz teams in the world, they are ready to face any challenger. Who among the contestants has enough knowledge, skill and concentration to defeat this unbeatable team? / U Superpotjeri lovci se udružuju u super tim _ petero vrhunskih znalaca koji djeluju kao jedan. Stvorivši jednu od najmoćnijih kvizaških ekipa na svijetu, spremni su suočiti se sa svakim izazivačem. Tko među natjecateljima ima dovoljno znanja, vještine i koncentracije da pobijedi ovaj nepobjedivi tim?

programme.title: Square home / Dom na kvadrat
programme.desc: We spoke with Damjan Geber, the founder of the architectural studio Brigada, who revealed to us that nothing in the stores is by chance. We were in the field with experts who investigated where the moisture was coming from and learned how to best remediate it. / Razgovarali smo s osnivačem arhitektonskog studija Brigada Damjanom Geberom koji nam je otkrio kako ništa u trgovinama nije slučajno. Bili smo na terenu sa stručnjacima koji su ispitivali odakle dolazi vlaga i naučili kako ju je najbolje sanirati.

programme.title: The voice of the motherland / Glas domovine
programme.desc: In the show: Why is Graz desirable for young people from various parts of the world to live and live in, why do Paula and Diego want to stay there? How was the collaboration between a musician from Australia of Croatian origin and a famous rocker from Rijeka achieved? With the support of the Croatian Government, the restoration of the birthplace of Ban Jelačić in Petrovaradin continues. The traditional Festival of Claps and Choirs was held in the town of Frakanava. / U emisiji: Zbog čega je Graz poželjan za život i stanovanje mladima iz raznih dijelova svijeta, zbog čega ondje žele ostati Paula i Diego? Kako je ostvarena suradnja glazbenika iz Australije hrvatskog podrijetla i poznatog riječkog rokera? Uz potporu hrvatske Vlade nastavlja se obnova rodne kuće bana Jelačića u Petrovaradinu. U gradišćanskom mjestu Frakanava održan je tradicionalni Festival klapa i zborova.

programme.title: HAK - Traffic education / HAK - Prometna edukacija
programme.desc: The educational weekly show of the Croatian Auto Club brings reports, short tips and interesting facts about road traffic and increasing safety. / Edukativna tjedna emisija Hrvatskog autokluba donosi reportaže, kratke savjete i zanimljivosti o cestovnom prometu i povećanju sigurnosti.

programme.title: tourism. hrt / turizam.hrt
programme.desc: Is there any progress in the tourist valorization of the Pula fortifications? How do the few that are in operation "live" and to what extent does the cultural and historical heritage in Pula attract tourists? In the show, we also talk about the news of the Goran offer, we check how the hotels on the Dalmatian coast are operating at this time, and we also discover the new transoceanic airline from Split... / Ima li pomaka u turističkoj valorizaciji pulskih utvrda? Kako "žive" one malobrojne koje su u funkciji i u kojoj mjeri kulturno-povijesna baština u Pulu privlači turiste? U emisiji govorimo i o novostima goranske ponude, provjeravamo kako u ovo doba posluju hoteli na dalmatinskoj obali, a otkrivamo i novu prekooceansku zračnu liniju iz Splita...

programme.title: Hit of the day / Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Around the world by train / Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Sir Tony Robinson has a mission to know and understand the shared history and culture of Mexico and the US. He leaves the usual tourist paths and meets locals who reveal unexpected stories to him. From the Mexican desert to starry Los Angeles, he explores these fascinating parts of America by train. The journey begins with the El Chepe train on the west coast of Mexico through the spectacular Copper Canyon _ larger and deeper than the Grand Canyon in the USA. There they will meet people who have lived in the canyon for generations. Then he takes the only passenger train in Mexico to the USA and on the way he will stop in the city of Chihuahua, where he will learn how he became prosperous and learn about the traditional drink "sotol", a northern Mexican type of tequila. They will have fun at the distillery tasting exotic varieties, including one with marijuana. Then he comes to the city that, thanks to the cartel wars, was once known as the most murderous city in the world, Juarez. / Sir Tony Robinson ima misiju upoznati i razumjeti zajedničku povijest i kulturu Meksika i SAD-a. Napušta uobičajene turističke staze i upoznaje domaće koji mu otkrivaju neočekivane priče. Od meksičke pustinje do zvjezdanog Los Angelesa, vlakom istražuje ove fascinantne dijelove Amerike. Putovanje počinje vlakom El Chepe na zapadnoj obali Meksika kroz spektakularni Bakreni kanjon _ veći i dublji od Grand Canyona u SAD-u. Ondje će upoznati ljude koji u kanjonu žive naraštajima. Zatim jedinim putničkim vlakom u Meksiku kreće prema SAD-u i putem će stati u gradu Chihuahui gdje će doznati kako je postao prosperitetan i upoznati tradicionalno piće "sotol", sjevernomeksičku vrstu tekile. Zabavit će se u destileriji kušajući egzotične varijante, uključujući jednu s marihuanom. Zatim dolazi u grad koji je zahvaljujući ratovima kartela nekoć bio poznat kao grad s najviše ubojstava na svijetu, Juarez.

programme.title: Tim Peake and the Secrets of the Universe / Tim Peake i tajne svemira
programme.desc: In the epic introduction to the series, Tim heads deep into the Western Australian outback, where clear night skies offer breathtaking views of our own galaxy, the Milky Way. While stargazing with British astronomer Dr. Natasha Hurley-Walker, Tim feels planets and stars. / U epskom uvodu u seriju Tim odlazi duboko u zaleđe Zapadne Australije, gdje vedro noćno nebo pruža pogled na našu galaksiju, Mliječni put, od kojeg zastaje dah. Dok gleda zvijezde s britanskom astronomkinjom dr. Natashom Hurley-Walker, Tim osjeća planete i zvijezde.

programme.title: But / Dar
programme.desc: A psychological thriller about unexpected gifts and a dark secret that came to light after two decades. When Simon (J. Bateman) changed jobs, he and his wife Robyn (R. Hall) moved from Chicago to the suburbs of Los Angeles. While shopping, they met Simon's schoolmate Gordon Moseley, aka Gordo (J. Edgerton), who has since started dropping by unannounced and bringing gifts. This began to disturb Simon, but Robyn didn't see any problem in it until she began to discover the truth about the relationship between the two men during school and to wonder how well we know the people we are close to... / Psihološki triler o neočekivanim darovima i mračnoj tajni koja je nakon dva desetljeća izašla na vidjelo. Kad je Simon (J. Bateman) promijenio posao, on i njegova žena Robyn (R. Hall) preselili su se iz Chicaga u predgrađe Los Angelesa. Dok su bili u kupovini, sreli su Simonovog školskog kolegu Gordona Moseleya, zvanog Gordo (J. Edgerton), koji je od tada počeo nenajavljeno svraćati k njima i donositi darove. Simona je to počelo uznemiravati, no Robyn u tome nije vidjela neki problem sve dok nije počela otkrivati istinu o odnosu dvojice muškaraca tijekom školovanja i pitati se koliko poznajemo ljude s kojima smo bliski...

programme.title: Bay / Zaljev
programme.desc: The Major Crimes Unit finds a key clue that casts doubt on another member of Hanna's family. With red tape holding back the investigation, Manning's frustration and lack of results is at a peak and he decides to cut corners to make some sort of breakthrough. Jenn threatens her relationship with the Dawson family after she gets too close to Steve. At the same time, Chris has to face both the educational inspection and family problems. After it turns out that Cal won't lead the team to Hanna's killer, Manning finds himself under fire from his superiors, and the investigation stumbles again. / Odjel teških zločina nalazi ključni trag koji baca sumnju na još jednog člana Hannine obitelji. S obzirom na to da birokracija koči istragu, Manningova frustracija i nedostatak rezultata dosežu vrhunac pa on odlučuje hvatati krivine kako bi učinio kakav-takav pomak. Jenn ugrozi svoj odnos s obitelji Dawson nakon što se previše zbliži sa Steveom. Istodobno, Chris se mora suočiti i s prosvjetnom inspekcijom i s obiteljskim problemima. Nakon što se ispostavi da Cal ekipu neće odvesti do Hannina ubojice, Manning se nađe na udaru nadređenih, a istraga ponovno tapka na mjestu.

programme.title: Lewis / Lewis
programme.desc: Lewis investigates the gruesome murder of a young waitress after she leaves her professor's book launch. As Lewis and Hathaway delve deeper into the mystery of the crime, the line between fantasy and reality becomes ever thinner as the murder begins to mirror the content of the professor's books. / Lewis istražuje stravično ubojstvo mlade konobarice nakon što je napustila predstavljanje knjige svoga profesora. Kako Lewis i Hathaway poniru dublje u zagonetku zločina, granica između fantazije i stvarnosti postaje sve tanja jer ubojstvo počinje zrcaliti sadržaj profesorovih knjiga.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Just when he thinks his life is on the way, Adam receives a letter from New York University that changes everything. When Barry finds out that his boys are hanging out with people outside of their circle, he fears that this is the end of their friendship. / Taman kad pomisli da mu je krenulo u životu, Adamu stiže pismo sa Sveučilišta u New Yorku koje sve mijenja. Kad Barry dozna da se njegovi dečki druže i s ljudima izvan njihova kruga, boji se da je to kraj prijateljstva.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam takes Beverly to her graduation anniversary and decides to make sure she doesn't end up with the wrong man. Barry and Joanne make an unexpected decision to show everyone how serious their relationship is. / Adam odvede Beverly na proslavu godišnjice mature i odluči se pobrinuti da ne završi s pogrešnim muškarcem. Barry i Joanne donose neočekivanu odluku kako bi svima pokazali koliko je njihova veza ozbiljna.

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana arrives at the magnificent palace of La Promesa on the day of the arranged marriage of Don Tomás, heir to the Luján family, and Jimena de los Infantes. Jana manages to get a job as a replacement for the fired maid who was helping with the wedding preparations. The first person she meets is the groom's younger brother, Don Manuel. Actually, Jana didn't come here by chance. She is looking for her mother's killer and her brother's kidnapper. Finding herself in a bind, Jana is forced to confide her plan to Tomás, and he thinks he knows who committed the crime... / Jana dolazi u veličanstvenu palaču La Promesa na dan sklapanja ugovorenog braka Don Tomása, nasljednika obitelji Luján, i Jimene de los Infantes. Jana uspijeva dobiti posao kao zamjena za otpuštenu sluškinju koja je pomagala oko priprema za vjenčanje. Prva osoba koju susreće je mladoženjin mlađi brat, Don Manuel. Ustvari, Jana nije slučajno došla ovamo. Ona traga za ubojicom svoje majke i otmičarem svojega brata. Našavši se u škripcu, Jana je prisiljena povjeriti Tomásu svoj plan, a on misli da zna tko je taj zločin počinio...

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Three dogs and their two owners want to realize their dream of escaping to the countryside _ from the bustling port city of Southampton to beautiful, rural Herefordshire. Denise Nurse is already ready and waiting for them with the keys to a selection of outstanding potential new homes. / Tri psa i njihova dva vlasnika žele ostvariti svoj san o bijegu na selo _ iz užurbanog lučkog grada Southamptona u prekrasni, ruralni Herefordshire. Denise Nurse već je spremna i čeka ih s ključevima od odabranih izvanrednih potencijalnih novih domova.

programme.title: The most wonderful homes in the world / Najčudesniji domovi na svijetu
programme.desc: Piers Taylor and Caroline Quentin will travel to Switzerland, where architecture is influenced by neighboring countries and dramatic nature. The house in Les Jeurs was built in the shadow of Mont Blanc at 1300 m above sea level in the Alps. It is a modern version of a traditional Swiss wooden house. The second house lies on the western shore of Lake Maggiore, in an area known for its warm climate and Italian influence. The third house is located close to Zurich. The last house is a villa on the lake with a view of Firvaldštet Lake. / Piers Taylor i Caroline Quentin otputovat će u Švicarsku, u kojoj je arhitektura pod utjecajem susjednih zemalja i dramatične prirode. Kuća u Les Jeursu izgrađena je u sjeni Mont Blanca na 1300 m nadmorske visine u Alpama. Riječ je o modernoj inačici tradicionalne švicarske drvene kuće. Druga kuća leži na zapadnoj obali jezera Maggiore, na području poznatom po toploj klimi i talijanskom utjecaju. Treća se kuća smjestila nadomak Zuricha. Posljednja je kuća vila na jezeru s pogledom na Firvaldštetsko jezero.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: In today's sequel, Gordon will show how he prepares his favorite street food at home, such as delicious fried tortillas with shrimp and irresistible salted popcorn with caramel. Son Jack will help him prepare buttermilk fried chicken, one of the Ramsay family's favorite dishes. / Gordon će u današnjem nastavku pokazati kako kod kuće priprema njemu najdraža ulična jela poput slasnih preprženih tortilja s kozicama i neodoljivih slanih kokica s karamelom. Sin Jack pomoći će mu da pripremi prženu piletinu s mlaćenicom, jedno od omiljenih jela u obitelji Ramsay.

programme.title: Garden saviors / Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Danni and Dawn decided to create a naughty wonderland for their five-year-old twins Ellie and Sofia. With a budget of £5,000 Charlie and Flo let their creative, playful imaginations run wild. Danni and Dawn moved into their newly built home four years ago. With two small children, the garden was not a priority for them. Now they have decided to transform that space and introduce twists instead of symmetry. Their goal is to create a magical place for Ellie and Sofia where the girls can explore, play hide and seek and build secret hiding places. In addition, they also want a place where the two of them can rest and relax in the shade. / Danni i Dawn odlučile su stvoriti nestašnu zemlju čudesa za svoje petogodišnje blizanke Ellie i Sofiju. Uz budžet od 5000 funta Charlie i Flo puštaju na volju svojoj kreativnoj razigranoj mašti. Danni i Dawn uselile su se u svoj novoizgrađeni dom prije četiri godine. Uz dvoje male djece vrt im nije bio prioritetan. Sad su odlučile preobraziti taj prostor i u njega unijeti vijuge umjesto simetrije. Cilj im je stvoriti čarobno mjesto za Ellie i Sofiju gdje će curice moći istraživati, igrati se skrivača i graditi tajna skrovišta. Usto, također žele mjesto gdje će se njih dvije moći odmarati i opuštati u hladu.

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue greets Mark Lane _ who is preparing a warm kale salad with peanut dressing and plum cake _ and remembers how to make a dish her husband hasn't eaten in nearly twenty years. / Prue pozdravlja Marka Lanea _ koji priprema toplu salatu od kelja s preljevom od kikirikija i kolač od šljive _ te se prisjeća načina izrade jela koje njezin suprug nije jeo gotovo dvadeset godina.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The rugged west of France is surrounded by the sea. Brittany, with its often stormy weather and harsh climate, has a peculiar charm. Inland are deep forests and hilly wasteland, on the coast rugged steep slopes with extremely unusual rock formations, and in between beaches with white sand similar to the Caribbean. No place is more than 80 km from the coast. Most Bretons live from the sea and with the sea. / Surovi zapad Francuske okružen je morem. Bretanja s često olujnim vremenom i oštrom klimom ima osebujan šarm. U unutrašnjosti se prostiru duboke šume i brežuljkasta pustopoljina, na obali krševite strme padine s krajnje neobičnim formacijama stijena, a između toga plaže s bijelim pijeskom nalik na karipske. Nijedno mjesto nije udaljeno od obale više od 80 km. Većina Bretonaca živi od mora i s morem.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Three dogs and their two owners want to realize their dream of escaping to the countryside _ from the bustling port city of Southampton to beautiful, rural Herefordshire. Denise Nurse is already ready and waiting for them with the keys to a selection of outstanding potential new homes. / Tri psa i njihova dva vlasnika žele ostvariti svoj san o bijegu na selo _ iz užurbanog lučkog grada Southamptona u prekrasni, ruralni Herefordshire. Denise Nurse već je spremna i čeka ih s ključevima od odabranih izvanrednih potencijalnih novih domova.

programme.title: The most wonderful homes in the world / Najčudesniji domovi na svijetu
programme.desc: Piers Taylor and Caroline Quentin will travel to Switzerland, where architecture is influenced by neighboring countries and dramatic nature. The house in Les Jeurs was built in the shadow of Mont Blanc at 1300 m above sea level in the Alps. It is a modern version of a traditional Swiss wooden house. The second house lies on the western shore of Lake Maggiore, in an area known for its warm climate and Italian influence. The third house is located close to Zurich. The last house is a villa on the lake with a view of Firvaldštet Lake. / Piers Taylor i Caroline Quentin otputovat će u Švicarsku, u kojoj je arhitektura pod utjecajem susjednih zemalja i dramatične prirode. Kuća u Les Jeursu izgrađena je u sjeni Mont Blanca na 1300 m nadmorske visine u Alpama. Riječ je o modernoj inačici tradicionalne švicarske drvene kuće. Druga kuća leži na zapadnoj obali jezera Maggiore, na području poznatom po toploj klimi i talijanskom utjecaju. Treća se kuća smjestila nadomak Zuricha. Posljednja je kuća vila na jezeru s pogledom na Firvaldštetsko jezero.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: In today's sequel, Gordon will show how he prepares his favorite street food at home, such as delicious fried tortillas with shrimp and irresistible salted popcorn with caramel. Son Jack will help him prepare buttermilk fried chicken, one of the Ramsay family's favorite dishes. / Gordon će u današnjem nastavku pokazati kako kod kuće priprema njemu najdraža ulična jela poput slasnih preprženih tortilja s kozicama i neodoljivih slanih kokica s karamelom. Sin Jack pomoći će mu da pripremi prženu piletinu s mlaćenicom, jedno od omiljenih jela u obitelji Ramsay.

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue greets Mark Lane _ who is preparing a warm kale salad with peanut dressing and plum cake _ and remembers how to make a dish her husband hasn't eaten in nearly twenty years. / Prue pozdravlja Marka Lanea _ koji priprema toplu salatu od kelja s preljevom od kikirikija i kolač od šljive _ te se prisjeća načina izrade jela koje njezin suprug nije jeo gotovo dvadeset godina.

programme.title: Lewis / Lewis
programme.desc: After the preparation of the university play The Merchant of Venice is abruptly interrupted by the death of the lead actor, Lewis is called to investigate a case that will lead him to confront his own past. / Nakon što pripremu sveučilišne predstave Mletački trgovac naglo prekine smrt glavnoga glumca, Lewis je pozvan da istraži slučaj koji će ga navesti na suočavanje s vlastitom prošlosti.

programme.title: TV calendar / TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: The world of science / Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: The show brings current events, new scientific discoveries, interesting facts from the animal and plant world, and social phenomena. We will look into all the corners of the Earth, and we will not forget the rest of the universe either. We bring the serious, but also the more casual, fun side of science. / Emisija donosi aktualnosti, nova znanstvena otkrića, zanimljivosti iz životinjskog i biljnog svijeta te društvene fenomene. Zavirit ćemo u sve kutke Zemlje, a nećemo zaboraviti ni ostatak svemira. Donosimo ozbiljnu, ali i onu ležerniju, zabavnu stranu znanosti.

programme.title: Prometheus / Prometej
programme.desc: The weekly show about science, new knowledge and innovations that practically change our world, improving our everyday life, presents the professional and scientific achievements of our scientists in all scientific fields. / Tjedna emisija o znanosti, novim spoznajama i inovacijama koje praktično mijenjaju naš svijet poboljšavajući nam svakodnevicu, predstavlja stručna i znanstvena postignuća naših znanstvenika u svim znanstvenim područjima.

programme.title: Business plan / Poslovni plan
programme.desc: The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP trends, problems and growth generators. / Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta.

programme.title: Coordination / Koordinacija
programme.desc: The Coordination team takes you to the capital of Albania _ the city of colors and incredible skyscrapers. The guest of Notes is professor emeritus Tihomir Jukić, one of the most respected Croatian urban planners. In Miljokaz, we introduce you to a Croat who manages million-dollar construction projects in Germany, and takes care of his olive grove in Croatia. In the new section Under the helmet, we present a construction engineer who reveals construction irregularities on social networks that no one mentions. Youtuber and craftsman Doctor DS will show how, with quality paints and coatings, an old planter can take on a completely new look. / Ekipa Koordinacije vodi vas u glavni grad Albanije _ grad boja i nevjerojatnih nebodera. Gost Notesa je profesor emeritus Tihomir Jukić, jedan od najuglednijih hrvatskih urbanista. U Miljokazu vas upoznajemo s Hrvatom koji u Njemačkoj vodi milijunske građevinske projekte, a u Hrvatskoj se brine o svojem masliniku. U novoj rubrici Ispod kacige predstavljamo inženjerku građevinarstva koja na društvenim mrežama otkriva građevinske nepravilnosti koje nitko ne spominje. Youtuber i majstor Doctor DS pokazat će kako uz kvalitetne boje i premaze stara žardinjera može poprimiti potpuno novi izgled.

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: The weekly show brings short reports about the everyday life of Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina, follows the political scene there, events in the Croatian community, reminds us of the greats of Croatian culture, science and history. / Tjedna emisija, donosi kratke reportaže o svakodnevici Hrvata u BiH, prati tamošnju političku scenu, događaje u hrvatskoj zajednici, podsjeća na velikane hrvatske kulture, znanosti i povijesti.

programme.title: Herb hunter / Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herb hunter visits the southernmost branch of Lička Plješivice _ Poštak. The highest rounded peak on the northern ridge is Bijeli vrh, 1446 meters high. From a distance, it stands out because of the steep, almost cut-off slope below the peak. In addition to the wide vistas, it is interesting as a hiker because of the natural park of unusual stone sculptures on the grassy slope next to the marked trail, at an altitude of 1,200 meters. Some of the plants in this episode are small cacti, narrow-leaved lungwort, stout gorse, bearberry, large sasa, and medicinal primrose. The guests of the episode are Gradimira Bumbak, vice president of HPD Kamenar from Šibenik, and Vesna Bogunović, a lover of plants. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje najjužniji ogranak Ličke Plješivice _ Poštak. Najviši zaobljeni vrh na sjevernom grebenu je Bijeli vrh, visok 1446 metara. Iz daljine se posebno ističe po strmoj, gotovo odsječenoj padini ispod vrha. Osim zbog širokih vidika planinarski je zanimljiv zbog prirodnog parka neobičnih kamenih skulptura na travnatoj padini pokraj markirane staze, na visini od 1200 metara. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su mali kaćun, uskolisni plućnjak, čvrsta šupaljka, medvjedka, velika sasa i ljekoviti jaglac. Gosti epizode su Gradimira Bumbak, potpredsjednica HPD Kamenar iz Šibenika te Vesna Bogunović, zaljubljenica u bilje.

programme.title: Hit of the day / Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Around the world by train / Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Sir Tony Robinson will take the train to the unknown, traveling from Canada to Alaska. He looks forward to meeting Canadians and exploring the great wilderness in this part of the world, from the Rocky Mountains to the beautiful glaciers of Alaska. The journey begins in the high-tech city of Seattle, home to Amazon, Microsoft and Starbucks. The Amtrack Cascades train will take him across the border into Canada, where he will immediately be surprised by the beauty of Vancouver and the warmth of Canadians. / Sir Tony Robinson će se vlakom zaputiti u nepoznato putujući iz Kanade u Aljasku. Veseli se upoznavanju Kanađana i istraživanju velike divljine u ovom dijelu svijeta, od planina Stjenjaka do prelijepih glečera Aljaske. Putovanje počinje u gradu visoke tehnologije Seattleu gdje sjedišta imaju Amazon, Microsoft i Starbucks. Vlak Amtrack Cascades prevest će ga preko granice u Kanadu gdje će ga odmah iznenaditi ljepota Vancouvera i toplina Kanađana.

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: In the show, we talk about what made academician Milivoj Solar special. Namely, when two months ago the public found out that this prominent literary theorist and comparatist, a man who taught for 50 years at the Department of Comparative Literature of the Faculty of Philosophy in Zagreb, had passed away at the age of 90, there was almost no media that did not cover the news and no cultural worker who did not want to say goodbye to this man who spoke about complex things with ease. That's how we dedicate today's ART show to Milivoj Solar, a former professor, to thousands of lucky people, including a large number of journalists from our Kulture newsroom, with whom an era ends. The emcee's guest is academician Pavao Pavličić, a former student of Milivoj Solar and then a longtime colleague at the Faculty of Philosophy in Zagreb. / U emisiji govorimo o tome po čemu je bio poseban akademik Milivoj Solar. Naime, kada je prije dva mjeseca javnost saznala da je u 90-oj godini preminuo taj istaknuti teoretičar književnosti i komparatist, čovjek koji je 50 godina predavao na Odsjeku za komparativnu književnost zagrebačkog Filozofskog fakulteta, gotovo da nije bilo medija koji nije popratio tu vijest i kulturnog djelatnika koji se nije poželio prigodnim riječima i uspomenama oprostiti od tog čovjeka koji je s lakoćom govorio o složenim stvarima. Tako i mi današnju emisiju ART posvećujemo Milivoju Solaru, bivšem profesoru tisućama sretnika, među kojima je i velik broj novinara naše redakcije Kulture, s kojim završava jedna epoha. Gost emsije je akademik Pavao Pavličić, bivši student Milivoja Solara a zatim i dugogodišnji kolega na Filozofskom fakultetu u Zagrebu.

programme.title: Book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Zastave, Gabrijela Rukelj Kraškovič and Robert Međurečan As admirers of Miroslav Krleža, we attended the performance of Zastave at Zagreb's HNK, directed and adapted by Ivan Planinić. From that pleasant evening out came, of course, a contribution _ to be more precise, a review. There were many flowers in the house and garden is the title of Gabriela Rukelj Kraškovič's first book, which might lead the reader to think that it is a warm, nostalgic prose. But for such prose, this title would be too much. "Nothing was ever right in those houses", we read at the very beginning of the book whose author is a guest of our show. After the conversation in the studio, another interesting intervention follows _ in the workspace of this year's winner of the "Gjalski" award, Robert Međurečan. His award-winning novel is set in Judea at the time of Christ, hence the title of the work, which, according to the author, was found by the editor Jadranka Pintarić. She opened the Bible and found a suitable title in Psalm 89: So be it. / Zastave, Gabrijela Rukelj Kraškovič i Robert Međurečan Kao poštovatelji Miroslava Krleže, bili smo na predstavi Zastave u zagrebačkom HNK-u, u režiji i adaptaciji Ivana Planinića. Iz tog ugodnog večernjeg izlaska proizišao je, naravno, i prilog _ točnije rečeno, osvrt. U kući i vrtu bilo je mnogo cvijeća naslov je prve knjige Gabrijele Rukelj Kraškovič, koji bi čitatelja mogao navesti na pomisao da je riječ o toploj, nostalgičnoj prozi. No za takvu prozu ovakav bi naslov bio _ previše. "U tim kućama nikada ništa nije bilo u redu", čitamo već na samom početku knjige čija je autorica gošća naše emisije. Nakon razgovora u studiju slijedi još jedna zanimljiva intervencija _ u radnom prostoru ovogodišnjeg dobitnika nagrade "Gjalski", Roberta Međurečana. Njegov nagrađeni roman smješten je u Judeju u Kristovo vrijeme, pa otuda i naslov djela koji je, prema autorovim riječima, pronašla urednica Jadranka Pintarić. Otvorila je Bibliju i u Psalmu 89 pronašla prigodan naslov: Tako neka bude.

programme.title: from the soul / Animatik
programme.desc: The show announces this year's International Day of Animation, which is celebrated on October 28 _ the day when, in 1892, the first projection of an animated film on celluloid tape in the history of film art was held in Paris. On this occasion, ASIFA Croatia, a branch of the International Animated Film Association (ASIFA), prepared a two-day program in Zagreb, during which a recent production of a Croatian short animated film is shown. In the studio, its president, director Kata Gugić, and secretary, director Matija Pisačić, talk about International Animation Day and the work of ASIFA Croatia. Viewers will see the films: Protoplasm (2017) directed by Katrin Novaković, Eeva (2022), a joint work of Lucija Mrzljak and Morten Tšinakova, and Life Smartphone (2015) directed by Chenglin Xie. Filip Zadro, director of the Tuškanac cinema in Zagreb, talks about the series of films produced by the Japanese studio Ghibli, one of the world's most influential animation studios. / Emisija najavljuje ovogodišnji Međunarodni dan animacije, koji se obilježava 28. listopada _ na dan kada je 1892. godine u Parizu održana prva projekcija animiranog filma na celuloidnoj vrpci u povijesti filmske umjetnosti. Tim je povodom ASIFA Hrvatske, ogranak Međunarodnog udruženja animiranog filma (ASIFA), pripremila u Zagrebu dvodnevni program u sklopu kojega se prikazuje recentna produkcija hrvatskog kratkometražnog animiranog filma. O Međunarodnom danu animacije te o radu ASIFA-e Hrvatske u studiju govore njezina predsjednica, redateljica Kata Gugić, i tajnik, redatelj Matija Pisačić. Gledatelji će vidjeti filmove: Protoplazma (2017.) u režiji Katrin Novaković, Eeva (2022.), zajednički rad Lucije Mrzljak i Mortena Tšinakova, te Life Smartphone (2015.) redatelja Chenglina Xieja. O ciklusu filmova iz produkcije japanskog studija Ghibli, jednog od najutjecajnijih svjetskih studija animiranih ostvarenja, govori Filip Zadro, voditelj zagrebačkog kina Tuškanac.

programme.title: Retrospective of Alain Delon: The Doctor / Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Liječnik
programme.desc: It is modern times and a war is taking place between a European country and a country in the Far East. In the background of the battle lines there is a medical team and a love story between a surgeon and a nurse... / Suvremeno je doba i odvija se ratni sukob između neke europske zemlje i zemlje na Dalekom istoku. U pozadini borbenih linija nalazi se medicinska ekipa i ljubavna priča između kirurga i medicinske sestre...

programme.title: The Simpsons / Simpsoni
programme.desc: Lisa meets the son of the late musician Murphy Gingiva and tries to make his life better. / Lisa upoznaje sina pokojnoga glazbenika Murphyja Gingive pa mu nastoji uljepšati život.

programme.title: Yinniang killer / Ubojica Yinniang
programme.desc: The film is partially based on Pei Xing's short story "Nie Yinniang" about the adventures of a Chinese martial arts master and excellent swordswoman from the end of the seventh century. The film is set in China during the Zhenyuan period (785-805) during the reign of the Tang Dynasty, a few years after the uprising led by An Lushan (755-763). Weibo Province, although formally part of the Empire, is ruled by General Tian Jian. It centers on Nie Yinniang, an assassin who is ordered to kill corrupt government officials by her mistress, the nun Jiaxin, who has raised her since she was ten years old. When Yinniang spares their lives, Jiaxin decides to punish her cruelly and test her loyalty at the same time. He sends her to kill the ruler of the distant province of Weibo in northern China, her cousin Tian Jian, to whom she was promised as a child. / Film se djelomično temelji na kratkoj priči Pei Xinga "Nie Yinniang" o pustolovinama kineske majstorice borilačkih vještina i vrsne mačevaokinje s kraja sedmog stoljeća. Radnja filma smještena je u Kinu tijekom razdoblja Zhenyuan (785.-805.) za vrijeme vladavine dinastije Tang, nekoliko godina nakon ustanka pod vodstvom An Lushana (755.-763.). Provincijom Weibo, iako je formalno dio Carstva, upravlja general Tian Jian. U središtu je radnje Nie Yinniang, ubojica kojoj njezina gospodarica, redovnica Jiaxin, koja ju je odgajala od njezine desete godine, naređuje da ubije korumpirane vladine dužnosnike. Kad im Yinniang poštedi život, Jiaxin je odluči okrutno kazniti i ujedno testirati njezinu lojalnost. Pošalje je da ubije upravitelja daleke provincije Weibo na sjeveru Kine, njezinog rođaka Tian Jiana, kojem je bila obećana kao dijete.

programme.title: Acoustic Project: Furious Dance, Lauba / Acoustic Project: Furious Dance, Lauba
programme.desc: In 2012, the Acoustic Project ensemble released its first CD entitled Acoustic Project, which was nominated for the Croatian discography award "Porin" in the same year. In the continuity of activity, this group of great musicians boldly faces various challenges without refraining from musical experiments, always striving to reach new and as yet unexplored "landscapes of music". According to the opinion of the audience and professional critics, the ensemble made a leap into new musical expanses by introducing into classical music some contemporary, innovative formal structures and instrumentation procedures different from the established ones, and thereby not only brought it closer to other musical styles, but also made it more accessible to an audience that is open to new challenges and eager for new perspectives and exciting and still unexplored musical expanses. / Godine 2012. ansambl Acoustic Project objavljuje svoj prvi CD pod nazivom Acoustic Project, koji je iste godine nominiran i za hrvatsku diskografsku nagradu "Porin". U kontinuitetu djelovanja ovaj sastav sjajnih glazbenika smjelo se suočava s raznim izazovima ne prežući niti od glazbenih eksperimenata, uvijek nastojeći doprijeti do novih i još neistraženih "predjela glazbe". Ansambl je po mišljenju publike i stručne kritike napravio iskorak u nova glazbena prostranstva uvođenjem u klasičnu glazbu nekih suvremenih, inovativnih formalnih struktura i instrumentacijskih postupaka drugačijih od onih uvriježenih te ju je time ne samo približio drugim glazbenim stilovima, nego učinio i pristupačnijom publici koja je otvorena za nove izazove te željna novih vidika i uzbudljivih i još neistraženih glazbenih prostranstava.

programme.title: Yinniang killer / Ubojica Yinniang
programme.desc: The film is partially based on Pei Xing's short story "Nie Yinniang" about the adventures of a Chinese martial arts master and excellent swordswoman from the end of the seventh century. The film is set in China during the Zhenyuan period (785-805) during the reign of the Tang Dynasty, a few years after the uprising led by An Lushan (755-763). Weibo Province, although formally part of the Empire, is ruled by General Tian Jian. It centers on Nie Yinniang, an assassin who is ordered to kill corrupt government officials by her mistress, the nun Jiaxin, who has raised her since she was ten years old. When Yinniang spares their lives, Jiaxin decides to punish her cruelly and test her loyalty at the same time. He sends her to kill the ruler of the distant province of Weibo in northern China, her cousin Tian Jian, to whom she was promised as a child. / Film se djelomično temelji na kratkoj priči Pei Xinga "Nie Yinniang" o pustolovinama kineske majstorice borilačkih vještina i vrsne mačevaokinje s kraja sedmog stoljeća. Radnja filma smještena je u Kinu tijekom razdoblja Zhenyuan (785.-805.) za vrijeme vladavine dinastije Tang, nekoliko godina nakon ustanka pod vodstvom An Lushana (755.-763.). Provincijom Weibo, iako je formalno dio Carstva, upravlja general Tian Jian. U središtu je radnje Nie Yinniang, ubojica kojoj njezina gospodarica, redovnica Jiaxin, koja ju je odgajala od njezine desete godine, naređuje da ubije korumpirane vladine dužnosnike. Kad im Yinniang poštedi život, Jiaxin je odluči okrutno kazniti i ujedno testirati njezinu lojalnost. Pošalje je da ubije upravitelja daleke provincije Weibo na sjeveru Kine, njezinog rođaka Tian Jiana, kojem je bila obećana kao dijete.

programme.title: Acoustic Project: Furious Dance, Lauba / Acoustic Project: Furious Dance, Lauba
programme.desc: In 2012, the Acoustic Project ensemble released its first CD entitled Acoustic Project, which was nominated for the Croatian discography award "Porin" in the same year. In the continuity of activity, this group of great musicians boldly faces various challenges without refraining from musical experiments, always striving to reach new and as yet unexplored "landscapes of music". According to the opinion of the audience and professional critics, the ensemble made a leap into new musical expanses by introducing into classical music some contemporary, innovative formal structures and instrumentation procedures different from the established ones, and thereby not only brought it closer to other musical styles, but also made it more accessible to an audience that is open to new challenges and eager for new perspectives and exciting and still unexplored musical expanses. / Godine 2012. ansambl Acoustic Project objavljuje svoj prvi CD pod nazivom Acoustic Project, koji je iste godine nominiran i za hrvatsku diskografsku nagradu "Porin". U kontinuitetu djelovanja ovaj sastav sjajnih glazbenika smjelo se suočava s raznim izazovima ne prežući niti od glazbenih eksperimenata, uvijek nastojeći doprijeti do novih i još neistraženih "predjela glazbe". Ansambl je po mišljenju publike i stručne kritike napravio iskorak u nova glazbena prostranstva uvođenjem u klasičnu glazbu nekih suvremenih, inovativnih formalnih struktura i instrumentacijskih postupaka drugačijih od onih uvriježenih te ju je time ne samo približio drugim glazbenim stilovima, nego učinio i pristupačnijom publici koja je otvorena za nove izazove te željna novih vidika i uzbudljivih i još neistraženih glazbenih prostranstava.

programme.title: Great shipwrecks of the Adriatic / Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: At the beginning of June 1866, Italy declared war on Austria, deciding to take control of the island of Vis, a key point for the control of the entire Adriatic. After several days of cruising around Vis and bombarding Austrian positions, the Italian fleet decides to conquer the island by landing. However, at dawn on June 20, an Austrian squadron arrived at Vis and a great naval battle began. With a deft maneuver, the Austrian ship sank the Italian admiral ship, the battleship Re d'Italia, and the battle ended very quickly. Legend has it that Re d'Italia was transporting gold coins worth several million euros intended for the establishment of Italian rule on Vis and in Dalmatia. Therefore, the search for the location of the sinking of the Re d'Italie continued for more than a hundred years, until a special Croatian-French expedition found it in May 2005. The last episode of Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic brings a successful search for the location of the Battle of Vis, as well as the reconstruction of that battle, one of the most famous naval battles on the Adriatic. / Početkom lipnja 1866. Italija je objavila rat Austriji, odlučivši od nje preuzeti nadzor nad otokom Visom, ključnom točkom za nadzor cijelog Jadrana. Nakon nekoliko dana krstarenja oko Visa i bombardiranja austrijskih položaja talijanska flota odlučuje osvojiti otok iskrcavanjem. No, u zoru 20. lipnja do Visa stiže austrijska eskadra i započinje velika pomorska bitka. Spretnim manevrom austrijski brod potopio je talijanski admiralski brod, oklopnjaču Re dItalia, te je bitka okončana vrlo brzo. Legenda govori da je Re dItalia prevozila zlatnike vrijedne nekoliko milijuna eura namijenjene uspostavi talijanske vlasti na Visu i u Dalmaciji. Stoga se više od stotinu godina odvijala potraga za lokacijom potonuća Re dItalie, sve dok je u svibnju 2005. ne pronalazi posebna hrvatsko-francuska ekspedicija. Posljednja epizoda Velikih brodoloma Jadrana donosi uspješnu potragu za lokacijom Viške bitke, ali i rekonstrukciju te bitke, jedne od najpoznatijih pomorskih bitaka na Jadranu.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: Etymology is a branch of linguistics that studies the origin of words. In our country it is also called prehistory. Academician Ranko Matasović tells us about the beginnings of research into the origin of words, about our commonality with other languages ​​of the Indo-European group, about why the words brother, frater, brother have the same origin. We also learn how the origin of words that are difficult to determine where they come from, such as the word sedge, raga, etc., is shed light on. / Etimologija je grana lingvistike koja proučava podrijetlo riječi. U nas se zove i iskonoslovlje. Akademik Ranko Matasović govori nam o počecima istraživanja podrijetla riječi, o našem zajedništvu s ostalim jezicima indoeuropske skupine, o tome zašto su riječi brat, frater, bhrata istog podrijetla. Saznajemo i kako se rasvjetljava podrijetlo riječi kojima je teško utvrditi od kuda dolaze, primjerice riječ šaš, raga i sl.

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Sound collector / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing.
