Njezina zelena kruna _ vitamina puna, pomaže nam da budemo jaki i zdravi. Zaplešite i zapjevajte uz novu Juhuhu pjesmicu!

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: The worst witch / Najgora vještica
programme.desc: On her birthday, the Indigo Moon begins to grow and change unexpectedly quickly; and the spell that should help Izzy settle in at school develops in the exact opposite direction. / Na svoj rođendan Indigo Moon počinje neočekivano brzo rasti i mijenjati se; a čarolija koja bi trebala pomoći Izzy da se udomaći u školi razvije se u sasvim suprotnom smjeru.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: We are talking about the history of Esperanto, the people who created it, the reasons why it was created. It was well received in Croatia. From the beginning, enthusiasts have advocated learning that language of hope (which is the translation of the word Esperanto). The Zagreb school for learning Esperanto is also famous. Literature was born on it, it was a bridge for the translation of works of small literature such as ours, you can pray on it, you can also sing. This is exactly what opera singer Neven Mrzlečki does in our show, who translated some of our famous songs into Esperanto. Prof. Ph.D. Velimir Piškorec talks inspiredly about his experiences in learning and speaking Esperanto, about the history of that language and the people who marked its history. / Govorimo o povijesti esperanta, o ljudima koji su ga stvorili, razlozima zašto je nastao. U Hrvatskoj je naišao na dobar prijem. Od početka su se entuzijasti zauzimali za učenje toga jezika nade (što je prijevod riječi esperanto). Poznata je i zagrebačka škola učenja esperanta. Na njemu je nastala književnost, bio je most za prevođenje djela malih književnosti kakva je naša, na njemu se može i moliti, može se i pjevati. Upravo to u našoj emisiji radi operni pjevač Neven Mrzlečki koji je na esperanto preveo neke naše poznate pjesme. Prof. dr. sc. Velimir Piškorec nadahnuto govori o svojim iskustvima u učenju i govorenju esperanta, o povijesti toga jezika i ljudima koji su njegovu povijest obilježili.

programme.title: Tern around the world / Čigrom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Croatian tern and Mladen Šutej sail the seas of the world. In the first five episodes, we will follow the sailing from Biograd, through the Mediterranean, Gibraltar, Portugal, Tenerife, the Atlantic Ocean, the Caribbean, the Panama Canal and the Galapagos. With the help of good winds, self-sacrificing crews and experienced skippers, the Croatian Tern sailed to some of the most interesting parts of the world. In addition to the sailboat built in the shipyard in Kraljevica, we will also see Gibraltar and the port of Tangier in Morocco. We will see what it means to sail across the ocean, when for 25 days there is nothing but wind, sun and endless open sea. After a short stay in the Caribbean, Tern passed through the architectural marvel _ the Panama Canal, and we will also see two faces of Panama City and experience a stay on one of the most interesting natural phenomena _ the Galapagos Islands. In the first episode of "Doors of the Atlantic", the Croatian tern left Biograd, sailed across the Mediterranean and takes us to Gibraltar, Tangier in Morocco and the port of Cadiz, which was the main Spanish starting point for conquests in America. In Villamoura, a fashionable Portuguese resort on the Costa Algarve, Čigraši hung out with the future winner of the non-stop regatta "The Race", and we will also see one of the most beautiful Portuguese cities, Cascais, in the suburbs of Lisbon. / Hrvatska čigra i Mladen Šutej jedre svjetskim morima. U prvih pet epizoda pratit ćemo plovidbu od Biograda, preko Sredozemlja, Gibraltara, Portugala, Teneriffa, Atlantskog oceana, Kariba, Panamskog kanala i Galapagosa. Uz pomoć dobroga vjetra, požrtvovnih posada i iskusnih skipera, Hrvatska čigra doplovila je do nekih od najzanimljivijih dijelova svijeta. Osim jedrilice izgrađene u brodogradilištu u Kraljevici, vidjet ćemo i Gibraltar i luku Tanger u Maroku. Vidjet ćemo što znači plovidba preko oceana, kada 25 dana nema ničeg drugog osim vjetra, sunca i beskraja pučine. Nakon kratkog boravka na Karibima, Čigra je prošla kroz graditeljsko čudo _ Panamski kanal, a vidjet ćemo i dva lica grada Paname te doživjeti boravak na jednom od najzanimljivijih prirodnih fenomena _ otočju Galapagos. U prvoj epizodi "Vrata Atlantika" Hrvatska čigra napustila je Biograd, prejedrila Sredozemlje i vodi nas u Gibraltar, Tanger u Maroku te luku Cadiz koja je bila glavno španjolsko polazište za osvajačke pohode u Ameriku. U Villamouri, mondenom portugalskom ljetovalištu na Costi Algarve, Čigraši su se družili s budućim pobjednikom non-stop regate "The Race", a vidjet ćemo i jedan od najljepših portugalskih gradova Cascais, u predgrađu Lisabona.

programme.title: The World As It Was: Klonimir's Film Records / Svijet kakav je nekad bio: Klonimirovi filmski zapisi
programme.desc: After filming the documentary "All Klonimir's Decades" about the navigator and flight engineer Klonimir Seršić (Baška, Krk, 1925 _ Zagreb, 2021), director Mladen Santrić decided to process his unusual film legacy. It is about a selection of film recordings that Klonimir recorded all over the world in the period from 1960 to 1980. Considering the passage of time, the cycle is a valuable testimony of "the world as it once was", and it consists of sixty short films from Europe, Australia, Canada, the USA, Africa and Asia. This peculiar "time machine" is a valuable film document about a time that new generations would otherwise not be able to experience. / Nakon što je o navigatoru i inženjeru letenja Klonimiru Seršiću (Baška, Krk, 1925. _ Zagreb, 2021.) snimio dokumentarni film "Sva Klonimirova desetljeća", redatelj Mladen Santrić odlučio je obraditi njegovu neobičnu filmsku ostavštinu. Riječ je o izboru filmskih zapisa koje je Klonimir snimao po cijelom svijetu u razdoblju od 1960. do 1980. godine. Ciklus je s obzirom na protok vremena dragocjeno svjedočanstvo o "svijetu kakav je nekad bio", a čini ga šezdesetak kratkih filmova iz Europe, Australije, Kanade, SAD-a, Afrike i Azije. Ovaj osebujan "vremeplov" vrijedan je filmski dokument o vremenu koje nove generacije inače ne bi mogle doživjeti.

programme.title: Eagle vs. Shark / Orao protiv morskog psa
programme.desc: Lilly is a shy and somewhat unusual waitress. She falls in love with Jarrod, a video game geek. After bonding at a "favorite animal" themed party, Lilly follows Jarrod to his hometown, where he wants to confront a former school bully. During this journey, both discover their own insecurities and what it means to accept yourself and others. / Lilly je sramežljiva i pomalo neobična konobarica. Zaljubljuje se u Jarroda, mahera za videoigre. Nakon što se zbliže na zabavi na temu "omiljene životinje", Lilly prati Jarroda u njegov rodni grad, gdje se on želi suočiti s nekadašnjim školskim zlostavljačem. Tijekom tog putovanja oboje otkrivaju vlastite nesigurnosti i što znači prihvatiti sebe i druge.

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karl Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Stone Story - Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquities / Priča od kamena - Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine
programme.desc: In 2007, the Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquities celebrated its 55th anniversary. As a non-profit company, it has been taking care of the city walls and other Dubrovnik historical and cultural monuments for decades, preserving the values ​​that testify to the rich tradition and culture. The members of the Society are volunteers who take care of the city with care and expertise in times when it is increasingly difficult to preserve the true face of the stone city. In the show, we recall the past actions, we recall the recent ones in the maintenance of the Dubrovnik and Ston walls and the walls in Molunt and Cavtat, the restoration of the Sokol fortress and mills on the river Ljutoj, and more. The Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquity is a kind of civic consciousness and the conscience of Dubrovnik and still actively participates in the life of the City. / Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine godine 2007. obilježilo je 55. obljetnicu djelovanja. Kao neprofitabilno društvo, desetljećima skrbi o gradskim zidinama i drugim dubrovačkim povijesno-kulturnim spomenicima, čuvajući vrednote koje svjedoče o bogatoj tradiciji i kulturi. Članovi Društva su volonteri koji brižno i stručno skrbe o gradu u vremenima kada je sve teže sačuvati pravo lice kamenog grada. U emisiji se prisjećamo proteklih akcija, podsjećamo na novije u održavanju dubrovačkih i stonskih zidina te zidina u Moluntu i Cavtatu, obnovu tvrđave Sokol i mlinica na rijeci Ljutoj i drugo. Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine svojevrsna je građanska svijest i savjest Dubrovnika i još uvijek aktivno sudjeluje u životu Grada.

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: The show about art and culture, in the conversation in the studio and reports, opens up topics that are not talked about enough. / Emisija o umjetnosti i kulturi, u razgovoru u studiju i reportažama otvara teme o kojima se nedovoljno govori.

programme.title: Fever / Groznica
programme.desc: The episode explores the very essence of life _ water. From the earliest civilizations to modern-day societies, water is a key thread that shapes our lives, cities and cultures. As we explore the life cycle of water, the rise of ancient civilizations, and the role of water in driving industrialization and sustaining livelihoods, we delve into the cultural, economic, and existential importance of water _ exploring why it is aptly called the driving force of civilizations. / Epizoda istražuje samu esenciju života _ vodu. Od najranijih civilizacija do društava modernog doba, voda je ključna nit koja oblikuje naše živote, gradove i kulture. Dok otkrivamo životni ciklus vode, uspon drevnih civilizacija te ulogu vode u pokretanju industrijalizacije i održavanju sredstava za život, dubinski ispitujemo kulturnu, ekonomsku i egzistencijalnu važnost vode _ istražujući zašto je prikladno nazivaju pokretačkom snagom civilizacija.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The rugged west of France is surrounded by the sea. Brittany, with its often stormy weather and harsh climate, has a peculiar charm. Inland are deep forests and hilly wasteland, on the coast rugged steep slopes with extremely unusual rock formations, and in between beaches with white sand similar to the Caribbean. No place is more than 80 km from the coast. Most Bretons live from the sea and with the sea. / Surovi zapad Francuske okružen je morem. Bretanja s često olujnim vremenom i oštrom klimom ima osebujan šarm. U unutrašnjosti se prostiru duboke šume i brežuljkasta pustopoljina, na obali krševite strme padine s krajnje neobičnim formacijama stijena, a između toga plaže s bijelim pijeskom nalik na karipske. Nijedno mjesto nije udaljeno od obale više od 80 km. Većina Bretonaca živi od mora i s morem.

programme.title: Photography in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Sandra Vitaljić belongs to the younger generation of Croatian photographers. Born in 1972 in Pula, after studying at the FAMU Film Academy in Prague, she came to Zagreb, where she worked as a newspaper, advertising and art photographer. Her portraits, whether they are nudes or fashion photography, are a combination of a character study of the person portrayed and her personal view of the world. In photographs of seemingly deserted landscapes, she connects personal research and topics that occupy her with relevant social events. / Sandra Vitaljić pripada mlađoj generaciji hrvatskih fotografa. Rođena 1972. u Puli, nakon školovanja na Filmskoj akademiji FAMU u Pragu dolazi u Zagreb gdje radi kao novinski, reklamni i umjetnički fotograf. Njezini portreti, bilo da je riječ o aktovima ili modnoj fotografiji, spoj su studije karaktera portretiranog i njezinog osobnog pogleda na svijet. Na fotografijama naizgled pustih krajolika ona povezuje osobna istraživanja i teme koje ju zaokupljaju s relevantnim društvenim zbivanjima.

programme.title: Soloists, Ave Chamber Choir, Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT conducted by Ivo Lipanović - KD V. Lisinski / Solisti, Komorni zbor Ave, Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Ive Lipanovića - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Maestro Ivo Lipanović is one of our most prominent conductors, and he comes to the Kanconijer cycle to direct the symphonic program with soloists and choir. The opera music is represented by the famous orchestral excerpt _Dance with Seven Veils from Salome by Richard Strauss, which the musicologist and Strauss biographer Ernst Krause stated "establishes the modern musical formula for the representation of ecstatic sensual desire and brings it to perfection". In 1927, Krešimir Baranović, a composer whose music is woven into the foundations of the national direction of Croatian music in the 20th century, reached for the verses of Fran Galović from the collection Z mojih bregov. The poems from that collection are considered the beginning of new Kajkavian poetry, and Baranović chose three poems _ Pozdravlenje, Međaš and Kum Martin. Lavishly set to music for baritone and orchestra, they evoke a wide range of images: from village idylls, customs and atmosphere, through the actions and feelings of individuals, to hidden expressions of nostalgia, anxiety, loneliness and transience. Baritone Matija Meić, who is building a successful career in Germany, will be joined in the second part of the concert by soprano Valentina Fijačko Kobić, champion of the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, and tenor Filip Filipović, soloist of the same theater company. Their collaboration will also be the highlight of this program, which brings the monumental symphony Bells by Sergei Rachmaninoff. The work contains verses of the poem of the same name by E. A. Poe in a free translation into Russian, and is also a dedication to Russian church bells and the way they accompany human life. The expanded composition of the orchestra vividly evokes campanological symbols for different types of bells: Christmas bells, wedding bells, alarm bells and funeral bells. / Maestro Ivo Lipanović jedan je od naših najistaknutijih dirigenata, a u ciklus Kanconijer dolazi kako bi ravnao simfonijskim programom uz soliste i zbor. Operna glazba zastupljena je glasovitim orkestralnim ulomkom _ Plesom sa sedam velova iz Salome Richarda Straussa, za koji je muzikolog i Straussov biograf Ernst Krause ustvrdio da "uspostavlja modernu glazbenu formulu za prikaz ekstatične senzualne želje te ju dovodi do savršenstva". Skladatelj čija je glazba utkana u temelje nacionalnog smjera hrvatske glazbe 20. stoljeća, Krešimir Baranović, 1927. posegnuo je za stihovima Frana Galovića iz zbirke Z mojih bregov. Pjesme iz te zbirke smatraju se začetkom novije kajkavske poezije, a Baranović je izabrao tri pjesme _ Pozdravlenje, Međaš i Kum Martin. Raskošno uglazbljene za bariton i orkestar evociraju široku paletu slika: od seoske idile, običaja i ozračja, preko postupaka i osjećaja pojedinaca, do skrovitih izraza nostalgije, tjeskobe, samoće i prolaznosti. Baritonu Matiji Meiću, koji gradi uspješnu karijeru u Njemačkoj, u drugome dijelu koncerta pridružit će se sopranistica Valentina Fijačko Kobić, prvakinja Hrvatskog narodnog kazalište u Zagrebu, i tenor Filip Filipović, solist iste kazališne kuće. Njihova suradnja bit će ujedno vrhunac ovoga programa koji donosi monumentalna simfonija Zvona Sergeja Rahmanjinova. Djelo sadrži stihove istoimene pjesme E. A. Poea u slobodnom prijevodu na ruski jezik te je ujedno posveta ruskim crkvenim zvonima i načinu na koji prate ljudski život. Prošireni sastav orkestra slikovito dočarava kampanološke simbole za različite tipove zvona: božićne zvončiće, svadbena zvona, zvona za uzbunu i pogrebna zvona.

programme.desc: In the new Eco Zone, see how sustainable development can be implemented in urban areas. We will find out everything about the turtle recovery center and the fish tracks. Let's get acquainted with the "Ekobeba" project, and finally we end with a music video by the Zagreb trap/rap band KuKuS, which talks about the mythical mountain Velebit. / U novoj Eko zoni pogledajte kako održivi razvoj implementirati u urbanim sredinama. programme.title: Studio 4: Diagnosis / Studio 4: Dijagnoza
programme.desc: Diagnoses already discussed the new law on critical medicines for the EU, but what we are interested in today is a broader topic, it applies to all Croatian citizens and is very current. What can our citizens expect, what are the new roles of pharmacists and how will all this affect patients and our healthcare? The guest is Ana Soldo, mag. pharm., president of the Croatian Chamber of Pharmacy. / U Dijagnozama je već bilo riječi o novom zakonu o kritičnim lijekovima za EU, no ono što nas danas zanima šira je tema, odnosi se na sve hrvatske građane i vrlo je aktualna. Što mogu naši građani očekivati, koje su to nove uloge ljekarnika te kako će to sve utjecati na pacijente i naše zdravstvo? Gošća je Ana Soldo, mag. pharm., predsjednica Hrvatske ljekarničke komore.

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: In the show: Better connection of the south of Herzegovina with the Dubrovnik area _ new road opened from Zavala to the border with the Republic of Croatia. Numerous projects in Čitluk _ modernization for a better quality of life of the population. In Čapljina, the meeting "Efficient future _ Conference on energy efficiency, ESG and new technologies" was organized. A workshop on adapting agriculture to climate change was held in Hutovo Blato. How do Croats live in Duboštica, a settlement in the municipality of Vareš? Didak's days began, in memory of the great Franciscan and enlightener. / U emisiji: Bolja povezanost juga Hercegovine s dubrovačkim područjem _ otvorena nova prometnica od Zavale do granice s Republikom Hrvatskom. Brojni projekti u Čitluku _ modernizacija za kvalitetniji život stanovništva. U Čapljini je organiziran skup "Učinkovita budućnost _ Konferencija o energetskoj učinkovitosti, ESG-u i novim tehnologijama". Održana je radionica o prilagodbi poljoprivrede klimatskim promjenama u Hutovu blatu. Kako žive Hrvati u Duboštici, naselju u općini Vareš? Počeli su Didakovi dani, u sjećanje na velikog franjevca i prosvjetitelja.

programme.title: Romano Bolković - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Branko Bačić is the Vice-President of the Government of the Republic of Croatia and the Minister of Spatial Planning, Construction and State Property. He was born on June 7, 1959 in Dubrovnik, and in 1982 he graduated from the Faculty of Geodesy of the University of Zagreb. He worked in the Administration for Cadastre and Geodetic Affairs, where he held the position of director, and participated in the Homeland War on the Southern Front. From 1993 to 2004, he was elected mayor of the Municipality of Blato on Korčula three times. He has been a member of the Croatian Democratic Union since 1990 and has been a member of parliament several times. He held a number of positions in the state administration: from 2004 to 2010, he was the state secretary in the Ministry of the Sea, Transport and Development, and from 2010 to 2011, the minister of construction and environmental protection. He has held numerous positions in the HDZ, including that of secretary general and vice president of the party since 2020. We talk with the Deputy Prime Minister Branko Bačić about the key issues of current politics, achievements and challenges of the Government in the past nine years. At the center are the topics of stability in times of crisis _ from earthquakes and pandemics to energy and inflationary crises _ and an assessment of the extent to which the Government has achieved its program goals. We will also talk about reconstruction after the earthquake, which Bačić accelerated by taking over the department, about criticism of the departure of ministers and the perception of corruption, as well as about measures to mitigate inflation and preserve the standard of living citizens. The special topic of discussion is the National Housing Policy Plan until 2030, the first such strategic document in Croatia, with an emphasis on solving the housing issue of young people, the impact of tourism on the rental market and measures to ensure affordable housing. We also consider the laws that marked the mandate _ from the Law on Reconstruction and Management of State Property to the Law on Building Maintenance _ and which of them the Vice President considers to be the most important step forward. / Branko Bačić potpredsjednik je Vlade Republike Hrvatske i ministar prostornoga uređenja, graditeljstva i državne imovine. Rođen je 7. lipnja 1959. u Dubrovniku, a 1982. godine diplomirao je na Geodetskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Radio je u Upravi za katastar i geodetske poslove, gdje je obnašao dužnost direktora, te sudjelovao u Domovinskom ratu na Južnom bojištu. Od 1993. do 2004. tri je puta biran za načelnika Općine Blato na Korčuli. Član je Hrvatske demokratske zajednice od 1990. te je više puta bio saborski zastupnik. U državnoj upravi obnašao je niz dužnosti: od 2004. do 2010. bio je državni tajnik u Ministarstvu mora, prometa i razvitka, a od 2010. do 2011. ministar graditeljstva i zaštite okoliša. U HDZ-u je obnašao brojne funkcije, među kojima i onu glavnog tajnika te potpredsjednika stranke od 2020. godine. S potpredsjednikom Vlade Brankom Bačićem razgovaramo o ključnim pitanjima aktualne politike, postignućima i izazovima Vlade u proteklih devet godina. U središtu su teme stabilnosti u kriznim vremenima _ od potresa i pandemije do energetske i inflacijske krize _ te procjena koliko je Vlada ostvarila svoje programske ciljeve.Govorit ćemo i o obnovi nakon potresa, koju je Bačić ubrzao preuzimanjem resora, o kritikama na račun odlazaka ministara i percepciji korupcije, kao i o mjerama za ublažavanje inflacije i očuvanje životnog standarda građana.Posebna tema razgovora je Nacionalni plan stambene politike do 2030. godine, prvi takav strateški dokument u Hrvatskoj, s naglaskom na rješavanje stambenog pitanja mladih, utjecaj turizma na tržište najma i mjere za osiguravanje priuštivog stanovanja. Razmatramo i zakone koji su obilježili mandat _ od Zakona o obnovi i upravljanju državnom imovinom do Zakona o održavanju zgrada _ te koji od njih potpredsjednik smatra najvažnijim iskorakom.

There are currently 14 clubs competing in the league, fighting for first place and a place in the Champions League qualifiers. / Od 1948. godine bugarski klubovi bore se za titulu najboljeg u zemlji. Trenutno u ligi nastupa 14 klubova, koji se bore za prvo mesto i nastup u kvalifikacijama Lige šampiona.

programme.title: Shortlist / Uži izbor
programme.desc: The best athletes of all time, from all sports. In the same place, at the same time, how to compare them and how to make eternal lists. Someone will try what has been talked about for decades... / Najbolji sportisti svih vremena, iz svih sportova. Na istom mestu, u isto vreme, kako ih uporediti i kako napraviti večne liste. Neko će probati ono o čemu se decenijama priča...

programme.title: Football - 3rd Bundesliga: Mannheim - Munich 1860 / Fudbal - 3. Bundesliga: Mannheim - Munchen 1860
programme.desc: Some former champions of Germany are here. Entering Zvejta means a lot of fame and money, but it's a long and hard road to the goal. / Neki nekadašnji šampioni Nemačke su ovde. Ulazak u Cvajtu znači mnogo slave i novca, ali dug je i naporan put do cilja.

programme.title: Nogome - Grčka ligation: Kifissia - Panetolics / Nogomet - Grčka liga: Kifissia - Panetolikos
programme.desc: Football is loved in Greece and every match, especially the derby, is experienced with a lot of passion. Olympiacos is the favorite for the title, but AEK, PAOK and eternal rival Panathinaikos are knocking on the door ... / Nogomet se voli u Grčkoj i svaki dvoboj, posebno derbi, doživljava se s puno strasti. Olympiacos je favorit za naslov, ali AEK, PAOK i vječiti rival Panathinaikos kucaju na vrata ...

programme.title: Football - Slovenian 1st league: Mura - Celje / Fudbal - Slovenačka 1. liga: Mura - Celje
programme.desc: In previous seasons, we watched very interesting championships in Slovenia and got surprising results. Will it be the same this season? / Prethodnih sezona gledali smo veoma zanimljiva prvenstva u Sloveniji i dobijali iznenađujuće ishode. Da li će tako biti i ove sezone?

programme.title: Football - Austrian League: Austria (W) - Salzburg / Fudbal - Austrijska liga: Austria (W) - Salzburg
programme.desc: Salzburg is once again the favorite for the title, but LASK, Rapid and the others will not give up without a fight. We will certainly have some surprises like Wolfsberger in previous years. / Salcburg je ponovo favorit za titulu, ali LASK, Rapid i ostali se neće predati bez borbe. Svakako ćemo imati i neko iznenađenje kao Volfsberger prethodnih godina.

programme.title: Nogomet: 2nd Bundesliga: Braunschweig - Hanover / Nogomet: 2. Bundesliga: Braunschweig - Hannover
programme.desc: If it's not the strongest, then it's certainly the best-followed second football league in the world. Be a true football fan of the German philosophy of football with the 2nd Bundesliga on small screens. / Ako nije najjača onda je sigurno najbolje praćena druga nogometna liga na svijetu. Budite i vi kao pravi nogometni ljubitelj njemačke filozofije nogometa uz 2. Bundesligu na malim ekranima.

programme.title: Football - Turkish League: Kasimpasa - Besiktas / Fudbal - Turska liga: Kasimpasa - Besiktas
programme.desc: The Turkish Super League is Turkey's highest professional football league. This league was founded in 1957. / Turska Superliga je najviša profesionalna liga Turske u fudbalu. Ova liga osnovana je 1957. godine.

programme.title: Rivalry legend / Rivalitet legendi
programme.desc: They pulled each other forward, some kind of rivalry always raised the sport to a higher level. The best athletes of all time, from all sports. / Vukli su jedni druge napred, uvek je neki rivalitet izdizao sport na lestvicu više. Najbolji sportisti svih vremena, iz svih sportova.

programme.title: Moto 3 Malaysia: TRKA / Moto 3 Malaysia: TRKA
programme.desc: Follow the motorcycle competition in the Moto 3 class, which takes place as part of the Malaysian Grand Prix. / Pratite motociklističko takmičenje u klasi Moto 3, koje se održava u sklopu Velike nagrade Malezije.

programme.title: Moto 2 Malaysia: TRKA / Moto 2 Malaysia: TRKA
programme.desc: Follow the Moto 2 class motorcycle competition that takes place as part of the Malaysian Grand Prix from 10 to 12 November 2023. / Pratite motociklističko takmičenje u klasi Moto 2 koje se održava u sklopu Velike nagrade Malezije od 10. do 12. novembra 2023. godine.

programme.title: Malaysian GP Moto: TRKA / Moto GP Malaysia: TRKA
programme.desc: Follow the Malaysian Grand Prix, an exciting competition that will bring the fastest drivers to the Sepang International Circuit. / Pratite Veliku nagradu Malezije, uzbudljivo takmičenje koje će dovesti najbrže vozače na međunarodnu stazu Sepang.

programme.title: Portugal league overview / Pregled portugalske lige
programme.desc: Founded in 1934 as a trial project, the Portuguese league got its official version called Primeira four years later. In today's system, the league has 18 teams where each team plays one... / Osnovana 1934. kao probni projekat, portugalska liga je četiri godine kasnije dobila i svoju službenu verziju nazvanu Primeira. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 18 ekipa gde svaka ekipa igra po jednu...

programme.title: Odbojka - Polish league (M): Lviv - Czestochowa / Odbojka - Poljska liga (M): Lwow - Czestochowa
programme.desc: We follow the matches of the highest level of volleyball competition in Poland! This league is ranked among the best volleyball leagues in Europe, and the best clubs of that country are fighting for their place in it. / Pratimo utakmice najvišeg ranga odbojkaškog natjecanja u Poljskoj! Ova liga svrstana je među najbolje odbojkaške lige Europe, a najbolji klubovi te zemlje bore se za svoje mjesto u njoj.

programme.title: Bundesliga overview / Pregled Bundeslige
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition founded in 1963 has 18 teams that every August start the race for the popular... / Uz sve ono što nam je Nemačka podarila kroz istoriju ponosno stoji i Bundesliga. Najviši rang fudbalskog takmičenja osnovanog 1963. godine broji 18 ekipa koje svakog avgusta kreću u trku za popularnim...

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Baskonia - Dubai / Košarka - Euroleague: Baskonia - Dubai
programme.desc: The strongest club basketball competition in Europe attracts the attention of a large number of basketball enthusiasts every season. As a high-quality competition, we believe it will attract your attention. / Najjače klupsko takmičenje u košarci na području Evrope svake sezone privlači pažnju velikog broja zaljubljenika košarku. programme.title: Football - Bulgarian Cup: Spartak Pleven - Botev Plovdiv / Nogomet - Bugarski kup: Spartak Pleven - Botev Plovdiv
programme.desc: The Bulgarian Football Cup has been held since 1938. programme.title: Hertha - Elversberg, Football, German Cup / Hertha - Elversberg, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935, when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pokal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the third league. The rest of the participants come from the winners of the regional cups. The matches are played according to the single cup system, in which after the regular 90 minutes extra time is played and after the penalty shootout, if the winner is not decided by then. The final has been played every year since 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The winner of the cup secures a place in the UEFA Europa League... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Augsburg - Bochum, Soccer, German Cup / Augsburg - Bochum, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935, when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pokal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the third league. The rest of the participants come from the winners of the regional cups. The matches are played according to the single cup system, in which after the regular 90 minutes extra time is played and after the penalty shootout, if the winner is not decided by then. The final has been played every year since 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The winner of the cup secures a place in the UEFA Europa League... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: G. Furth - Kaiserslautern, Soccer, German Cup / G. Furth - Kaiserslautern, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935, when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pokal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the third league. The rest of the participants come from the winners of the regional cups. The matches are played according to the single cup system, in which after the regular 90 minutes extra time is played and after the penalty shootout, if the winner is not decided by then. The final has been played every year since 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The winner of the cup secures a place in the UEFA Europa League... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Zagreb Day 1, Wrestling, World Championship / Zagreb Dan 1, Hrvanje, Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Wrestling: World Championships - (sport. program) The World Championships in Wrestling is an international competition organized by the international wrestling federation FILA. Ovogodišnje izdanje održava se u Areni Zagreb od 13. do 12. rujna. Očekuje se da će nastupiti oko 1200 hrvača, a ovo je prvi put da Hrvatska organizira takav spektakl...

programme.desc: Football: CONMEBOL Libertadores - (sport. program, 2025) Copa Libertadores is an annual competition founded in 1960 in which the 38 best teams of South America compete. programme.title: Heidenheim - Hsv, Football, German Cup / Heidenheim - Hsv, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935, when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pokal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the third league. The rest of the participants come from the winners of the regional cups. The matches are played according to the single cup system, in which after the regular 90 minutes extra time is played and after the penalty shootout, if the winner is not decided by then. The final has been played every year since 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The winner of the cup secures a place in the UEFA Europa League... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.desc: Carabao Cup - (sport. program, England, 2025) The Carabao Cup is an English league cup in which more than 90 clubs from the Championship, League One and League Two participate. In this season, a preliminary round has been introduced that starts on August 4, 2025, and the final will be held in the spring of 2026... / Carabao Cup - (sport. program, Engleska, 2025) Carabao Cup je engleski ligaški kup u kojem sudjeluje više od 90 klubova iz Championshipa, League One i League Two. U ovoj sezoni uvedena je preliminarna runda koja počinje 4. kolovoza 2025. godine, a finale će se održati u proljeće 2026. godine...

The tricks with... / Die Tricks mit ...
programme.desc: In hardly any other country are bread and rolls as popular as in Germany. Many bakeries advertise craftsmanship, but brazenly sell industrial goods to consumers. Current research by NDR and WDR for the ARD Consumer Competence Center reveals how a variety of tricks are used to cash in on bread and rolls! How much real craftsmanship is still in the bread and rolls that are sold over the counter every day? Customers are often lured with romantic images of the masterful production of the baked goods, while industrial processes and ready-made mixes dominate in the bakery. More and more companies are turning to industrially prefabricated dough, additives and technical enzymes in order to save time and costs. According to current estimates, more than half of the so-called artisan bakeries no longer work exclusively according to traditional methods. The consumer is often clueless. Particularly explosive: The price often says little about the actual quality. "Vital", "fitness" or "with valuable vitamins" - these terms suggest healthy nutrition. But a look at the ingredient list of many breads with these promises reveals: Some of them contain numerous ingredients such as emulsifiers, stabilizers, sugars and artificial baking aids. To experts, “Vital” or “vitamin bread” are marketing names that make the products appear healthier than they are. Some supposedly healthy baked goods are actually highly industrially processed products and are far from natural bread. Many consumers reach for the bread flap in supermarkets and discount stores for cost reasons. The goods there are significantly cheaper than in bakeries. But how good is the quality? Also popular: baked bread. In the test: branded products versus own brands. The film shows why it is not always worth choosing the more expensive brand when it comes to baked bread. In this documentary for consumers, Anna Planken and Jo Hiller as well as the editorial team research the current tricks in bread and rolls: ready-made mixes instead of handcraft, unhealthy additives, misleading marketing promises. Together with experts, they check prices, quality and taste - and show where consumers can find really good bread. A film that debunks myths and provides consumer knowledge so that people can be more conscious about their daily bread. / In kaum einem anderen Land sind Brot und Brotchen so beliebt wie in Deutschland. Dabei werben viele Backereien mit Handwerk, verkaufen den Verbraucher*innen aber dreist Industrieware. Eine aktuelle Recherche von NDR und WDR fur das ARD Kompetenzcenter Verbraucher deckt auf, wie bei Brot und Brotchen mit ganz verschiedenen Tricks abkassiert wird!Wie viel echtes Handwerk steckt noch in Brot und Brotchen, die taglich uber die Ladentheke gehen? Haufig wird die Kundschaft mit romantischen Bildern von der meisterhaften Herstellung der Backwaren gekodert, wahrend in der Backstube Industrieprozesse und Fertigmischungen dominieren. So greifen immer mehr Betriebe zu industriell vorgefertigten Teigen, Zusatzstoffen und technischen Enzymen, um Zeit und Kosten zu sparen. Nach aktuellen Schatzungen arbeitet mehr als die Halfte der sogenannten Handwerksbackereien nicht mehr ausschlieSSlich nach klassischen Methoden. Der Verbraucher ist haufig ahnungslos. Besonders brisant: Der Preis sagt oft wenig uber die tatsachliche Qualitat aus."Vital", "Fitness" oder "mit wertvollen Vitaminen", diese Begriffe suggerieren gesunde Ernahrung. Doch ein Blick auf die Zutatenliste vieler Brote mit diesen Versprechen offenbart: Zum Teil stecken zahlreiche Bestandteile wie Emulgatoren, Stabilisatoren, Zuckerstoffe und kunstliche Backhilfsmittel drin. Fur Experten sind "Vital"- oder "Vitaminbrot" Marketing-Namen, die die Produkte gesunder erscheinen lassen, als sie sind. So sind einige vermeintlich gesunde Backwaren in Wahrheit stark industriell verarbeitete Produkte und weit entfernt von naturlichem Brot.Viele Verbraucher greifen aus Kostengrunden in die Brotklappe im Supermarkt und Discounter. Dort ist die Ware deutlich gunstiger als in Backereien. Doch wie gut ist die Qualitat? Ebenfalls beliebt: Aufbackbrotchen. Im Test: Markenprodukte gegen Eigenmarken. Der Film zeigt, warum es sich bei Aufbackbrotchen nicht immer lohnt, zur teureren Marke zu greifen.Anna Planken und Jo Hiller sowie das Redaktionsteam recherchieren in dieser Dokumentation fur Verbraucher die aktuellen Maschen bei Brot und Brotchen: Fertigmischungen statt Handwerk, ungesunde Zusatze, irrefuhrende Marketingversprechen. Gemeinsam mit Experten prufen sie Preise, Qualitat und Geschmack - und zeigen, wo Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher wirklich gutes Brot finden. Ein Film, der Mythen entlarvt und Verbraucherwissen liefert, damit man beim taglichen Brot bewusster zugreifen kann.

programme.title: Tough but fair / Hart aber fair
programme.sub-title: Aufstand derJungen: Wird die Rente unbezahlbar?
programme.desc: "It is enough!" The youngest members of the CDU and CSU are protesting against the federal government's pension plans. The costs in the future? "Definitely too high!" Is now the time for a fundamental reform of pension provision? Are the burdens distributed fairly between young and old in our society? Should there be a social year for young men and women in the future or even a compulsory social year for pensioners? / "Es reicht!" Die jungsten Abgeordneten von CDU und CSU protestieren gegen die Rentenplane der Bundesregierung. Die Kosten in der Zukunft? "Eindeutig zu hoch!" Ist jetzt der Zeitpunkt fur eine grundlegende Reform der Alterssicherung? Sind in unserer Gesellschaft die Lasten zwischen Jung und Alt gerecht verteilt? Sollte es zukunftig ein Gesellschaftsjahr fur junge Manner und Frauen oder sogar ein verpflichtendes soziales Jahr fur Rentnerinnen und Rentner geben?

programme.desc: with weather / mit Wetter

programme.title: Dirty Money - Money laundering paradise Germany / Dirty Money - Geldwasche-Paradies Deutschland
programme.desc: Germany is considered one of the hotspots for money laundering in the world. Billions of dollars in criminal money enter our legal economic cycle every day. Drug cartels, terrorist networks, oligarchs - they all use the existing loopholes in the system to turn illegal money into legal money. Why is this so possible in Germany in particular? And who are the money launderers? The film follows the trail of dirty money: it enters the system in disguise, via money couriers, luxury restaurants and real estate investments. He shows the methods of money launderers and their tricks and provides exclusive insights into the work of the BKA, customs and tax investigators. The camera accompanies them in their laborious and complicated investigative work. The film discovers why Germany is one of the largest money laundering paradises in the world, how investigators reach their limits and why illegal money encourages terrorism and wars. We all feel the consequences: exploding real estate prices, collapsing companies, a weakened constitutional state. The documentary shows why consistent combating money laundering is more than financial policy - it is a question of national security. / Deutschland gilt als einer der Hotspots fur Geldwasche weltweit. Kriminelle Gelder in Milliardenhohe gelangen taglich in unseren legalen Wirtschaftskreislauf. Drogenkartelle, Terrornetzwerke, Oligarchen - sie alle nutzen die bestehenden Schlupflocher im System, um aus illegalem Geld legales zu machen. Wieso ist das gerade in Deutschland so gut moglich? Und wer sind die Geldwascher? Der Film verfolgt die Spur des schmutzigen Geldes: Getarnt gelangt es ins System, uber Geldkuriere, Nobelrestaurants und Immobilien-Investments. Er zeigt die Methoden der Geldwascher und ihre Tricks und gewahrt exklusive Einblicke in die Arbeit der Ermittler von BKA, Zoll und Steuerfahndung. Die Kamera begleitet sie bei ihrer muhsamen und komplizierten Fahndungsarbeit.Der Film entdeckt, warum Deutschland eines der groSSten Geldwasche-Paradiese weltweit ist, wie Ermittler an Grenzen stoSSen und warum illegales Geld Terrorismus und Kriege begunstigt.Die Folgen spuren wir alle: explodierende Immobilienpreise, kollabierende Unternehmen, ein geschwachter Rechtsstaat. Die Doku zeigt, warum konsequente Geldwaschebekampfung mehr ist als Finanzpolitik - sie ist eine Frage der nationalen Sicherheit.

programme.title: daily news / Tagesschau
programme.desc: As one of the oldest still existing news programs on German television, the magazine has been broadcast since December 1952. Current events at home and abroad are reported on. / Als eine der altesten noch bestehenden Nachrichtensendungen im deutschen Fernsehen wird das Magazin bereits seit Dezember 1952 ausgestrahlt. Berichtet wird uber das aktuelle Geschehen im In- und Ausland.

programme.title: Crime scene / Tatort
programme.desc: In the Old Country, the Romanian temporary farmer Victor was beheaded. The local police officer Olaf Gerke assumes a fatal accident at work involving an agricultural machine. But Charlotte Lindholm doesn't really want to believe that. Why is the head missing? Since a parallel large-scale operation by the LKA requires all available emergency services, Charlotte Lindholm has to sort things out largely on her own. She follows her instinct and spontaneously rents the vacant guest room on the organic farm where the victim last worked. Little by little she delves into the complex psychogram of the farming family and uncovers toxic relationships between them. Wasn't it a fatal accident, but murder? What did the organic farmer Marlies have to do with the victim? Does the use of pesticides in agriculture, which is hotly debated in the village, play a role? Charlotte also learns that Marlie's son Sven and his wife Frauke do not want to take over the farm. But does that really matter? / Im Alten Land wurde der rumanische Aushilfsbauer Victor enthauptet. Der ortliche Polizist Olaf Gerke geht von einem todlichen Arbeitsunfall mit einer Landmaschine aus. Doch Charlotte Lindholm will das nicht recht glauben. Warum fehlt der Kopf? Da ein paralleler GroSSeinsatz des LKA alle verfugbaren Einsatzkrafte in Anspruch nimmt, muss Charlotte Lindholm weitestgehend Dinge allein regeln. Sie folgt ihrem Instinkt und mietet sich kurzentschlossen in das freie Pensionszimmer des Biohofes ein, auf dem das Opfer zuletzt gearbeitet hat. Nach und nach taucht sie ein in das komplexe Psychogramm der Bauernfamilie und deckt toxische Beziehungen untereinander auf. War es doch kein todlicher Unfall, sondern Mord? Was hatte die Biobauerin Marlies mit dem Opfer zu tun? Spielt der im Dorf heiSS diskutierte Einsatz von Pestiziden in der Landwirtschaft eine Rolle? Charlotte erfahrt auch, dass Marlies Sohn Sven und dessen Frau Frauke den Hof nicht ubernehmen wollen. Doch ist das uberhaupt wichtig?

So greifen immer mehr Betriebe zu industriell vorgefertigten Teigen, Zusatzstoffen und technischen Enzymen, um Zeit und Kosten zu sparen. Nach aktuellen Schatzungen arbeitet mehr als die Halfte der sogenannten Handwerksbackereien nicht mehr ausschlieSSlich nach klassischen Methoden. Der Verbraucher ist haufig ahnungslos. Besonders brisant: Der Preis sagt oft wenig uber die tatsachliche Qualitat aus."Vital", "Fitness" oder "mit wertvollen Vitaminen", diese Begriffe suggerieren gesunde Ernahrung. Doch ein Blick auf die Zutatenliste vieler Brote mit diesen Versprechen offenbart: Zum Teil stecken zahlreiche Bestandteile wie Emulgatoren, Stabilisatoren, Zuckerstoffe und kunstliche Backhilfsmittel drin. Fur Experten sind "Vital"- oder "Vitaminbrot" Marketing-Namen, die die Produkte gesunder erscheinen lassen, als sie sind. So sind einige vermeintlich gesunde Backwaren in Wahrheit stark industriell verarbeitete Produkte und weit entfernt von naturlichem Brot.Viele Verbraucher greifen aus Kostengrunden in die Brotklappe im Supermarkt und Discounter. Dort ist die Ware deutlich gunstiger als in Backereien. Doch wie gut ist die Qualitat? Ebenfalls beliebt: Aufbackbrotchen. Im Test: Markenprodukte gegen Eigenmarken. Der Film zeigt, warum es sich bei Aufbackbrotchen nicht immer lohnt, zur teureren Marke zu greifen.Anna Planken und Jo Hiller sowie das Redaktionsteam recherchieren in dieser Dokumentation fur Verbraucher die aktuellen Maschen bei Brot und Brotchen: Fertigmischungen statt Handwerk, ungesunde Zusatze, irrefuhrende Marketingversprechen. Gemeinsam mit Experten prufen sie Preise, Qualitat und Geschmack - und zeigen, wo Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher wirklich gutes Brot finden. Ein Film, der Mythen entlarvt und Verbraucherwissen liefert, damit man beim taglichen Brot bewusster zugreifen kann.

The police learned from neighbor Mischmeier that the owners always rent out their house to tourists from abroad during Oktoberfest, in this case to Karamanlis and two Greek women. What happened between Karamanlis and his companions and where is the second lady? When Hubert and Girwidz finally pick up Ariadne Papadopoulou at the nearby lake, the first thing they have to do is overcome language barriers. / Eigentlich wollen Hubert und Girwidz nur einen betrunkenen Oktoberfest-Touristen vom S-Bahnhof abholen, der die Fahrgaste belastigt haben soll. programme.title: WaPo Elbe / WaPo Elbe
programme.desc: The body of a young woman, who has been missing for 30 years, is recovered from the Elbe, buried in concrete in a box. The WaPo is now dealing with a cold case from the post-reunification period that has since split an entire village into two deeply hostile camps. Maike and her team have to reconcile the fronts in order to solve the case - above all the embittered Martha Siemers, widow of the main suspect at the time, and Ingo Koschwitz, the short-tempered former boyfriend of the dead Cordula. But the entrepreneur and local politician Uwe Gomolka, who is considered a man of honor, also seems to play a dubious role in the case... / Aus der Elbe wird die in einer Kiste einbetonierte Leiche einer jungen Frau geborgen, die seit 30 Jahren vermisst wird. Wie sich herausstellt, wurde die gesuchte Cordula Ericke damals Opfer eines Gewaltverbrechens. Die WaPo hat es nun mit einem Cold Case aus der Nachwendezeit zu tun, der seitdem ein ganzes Dorf in zwei tief verfeindete Lager gespalten hat. Maike und ihr Team mussen die Fronten versohnen, um den Fall zu losen - allen voran die verbitterte Martha Siemers, Witwe des damaligen Hauptverdachtigen, und Ingo Koschwitz, den aufbrausenden damaligen Ex-Freund der toten Cordula. Doch auch der als Ehrenmann geltende Unternehmer und Lokalpolitiker Uwe Gomolka scheint in dem Fall eine dubiose Rolle zu spielen ...

Wahrend sie verzweifelt glaubt, dass ihr Traum vom LUIS geplatzt ist, hofft Miro, dass der Banker Mitleid bekommen hat und sein Angebot verbessert.Beim Betriebsfest sollen alle Mitarbeitenden eine Zirkusnummer auffuhren. WaPo Bodensee / WaPo Bodensee
programme.desc: After his arrest, Ben Muller (Laurenz Lerch) pretends to be a ripped-off gangster. Although the 23-year-old drove a boat with lots of explosives and is now in custody, he criticizes the quality of the pizza and flirts heavily with Julia (Wendy Guntensperger). Ben threw his cell phone into the water in a bay when he was arrested by Paul (Tim Wilde) and is now remaining silent. Jakob (Max Konig) quickly finds out that the explosives delivery man has a criminal record and works as a part-time jobber at Ella's boat service. Ella (Sabrina Ceesay) is also shocked when she hears that Ben has hijacked the boat that she had to report stolen a few hours earlier. Nele (Floriane Daniel) and her team puzzle together a picture that makes them very sure that Ben, Lino (Oli Bigalke) and Tom (Enno Kalisch)'s accomplices will now rob the nearest bank of a lot of money without explosives. The neighboring jewelry store also comes into the focus of the investigators. But then things develop in an unforeseen direction. A parcel delivery person needs a lot of time... The police are left behind and Jakob, who is alone on the lake, has to make the right decisions very quickly. / Ben Muller (Laurenz Lerch) gibt sich nach seiner Festnahme als abgezockter Gangster. Obwohl der 23-Jahrige ein Boot mit reichlich Sprengstoff lenkte und nun in Untersuchungshaft sitzt, makelt er an der Qualitat der Pizza und flirtet heftig mit Julia (Wendy Guntensperger). Ben hat sein Handy bei der Festnahme durch Paul (Tim Wilde) in einer Bucht ins Wasser geworfen und schweigt nun eisern. Jakob (Max Konig) findet trotzdem schnell heraus, dass der Sprengstoffbote vorbestraft ist und bei Ellas Bootsservice als Minijobber arbeitet. Ella (Sabrina Ceesay) fallt auch aus allen Wolken, als sie hort, dass Ben das Boot entfuhrt hat, das sie wenige Stunden zuvor als gestohlen melden musste. Nele (Floriane Daniel) und ihr Team puzzeln ein Bild zusammen, das sie sehr sicher sein lasst, dass die Komplizen von Ben, Lino (Oli Bigalke) und Tom (Enno Kalisch) nun eben ohne Sprengstoff die nachstgelegene Bank um viel Geld erleichtern werden. Auch der benachbarte Juwelierladen gerat in den Fokus der Ermittler. Doch dann entwickeln sich die Dinge in eine unvorhergesehene Richtung. Ein Paketbote benotigt viel Zeit ... Die Polizei hat das Nachsehen und Jakob, der allein auf dem See unterwegs ist, muss sehr schnell die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen.

programme.title: Knowledge before eight - nature / Wissen vor acht - Natur
programme.desc: Encounters with brown bears are now also often reported in Europe. Bear populations have recovered, e.g. B. in Trentino in Italy or in the Carpathians in Romania. But humans often penetrate too far into the bears' habitats, leaving behind, among other things: Garbage and threatens their home. So what do you do if the bears come too close to us humans in search of food? Thomas D has three good behavioral tips - at "Knowledge before eight - Nature". / Von Begegnungen mit Braunbaren wird jetzt auch ofter in Europa berichtet. Die Barenbestande haben sich erholt, z. B. im Trentino in Italien oder in den Karpaten in Rumanien. Aber der Mensch dringt oft zu weit in die Lebensraume der Baren ein, hinterlasst u. a. Mull und bedroht ihr Zuhause. Was also tun, wenn die Baren auf der Suche nach Nahrung uns Menschen zu nahe kommen? Thomas D hat drei gute Verhaltens-Tipps - bei "Wissen vor acht - Natur".

programme.title: Die Heiland - We are lawyers / Die Heiland - Wir sind Anwalt
programme.desc: Romy's client is none other than Dr. Monika Gross-Zeder, who has now become head of Berlin's monument protection authority. She is responsible for the Spandau Citadel, one of the oldest buildings in Berlin and an important High Renaissance fortress in Europe. Gross-Zeder's office was searched; She, of all people, is accused of taking advantage in office. It is unclear what exactly lies behind the allegations; an anonymous tip brought the public prosecutor's office into action. Romy wonders whether irregularities during the frequent business trips or during the extensive renovation of the fortress wall could be the reason. Gross-Zeder's closest team, the assiduous cultural historian Daniel Rebel and her ambitious speaker Silke Struchholz, who is also in a private relationship with her, act clueless. When Gross-Zeder is temporarily on leave, Romy asks herself: Is this a personal matter or is one of the employees after the boss's job? A declared enemy of Gross-Zeder is Urs Tetzeli, who waits for visitors at the gate of the citadel with historical torture devices. The self-proclaimed medieval expert seeks revenge because his funds were cut off.Karin knew that Romy had a half-sister. But Romy's parents thought it would be better to keep this fact from her. Romy is angry and can hardly contain her disappointment at her mother's behavior. Ringo invites Odette to his and Tilly's home. Tilly is forced to cook for three. Ringo is extremely nervous, but Odette inspires both of them with her uncomplicated nature. A perfect evening, Ringo thinks. He is even more irritated when Odette asks him in the morning whether he would like to move in with her. / Romys Mandantin ist keine Geringere als Dr. Monika Gross-Zeder, die inzwischen Leiterin der Denkmalschutzbehorde Berlins geworden ist. Sie ist zustandig fur die Zitadelle Spandau, eines der altesten Gebaude Berlins und bedeutende Festung der Hochrenaissance in Europa. Gross-Zeders Buroraume wurden durchsucht; ausgerechnet ihr wird Vorteilsnahme im Amt vorgeworfen. Was genau sich hinter den Vorwurfen verbirgt, ist unklar, ein anonymer Hinweis hat die Staatsanwaltschaft auf den Plan gerufen. Romy fragt sich, ob UnregelmaSSigkeiten bei den haufigen Dienstreisen oder bei der aufwendigen Sanierung des Festungswalls der Grund sein konnten. Gross-Zeders engstes Team, der beflissene Kulturhistoriker Daniel Rebel und ihre ehrgeizige Referentin Silke Struchholz, die auch privat mit ihr liiert ist, geben sich ahnungslos. Als Gross-Zeder vorlaufig beurlaubt wird, fragt sich Romy: Geht es hier um eine personliche Angelegenheit oder hat es einer der Mitarbeiter:innen auf den Job der Chefin abgesehen? Ein erklarter Feind von Gross-Zeder ist Urs Tetzeli, der am Tor der Zitadelle mit historischen Foltergeraten auf die Besucher wartet. Der selbsternannte Mittelalter-Experte sinnt auf Rache, weil seine Mittel gestrichen wurden.Karin wusste durchaus, dass Romy eine Halbschwester hat. Aber Romys Eltern hielten es fur besser, ihr diese Tatsache vorzuenthalten. Romy ist wutend und kann ihre Enttauschung uber das Verhalten ihrer Mutter kaum zuruckhalten.Ringo ladt Odette zu sich und Tilly nach Hause ein. Tilly wird dazu verdonnert, fur drei zu kochen. Ringo ist extrem nervos, aber Odette begeistert beide mit ihrer unkomplizierten Art. Ein perfekter Abend, findet Ringo. Umso mehr ist er irritiert, als Odette ihn am Morgen fragt, ob er bei ihr einziehen mochte.

programme.title: In all friendship / In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Dr. Kathrin Globisch wants to work with Dr. Roland Heilmann spend a lovely evening at a dance class. She was really looking forward to it, but then experienced a bitter disappointment: Roland canceled because he supposedly had to have an operation. Instead, Kathrin invites her childhood crush David Schrader at short notice and spends a momentous evening with him.Sarah Marquardt is angry with Dr. Rolf Kaminski. The two had arranged to meet, but the fire alarm went off in Kaminski's practice. He has to think of something to make up with Sarah again. / Dr. Kathrin Globisch will mit Dr. Roland Heilmann einen schonen Abend bei einem Tanzkurs verbringen. Sie hat sich sehr darauf gefreut, erlebt dann aber eine herbe Enttauschung: Roland sagt ab, weil er angeblich operieren muss. Kathrin ladt stattdessen kurzfristig ihren Jugendschwarm David Schrader ein und verbringt mit ihm einen folgenschweren Abend.Sarah Marquardt ist sauer auf Dr. Rolf Kaminski. Die beiden waren verabredet, doch in Kaminskis Praxis hat der Feueralarm ausgelost. Er muss sich etwas einfallen lassen, um sich wieder mit Sarah zu versohnen.

programme.title: Report Mainz: Death after anesthesia / Report Mainz: Tod nach Narkose
programme.desc: A seemingly harmless visit to the dentist can end in death for patients. Deaths occur every year after general anesthesia in doctors' offices. Because anesthetists repeatedly fail to monitor pulse and blood pressure correctly during the operation or in the recovery room. There are clear guidelines for this. There is also often a need for trained staff. Do doctors consciously accept a fatal risk? "Report Mainz" meets relatives of those who died and examines the question of why there are still hardly any checks in doctor's offices despite an increase in outpatient operations. Why are anesthetists allowed to continue practicing in some cases despite being convicted? / Der vermeintlich harmlose Besuch beim Zahnarzt kann fur Patienten todlich enden. Jedes Jahr kommt es nach Vollnarkosen in Arztpraxen zu Todesfallen. Denn immer wieder verzichten Narkosearzte auf eine korrekte Überwachung etwa von Puls und Blutdruck wahrend der OP oder im Aufwachraum. Dabei gibt es dafur klare Vorgaben. Auch an geschultem Personal wird haufig gespart. Nehmen Ärzte ein todliches Risiko bewusst in Kauf? "Report Mainz" trifft Angehorige von Todesopfern und geht der Frage nach, warum es trotz einer Zunahme von ambulanten Operationen weiterhin kaum Kontrollen in Arztpraxen gibt. programme.title: Real life / Echtes Leben
programme.sub-title: TikTok-Star mit 12 - meine Tochter im Rampenlicht
programme.desc: Ruby is twelve years old and a social media star. She has more than 100,000 followers on TikTok. She interviews celebrities like Elias MBarek, is invited to film premieres and advertises plush figures. Her nine-year-old brother Neo is a model and also wants to become a social media star. Ruby's success has completely changed family life. Because lucrative contracts and the prospect of a great career beckons almost every day. But her parents' pride is increasingly mixed with concern for Ruby's health. Can she withstand the pressure of constantly producing new content? Does Ruby feel driven by the fight for higher click counts? Can your daughter tolerate losing friends, feeling the envy of classmates and adapting her free time to the expectations of her followers? Ruby has been unable to produce content for TikTok and Instagram for weeks; she is not feeling well. Parents are increasingly asking themselves the question: How much can they challenge their children and what are the dangers? Mother Elke has taken over Ruby's management. She negotiates contracts with agencies and decides which assignments her daughter can accept. What is Ruby too young for? Which events and products suit her? What risks and stresses do some jobs entail? Elke helps Ruby with rehearsing interviews, formulating texts, dubbing videos and accompanies her to all jobs. This is how she tries to control her daughter's development. At the same time, she recognizes the risks that come with life as a social media star. The report shows how the family increasingly finds itself caught between fame and normality and how the social media dream can become a trap. / Ruby ist zwolf Jahre alt und ein Social Media-Star. Auf TikTok hat sie mehr als 100.000 Follower. Sie interviewt Prominente wie Elias MBarek, wird zu Film-Premieren eingeladen und macht Werbung fur Pluschfiguren. Ihr neunjahriger Bruder Neo ist Model und will ebenfalls Social Media-Star werden. Rubys Erfolg hat das Familienleben komplett verandert. Denn fast taglich locken lukrative Auftrage und die Aussicht auf eine groSSe Karriere. Doch in den Stolz der Eltern mischt sich mehr und mehr die Sorge um Rubys Gesundheit. Halt sie dem Druck stand, immer neuen Content zu produzieren? Fuhlt sich Ruby vom Kampf um hohere Klickzahlen getrieben? Ertragt ihre Tochter es, Freundinnen zu verlieren, den Neid von Mitschulern zu spuren und ihre Freizeit nach den Erwartungen ihrer Follower auszurichten? Wochenlang kann Ruby keinen Content mehr fur TikTok und Instagram produzieren, es geht ihr nicht gut. Immer haufiger stellen sich die Eltern die Frage: Wie sehr durfen sie ihre Kinder fordern und wo liegen die Gefahren?Mutter Elke hat Rubys Management ubernommen. Sie verhandelt Vertrage mit Agenturen und wagt ab, welche Auftrage ihre Tochter annehmen darf. Wofur ist Ruby zu jung? Welche Events und Produkte passen zu ihr? Welche Risiken und Belastungen bringen manche Jobs mit sich? Elke hilft Ruby beim Einstudieren von Interviews, beim Formulieren von Texten, beim Nachvertonen von Videos und begleitet sie zu allen Jobs. So versucht sie die Entwicklung ihrer Tochter zu steuern. Gleichzeitig erkennt sie die Risken, die das Leben als Social Media-Star mit sich bringt.Die Reportage zeigt, wie die Familie immer starker ins Spannungsfeld zwischen Ruhm und Normalitat gerat und der Social-Media-Traum zur Falle werden kann.

programme.title: Die Heiland - We are lawyers / Die Heiland - Wir sind Anwalt
programme.desc: Romy's client is none other than Dr. Monika Gross-Zeder, who has now become head of Berlin's monument protection authority. She is responsible for the Spandau Citadel, one of the oldest buildings in Berlin and an important High Renaissance fortress in Europe. Gross-Zeder's office was searched; She, of all people, is accused of taking advantage in office. It is unclear what exactly lies behind the allegations; an anonymous tip brought the public prosecutor's office into action. Romy wonders whether irregularities during the frequent business trips or during the extensive renovation of the fortress wall could be the reason. Gross-Zeder's closest team, the assiduous cultural historian Daniel Rebel and her ambitious speaker Silke Struchholz, who is also in a private relationship with her, act clueless. When Gross-Zeder is temporarily on leave, Romy asks herself: Is this a personal matter or is one of the employees after the boss's job? A declared enemy of Gross-Zeder is Urs Tetzeli, who waits for visitors at the gate of the citadel with historical torture devices. The self-proclaimed medieval expert seeks revenge because his funds were cut off.Karin knew that Romy had a half-sister. But Romy's parents thought it would be better to keep this fact from her. Romy is angry and can hardly contain her disappointment at her mother's behavior. Ringo invites Odette to his and Tilly's home. Tilly is forced to cook for three. Ringo is extremely nervous, but Odette inspires both of them with her uncomplicated nature. A perfect evening, Ringo thinks. He is even more irritated when Odette asks him in the morning whether he would like to move in with her. / Romys Mandantin ist keine Geringere als Dr. Monika Gross-Zeder, die inzwischen Leiterin der Denkmalschutzbehorde Berlins geworden ist. Sie ist zustandig fur die Zitadelle Spandau, eines der altesten Gebaude Berlins und bedeutende Festung der Hochrenaissance in Europa. Gross-Zeders Buroraume wurden durchsucht; ausgerechnet ihr wird Vorteilsnahme im Amt vorgeworfen. Was genau sich hinter den Vorwurfen verbirgt, ist unklar, ein anonymer Hinweis hat die Staatsanwaltschaft auf den Plan gerufen. Romy fragt sich, ob UnregelmaSSigkeiten bei den haufigen Dienstreisen oder bei der aufwendigen Sanierung des Festungswalls der Grund sein konnten. Gross-Zeders engstes Team, der beflissene Kulturhistoriker Daniel Rebel und ihre ehrgeizige Referentin Silke Struchholz, die auch privat mit ihr liiert ist, geben sich ahnungslos. Als Gross-Zeder vorlaufig beurlaubt wird, fragt sich Romy: Geht es hier um eine personliche Angelegenheit oder hat es einer der Mitarbeiter:innen auf den Job der Chefin abgesehen? Ein erklarter Feind von Gross-Zeder ist Urs Tetzeli, der am Tor der Zitadelle mit historischen Foltergeraten auf die Besucher wartet. Der selbsternannte Mittelalter-Experte sinnt auf Rache, weil seine Mittel gestrichen wurden.Karin wusste durchaus, dass Romy eine Halbschwester hat. Aber Romys Eltern hielten es fur besser, ihr diese Tatsache vorzuenthalten. Romy ist wutend und kann ihre Enttauschung uber das Verhalten ihrer Mutter kaum zuruckhalten.Ringo ladt Odette zu sich und Tilly nach Hause ein. Tilly wird dazu verdonnert, fur drei zu kochen. Ringo ist extrem nervos, aber Odette begeistert beide mit ihrer unkomplizierten Art. Ein perfekter Abend, findet Ringo. Umso mehr ist er irritiert, als Odette ihn am Morgen fragt, ob er bei ihr einziehen mochte.

programme.title: In all friendship / In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Dr. Kathrin Globisch wants to work with Dr. Roland Heilmann spend a lovely evening at a dance class. She was really looking forward to it, but then experienced a bitter disappointment: Roland canceled because he supposedly had to have an operation. Instead, Kathrin invites her childhood crush David Schrader at short notice and spends a momentous evening with him.Sarah Marquardt is angry with Dr. Rolf Kaminski. The two had arranged to meet, but the fire alarm went off in Kaminski's practice. He has to think of something to make up with Sarah again. / Dr. Kathrin Globisch will mit Dr. Roland Heilmann einen schonen Abend bei einem Tanzkurs verbringen. Sie hat sich sehr darauf gefreut, erlebt dann aber eine herbe Enttauschung: Roland sagt ab, weil er angeblich operieren muss. Kathrin ladt stattdessen kurzfristig ihren Jugendschwarm David Schrader ein und verbringt mit ihm einen folgenschweren Abend.Sarah Marquardt ist sauer auf Dr. Rolf Kaminski. Die beiden waren verabredet, doch in Kaminskis Praxis hat der Feueralarm ausgelost. Er muss sich etwas einfallen lassen, um sich wieder mit Sarah zu versohnen.

programme.title: Report Mainz: Death after anesthesia / Report Mainz: Tod nach Narkose
programme.desc: A seemingly harmless visit to the dentist can end in death for patients. Deaths occur every year after general anesthesia in doctors' offices. Because anesthetists repeatedly fail to monitor pulse and blood pressure correctly during the operation or in the recovery room. There are clear guidelines for this. There is also often a need for trained staff. Do doctors consciously accept a fatal risk? "Report Mainz" meets relatives of those who died and examines the question of why there are still hardly any checks in doctor's offices despite an increase in outpatient operations. Why are anesthetists allowed to continue practicing in some cases despite being convicted? / Der vermeintlich harmlose Besuch beim Zahnarzt kann fur Patienten todlich enden. Jedes Jahr kommt es nach Vollnarkosen in Arztpraxen zu Todesfallen. Denn immer wieder verzichten Narkosearzte auf eine korrekte Überwachung etwa von Puls und Blutdruck wahrend der OP oder im Aufwachraum. Dabei gibt es dafur klare Vorgaben. Auch an geschultem Personal wird haufig gespart. Nehmen Ärzte ein todliches Risiko bewusst in Kauf? "Report Mainz" trifft Angehorige von Todesopfern und geht der Frage nach, warum es trotz einer Zunahme von ambulanten Operationen weiterhin kaum Kontrollen in Arztpraxen gibt. Wieso durfen Narkosearzte in einigen Fallen trotz Verurteilung weiter praktizieren?

programme.title: Hubert without Staller / Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: A so-called Erlkonig drives way too fast through a speed trap set up by Hubert and Girwidz. When they stop the vehicle prototype, they discover that the driver is dead and the car was traveling independently. Why did test driver Rosalie Motz have to die? In the investigation, the two are involuntarily supported by 14-year-old Tom Burgmüller, who writes about the work of the police for the school newspaper and is also the nephew of the police president. Fearing for the reputation of the district, the pressure is high on Hubert and Girwidz to solve the case quickly and as inconspicuously as possible for their circumstances. / Durch eine von Hubert und Girwidz aufgestellte Radarfalle fahrt viel zu schnell ein sogenannter Erlkonig. Als sie den Fahrzeug-Prototypen stoppen, stellen sie fest, dass die Fahrerin tot ist und der Wagen selbststandig unterwegs war. Warum musste Testfahrerin Rosalie Motz sterben? Bei den Ermittlungen werden die beiden unfreiwillig vom 14-jahrigen Tom Burgmuller unterstutzt, der fur die Schulerzeitung uber die Arbeit der Polizei schreibt und auch noch der Neffe des Polizeiprasidenten ist. Aus Angst um den Ruf des Reviers ist der Druck auf Hubert und Girwidz hoch, den Fall schnell und fur ihre Verhaltnisse moglichst unauffallig zu losen.

programme.title: WaPo Elbe / WaPo Elbe
programme.desc: Stella Behritz, the 18-year-old daughter of shipowner Wilhelm Behritz, is kidnapped by two masked women on a paddle steamer the morning after her birthday party. The skipper is seriously injured. The kidnappers quickly demand a ransom: 300,000 euros or Stella will die. Her father Wilhelm Behritz doesn't want to take any risks and pays. But the planned handover fails, the WaPo is tricked: the tracking device in the money suitcase doesn't work and the money has disappeared. And yet Stella is not released. In fact, the kidnapped woman was in cahoots with her kidnappers and wanted to cash in on her stingy father. Only Stella did the math without her accomplices: After an argument, they don't even think about sharing the loot and releasing Stella. On the contrary, the kidnappers are increasing their demands... / Stella Behritz, die 18-jahrige Tochter des Reeders Wilhelm Behritz, wird am Morgen nach ihrer Geburtstagsfeier auf einem Raddampfer von zwei maskierten Frauen gekidnappt. Dabei wird der Skipper schwer verletzt. Schnell folgt eine Losegeldforderung der Entfuhrerinnen: 300.000 Euro oder Stella soll sterben. Ihr Vater Wilhelm Behritz will kein Risiko eingehen und zahlt. Aber die geplante Übergabe schlagt fehl, die WaPo wird ausgetrickst: Der Peilsender im Geldkoffer funktioniert nicht, das Geld ist verschwunden. Und trotzdem kommt Stella nicht frei. Tatsachlich steckt die Entfuhrte mit ihren Kidnapperinnen unter einer Decke und wollte ihren geizigen Vater abkassieren. Nur hat Stella die Rechnung ohne ihre Komplizinnen gemacht: Nach einem Streit denken die gar nicht daran, die Beute zu teilen und Stella freizulassen. Im Gegenteil, die Entfuhrerinnen erhohen ihre Forderung ...

programme.desc: Quiz show with presenter Florian Weber and the guessing teams Enie van de Meiklokjes and Bodo Bach against Alice Hoffmann and Christoph Sonntag. Can you use pure aloe vera gel as an aftershave? Is it legal to terminate an employment relationship by email and does opened UHT milk turn sour after five days? This quiz has both feet firmly on the ground, because with the answers to "Master of Everyday Life" you learn for everyday life! programme.title: Red roses / Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Lou bravely supports Daniel after his cancer diagnosis. Only Victoria gets her to drop her facade. In her mother's arms, Lou tearfully confesses how great her fear of losing Daniel really is. Simon is looking for a new apartment, but Elyas convinces him that he shouldn't let Valerie drive him away. So he decides to stay in the attic with Olivia - much to Valerie's annoyance. Arthur is looking forward to moving to Berlin with Svenja, but is worried about Bella, whom he doesn't want to leave entirely to Victoria's influence. Lou and Richard persuade Victoria to finally accept Svenja, whereupon she makes a generous offer. Carla wants to quickly make a new start and move to the horse farm. Britta thinks it's rushed, but wants to support her friend against her better judgment. But the first night in the Dornenhof becomes very uncomfortable for the friends... / Lou steht Daniel nach seiner Krebsdiagnose tapfer zur Seite. Erst Victoria bringt sie dazu, ihre Fassade fallen zu lassen. In den Armen ihrer Mutter gesteht Lou unter Tranen, wie groSS ihre Angst wirklich ist, Daniel zu verlieren.Simon sucht eine neue Wohnung, doch Elyas uberzeugt ihn, dass er sich von Valerie nicht vertreiben lassen soll. Also beschlieSSt er, mit Olivia im Dachgeschoss zu bleiben - sehr zum Ärger von Valerie.Arthur freut sich auf den Umzug nach Berlin mit Svenja, sorgt sich aber um Bella, die er nicht ganz Victorias Einfluss uberlassen will. Lou und Richard bewegen Victoria dazu, Svenja endlich zu akzeptieren, woraufhin diese ein groSSzugiges Angebot macht.Carla will schnell einen Neuanfang wagen und auf den Pferdehof ziehen. Britta halt das fur ubersturzt, will ihre Freundin aber wider besseres Wissen unterstutzen. Doch die erste Nacht im Dornenhof wird fur die Freundinnen sehr ungemutlich ...
