programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Lauterbrunnen, basejumper paradise and cemetery by Caroline Beck Lauterbrunnen, in the Bernese Oberland, has become one of the world capitals of base jumping. The spectacular morphology of the valley, with its vertical walls, is ideal for this extreme sport. The number of jumps is constantly increasing: up to 25 thousand per year. However, this amount of jumping creates tensions with the local population and raises environmental and safety concerns. Fatal accidents are numerous: so far seventy base jumpers have already lost their lives in Lauterbrunnen; therefore, there are those who ask to ban this extreme sport. Is it possible? On the trail of stolen e-bikes by Adrian Lemmenmeier Every year tens of thousands of bicycles are stolen in Switzerland, especially e-bikes due to their value. In recent years the phenomenon has increased by 50%. Last year, over 50 thousand thefts were reported and insurance losses exceeded eighty million francs. The most affected cities are Basel, Bern and Zurich. But where do the stolen bikes end up? Who are the thieves? We find out by following the path of a stolen bicycle on which a GPS tracker was hidden. Milan and its "new poor" by Emanuele Valenti and Claudio MaggioliniMilan, a symbol of wealth and modernity, hides a reality of growing inequalities. The cost of living has increased to the point that even those who work struggle to support themselves. The "new poor" are emerging: single-income families, young precarious workers, pensioners. The housing crisis, aggravated by short-term rentals, is pushing many towards marginalization. The reportage tells the contradictions of a city that risks excluding its own inhabitants. / Lauterbrunnen, paradiso e cimitero dei basejumper di Caroline Beck Lauterbrunnen, nell’Oberland bernese, è diventata una delle capitali mondiali del base jumping. La spettacolare morfologia della valle, con le sue pareti verticali, è ideale per questo sport estremo. Il numero di salti è in costante aumento: fino a 25mila all’anno. Questa quantità di salti crea però tensioni con la popolazione locale e solleva preoccupazioni ambientali e di sicurezza. Gli incidenti mortali sono numerosi: finora già settanta base jumper hanno perso la vita a Lauterbrunnen; perciò, c’è chi chiede di vietare questo sport estremo. È possibile? Sulle tracce delle e-bike rubate di Adrian Lemmenmeier Ogni anno in Svizzera vengono rubate decine di migliaia di biciclette, soprattutto e-bike a motivo del loro valore. Negli ultimi anni il fenomeno è aumentato del 50%. L’anno scorso sono stati denunciati oltre 50mila furti e i danni assicurativi hanno superato gli ottanta milioni di franchi. Le città più colpite sono Basilea, Berna e Zurigo. Ma dove finiscono le bici rubate? Chi sono i ladri? Lo scopriamo seguendo il percorso di una bicicletta rubata sulla quale è stato nascosto un localizzatore GPS. Milano e i suoi “nuovi poveri” di Emanuele Valenti e Claudio MaggioliniMilano, simbolo di ricchezza e modernità, nasconde una realtà fatta di crescenti disuguaglianze. Il costo della vita è aumentato al punto che anche chi lavora fatica a sostenersi. Emergono i “nuovi poveri”: famiglie monoreddito, giovani precari, pensionati. La crisi abitativa, aggravata dagli affitti brevi, spinge molti verso la marginalità. Il reportage racconta le contraddizioni di una città che rischia di escludere i suoi stessi abitanti.

programme.title: The prodigious transformation of the working class into foreigners / La prodigiosa trasformazione della classe operaia in stranieri
programme.desc: Through family photos, animations, testimonies and archive material, the film tells the story of emigration from neighboring countries to Switzerland in an original way, from the post-war period to the present day. At the time we were talking about the working class: a collective identity with a project of social change. In the Seventies this culture collapsed and the working class of the past was now defined as "foreigners". Director Samir intertwines personal history and collective memory, to tell a visual essay on the evolution of an identity that has marked Switzerland. / Attraverso foto di famiglia, animazioni, testimonianze e materiale darchivio, il film racconta in modo originale la storia dellemigrazione dai paesi vicini verso la Svizzera, dal dopoguerra ai giorni nostri.Allepoca si parlava di classe operaia: unidentità collettiva con un progetto di cambiamento sociale. Negli anni Settanta questa cultura crolla e la classe operaia di un tempo viene ormai definita "stranieri". Il regista Samir intreccia storia personale e memoria collettiva, per raccontare un saggio visivo sullevoluzione di unidentità che ha segnato la Svizzera.

programme.title: Signs of the times / Segni dei tempi
programme.desc: There are seven thousand Muslims in Ticino. In this episode we will enter the new Sopraceneri mosque. In Giubiasco, this is the news, the Islamic community has purchased a space specifically dedicated to prayer and interreligious meetings. We will meet imam Luan Afmataj with whom we will address some very current issues, from relations with other religions to the role of women in the Islamic world today. / Sono settemila i musulmani in Ticino. In questa puntata entreremo nella nuova moschea del Sopraceneri. A Giubiasco, è questa la novità, la comunità islamica ha acquistato uno spazio appositamente dedicato alla preghiera e agli incontri interreligiosi. Incontreremo l’imam Luan Afmataj con cui affronteremo alcuni temi di stretta attualità, dai rapporti con le altre religioni al ruolo oggi della donna nel mondo islamico.

programme.title: Paganini / Paganini
programme.desc: "Magical art is that which gives us back the marvelous at the heart of everyday life": this is how the writer Andre Breton expressed himself and - thanking the father of surrealism for the quote and the inspiration - it is precisely the dimension of the magical that the Paganini episode on Sunday 5 October, from 10.30 am on RSI LA1, addresses. The "Livermore Svò" - starring Davide Livermore, now an acclaimed opera director - was a of the funniest and wittiest serial productions in the RSI music sector. In the episode entitled "Magic Music" alongside the histrionic host, the Orchestra of the Teatro Regio of Turin directed by Carlo Boccadoro, a group of madrigalists, the musicians Oliviero Giovannoni and Diego Fasolis alternated. Sorcellerie - literally: witchcraft - is instead a recent French show featuring the pianist duo Jatekok (with works by Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns and Paul Dukas) and two mimes/magicians engaged in an evocative dombre theatre. Fantasymphony is finally the imaginative symphonic program of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra conducted by Christian Schumann which - with the subtitle "a concert of magic and fire" - offers a selection of songs from films, series and video games that address the theme of the magical and the fantastic. Some examples? The Harry Potter soundtrack written by John Williams, the music by Lorne Balfe for the BBC/HBO series His Dark Materials, the song Breath of Life by Florence and the Machine for the film Snow White and the Huntsman, the famous theme by Ramin Djawadi for Game of Thrones or even the musical suite from the series Netflix The Witcher written by Sonya Belousova together with Giona Ostinelli from Ticino. / "Larte magica è quella che ci restituisce il meraviglioso al cuore della vita quotidiana": così si esprimeva lo scrittore Andre Breton e - ringraziando il padre del surrealismo per la citazione e lo spunto - è proprio alla dimensione del magico che si rivolge la puntata di Paganini di domenica 5 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1.Il "Livermore Sciò" - con protagonista Davide Livermore, oggi acclamato regista operistico - è stata una delle produzioni seriali più divertenti e argute del settore musicale RSI. Nellepisodio intitolato "Musica magica" si alternavano, accanto allistrionico padrone di casa, lOrchestra del Teatro Regio di Torino diretta da Carlo Boccadoro, un gruppo di madrigalisti, i musicisti Oliviero Giovannoni e Diego Fasolis.Sorcellerie - letteralmente: stregoneria - è invece un recente spettacolo francese che vede protagonisti il duo di pianiste Jatekok (con opere di Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns e Paul Dukas) e due mimi/maghi impegnati in un suggestivo teatro dombre.Fantasymphony è infine limmaginifico programma sinfonico della Danish National Symphony Orchestra diretta da Christian Schumann che - con il sottotitolo «un concerto di magia e fuoco» - propone una selezione di brani da film, serie e videogiochi che affrontano il tema del magico e del fantastico. Alcuni esempi? La colonna sonora di Harry Potter scritta da John Williams, le musiche di Lorne Balfe per la serie BBC/HBO His Dark Materials - Queste oscure materie, il brano Breath of Life di Florence and the Machine per il film Biancaneve e il cacciatore, il celebre tema di Ramin Djawadi per Game of Thrones o ancora la Suite musicale dalla serie Netflix The Witcher scritta da Sonya Belousova assieme al ticinese Giona Ostinelli.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Every year tens of thousands of bicycles, especially e-bikes, are stolen in Switzerland. In 2024, over 50 thousand thefts were reported and insurance damages exceeded eighty million francs. But where do the stolen bikes end up? Who buys them? And who are these tireless bicycle thieves? / Ogni anno in Svizzera vengono rubate decine di migliaia di biciclette, e-bike soprattutto. Nel 2024 sono stati denunciati oltre 50mila furti e i danni assicurativi hanno superato gli ottanta milioni di franchi. Ma dove vanno a finire le bici rubate? Chi le compera? E chi sono questi infaticabili ladri di biciclette?

programme.title: Treasures of the World - Ferrara / Tesori del Mondo - Ferrara
programme.desc: Let's protect them. Let's not lose them. Let's get to know them. A series that punctuates the RSI schedule introduces us to the great treasures of the planet that hosts us. Ferrara (Fràra in Ferrarese) is a city of 134,636 inhabitants in Emilia-Romagna, capital of the province of the same name. Located in the lower Emilian plain, the city stands on the banks of the Po di Volano which delimits the border between the ancient city south of the walls with the new contemporary settlements. Ferrara enjoyed an important golden age when in the late Middle Ages and the Renaissance under the government of the Este family it was transformed into an artistic center of important importance not only in Italy but also in Europe, hosting artists such as Titian, George Gordon Byron, Ludovico Ariosto, Niccolò Copernicus, Andrea Mantegna and Torquato Tasso. Towards the end of the Middle Ages and the beginning of the Renaissance, the most important urban planning in history was implemented in Ferrara, the Addizione Erculea, the first example of reasoned planning of urban spaces, commissioned by Duke Ercole I d'Este (from whom it takes its name) and implemented by the architect Biagio Rossetti. / Proteggiamoli. Non perdiamoli. Conosciamoli. Una serie che punteggia il palinsesto RSI ci fa conoscere i grandi tesori del pianeta che ci ospita. Ferrara (Fràra in ferrarese) è una città di 134.636 abitanti dellEmilia-Romagna, capoluogo dellomonima provincia. Situata nella bassa pianura emiliana, la città sorge sulle sponde del Po di Volano che delimita il confine fra la città antica a sud delle mura con i nuovi insediamenti contemporanei. Ferrara gode di un importante periodo aureo quando nel basso medioevo e nel Rinascimento sotto il governo della famiglia degli Este viene trasformata in un centro artistico di importante rilevanza non solo italiano ma anche europeo, arrivando ad ospitare artisti come Tiziano, George Gordon Byron, Ludovico Ariosto, Niccolò Copernico, Andrea Mantegna e Torquato Tasso. Verso la fine del Medioevo e linizio del Rinascimento a Ferrara venne attuata la più importante progettazione urbanistica della storia, lAddizione Erculea, il primo esempio di pianificazione ragionata di spazi urbani, voluta dal duca Ercole I dEste (da cui prende il nome) ed attuata dallarchitetto Biagio Rossetti.

programme.title: Sister Boniface's investigations / Le indagini di Sister Boniface
programme.desc: England, 1960s. Sister Boniface, Catholic nun and winemaker at the St. Vincent convent, is a forensic scientist who collaborates in local police investigations. / Inghilterra, anni 60. Sister Boniface, suora cattolica e enologa al convento St. Vincent è una scienziata forense che collabora nelle indagini della polizia locale.

programme.title: The great thaw / Il grande disgelo
programme.desc: WHILE / DOK

programme.title: Tiny House - Small houses for living large / Tiny House - Piccole case per vivere in grande
programme.desc: John Weisbarth and Zack Giffin, renovation experts, travel across America to show us tiny homes with multifunctional, innovative furnishings and equipped with every comfort. / John Weisbarth e Zack Giffin esperti in ristrutturazione viaggiano attraverso lAmerica per mostrarci case minuscole con arredi multifunzione, innovative e dotate di ogni comfort.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Jessica, at the Rojam Records headquarters, watches the recording of a video clip. The music is deafening, but a shot is heard: one of the partners has been killed. / Jessica, nella sede della Rojam Records, assiste alla registrazione di un video clip. La musica e assordante, ma si ode uno sparo: uno dei soci e stato ucciso.

programme.title: Psych / Psych
programme.desc: Gus has to look after his girlfriend's son, Maximus, for a day, but as soon as a harmless trip to the circus turns into a lethal adventure, his relationship is in serious danger. / Gus deve badare per un giorno al figlio della fidanzata, Maximus, ma appena una innocua capata al circo si tramuta in un avventura letale la sua relazione rischia grosso.

programme.title: Padre Brown / Padre Brown
programme.desc: Father Brown is the parish priest of St. Mary's Catholic Church, thanks to his intuition and his passion for detective stories, as well as being the spiritual reference of the inhabitants of the small village, he manages to solve the most complex crimes together with the local police who are not always enthusiastic about his interference. / Padre Brown è il parroco della Chiesa cattolica di St. Mary, grazie al suo intuito e alla sua passione per i gialli, oltre a essere il riferimento spirituale degli abitanti del piccolo villaggio, riesce a risolvere i crimini più complessi insieme alle forze dellordine locali che non sempre sono entusiaste della sua interferenza.

programme.title: Telescuard / Telesguard
programme.desc: Current affairs from GrisonsActulitad del Grischun / Attualità dei GrigioniActulitad del Grischun

programme.title: basic / basik
programme.desc: Even if the art market is not in good shape, having lost 12% in 2024, there is still a field of possibilities, and Switzerland plays a central role in it. Art Basel wonderfully embodies this ambivalence between luxury, excess, but also many artists left behind... The basik investigation. / Meme si le marche de l’art n’est pas au beau fixe, ayant perdu 12% en 2024, il reste encore un terrain de tous les possibles, et la Suisse y joue un rôle central. Art Basel incarne à merveille cette ambivalence entre luxe, demesure, mais aussi de nombreux artistes laisses sur le carreau… L’enquete de basik.

programme.title: Bye bye bourbine / Ciao ciao bourbine
programme.desc: A crazy referendum plunges Switzerland into a state of emergency. By accepting the “No Bilangue” initiative, there should only be one national language: French. Many German-speaking Swiss are therefore in crisis. Including Walter Egli, 56, who works for the federal police and must ensure that the transition to monolingualism is done correctly. / Un referendum fou plonge la Suisse dans letat durgence. En acceptant linitiative «No Bilangue», il ne devrait plus y avoir quune seule langue nationale : le français. De nombreux Suisses alemaniques sont donc en crise. Dont Walter Egli, 56 ans, qui travaille pour la police federale et doit veiller à ce que le passage au monolinguisme se fasse correctement.

programme.title: House of the Dragon / House of the Dragon
programme.sub-title: Reine d’un jour, reine de toujours
programme.desc: Daemon has a new vision of the future that leads him to renounce his claims to the throne and pledge allegiance to Rhaenyra. At the sight of the seven dragons of the Blacks, Aemon fled Dragonstone. Furious, he burned Pointe-Vive and all its inhabitants. Rhaenyra then realizes that trouble is inevitable... / Daemon a une nouvelle vision de lavenir qui lamène à renoncer à ses pretentions au trône et à preter allegeance à Rhaenyra. A la vue des sept dragons des Noirs, Aemon fuit Peyredragon. Furieux, il incendie Pointe-Vive et tous ses habitants. Rhaenyra prend alors conscience que la guère est inevitable...

programme.title: Our House / Our House
programme.desc: Fiona tries to recover the money from the sale of her house, but the notary tells her that the funds have already been transferred. Toby shows up at her house and seems very eager to find Bram. / Fiona essaie de recuperer l’argent de la vente de sa maison, mais le notaire lui annonce que les fonds ont dejà ete transferes. Toby debarque chez elle et semble très presse de retrouver Bram.

programme.title: Our House / Our House
programme.desc: Fiona realizes that Toby is not the man she thought and that he set up the scam with Bram. He shows her his true face and threatens to harm her children if she does not find the money. / Fiona se rend compte que Toby n’est pas l’homme qu’elle croyait et qu’il a monte l’escroquerie avec Bram. Il lui montre son vrai visage et la menace de s’en prendre à ses enfants si elle ne retrouve pas l’argent.

programme.desc: In turn, presenters go out into the field to discover a place that is making the news. These information adventurers guide viewers through vineyards, alleys or avenues to make them admire a new corner of Switzerland. / Tour à tour, des presentateurs partent sur le terrain à la decouverte dun lieu qui fait lactualite. programme.title: Switzerland seen from the sky / La suisse vue du ciel
programme.desc: A documentary series that explores Switzerland from the sky. / Une serie documentaire qui part à la decouverte de la Suisse vue du ciel.

programme.title: Narwhal or almost / Narval ou presque
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. / When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper go in search of the plant they believe will cure her. Meanwhile, Pixie wonders if she can be cured! / Leroy doit apprendre à lâcher prise lorsque son amie chenille se transforme en papillon. / Lorsque Pixie perd son etincelle, Kelp et Juniper partent à la recherche de la plante qui, selon eux, la guerira. Pendant ce temps, Pixie se demande si elle peut etre guerie !

programme.title: The Thieves / Les Chapardeurs
programme.desc: Without listening to Tom's advice, Arrietty brings a bath bomb home, unintentionally causing a foam accident... which spreads into the Atrium! The atmosphere being unbreathable, the Clocks must temporarily settle in with the Davenports, in the dolls' house in the storage room. But now Marie decides to give the doll's house to her little neighbor. What will become of the Davenports? Arrietty tries to save the day, but to do so she will need Tom's help. / Sans ecouter les conseils de Tom, Arrietty rapporte une bombe de bain chez elle, causant involontairement un accident de mousse… qui se repand jusque dans l’Atrium ! L’atmosphère etant irrespirable, les Clock doivent s’installer temporairement chez les Davenport, dans la maison de poupees du debarras. Mais voilà que Marie decide de donner la maison de poupees à sa petite voisine. Que vont devenir les Davenport ? Arrietty tente de sauver la situation, mais pour cela, elle aura besoin de l’aide de Tom.

programme.title: The Thieves / Les Chapardeurs
programme.desc: In Olowi, the Thieves must remain hidden because that day the Zumains are even more monstrous than usual... This is what is said among the Thieves. Of course, Arrietty would like to compare her community's beliefs about this special day with what she knows about her friend Tom, in whom she trusts. But when Tom, disguised as Frankenstein, has fun scaring Arrietty, the Thief's certainties waver... Fortunately, her friendship for Tom is stronger. She will understand the meaning of the festival that the Zumains call “Halloween”… but her absence will worry her entire community, who believe she is in danger. / A Olowi, les Chapardeurs doivent rester caches car ce jour-là les Zumains sont encore plus monstrueux que d’habitude… C’est ce qui se raconte chez les Chapardeurs. Bien sûr, Arrietty voudrait confronter les croyances de sa communaute sur ce jour special avec ce qu’elle connaît de son ami Tom, en qui elle a toute confiance. Mais quand Tom, deguise en Frankenstein, s’amuse à faire peur à Arrietty, les certitudes de la Chapardeuse vacillent… Heureusement, son amitie pour Tom est plus forte. Elle va comprendre le sens de la fete que les Zumains nomment « Halloween »… mais son absence va inquieter toute sa communaute, qui la croit en danger.

programme.title: Mystery Lane / Mystery Lane
programme.desc: After his friend Tommy was bitten by a strange bat that appeared during their dinner at the park, Red the alley cat can't believe his eyes: his friend has become a... vampire! / Après que son ami Tommy sest fait mordre par une etrange chauve-souris qui a surgit pendant leur diner au parc, Red le chat de gouttière nen croit pas ses yeux : son ami est devenu un... vampire !

programme.title: Big Blue / Big Blue
programme.desc: Billie Biscotti is upset because the crew has to go on a mission and no one can play pirates with her anymore. By looking for someone else to play with, Billie Biscotti will help the crew discover why the seabed is cracking. / Billie Biscotti est contrariee parce que l’equipage doit partir en mission et que personne ne peut plus jouer aux pirates avec elle. En cherchant quelqu’un d’autre avec qui jouer, Billie Biscotti permettra à l’equipage de decouvrir pourquoi le fond marin se fissure.

programme.title: Big Blue / Big Blue
programme.desc: Lemo accidentally sends Lettie's diary to HQ instead of his logbook, so Lemo tries to find it before it's too late, but nothing goes as planned and a solution must be found. / Lemo envoie accidentellement au QG le journal de Lettie au lieu de son carnet de bord, cest pourquoi Lemo tente de le retrouver avant quil ne soit trop tard, mais rien ne se passe comme prevu et une solution doit etre mise au point.

programme.title: Big Blue / Big Blue
programme.desc: When Lettie becomes frustrated with the team's work ethic, she decides she would be better off doing everything herself, but soon she realizes that doing everything alone is too difficult and intense. / Lorsque Lettie est frustree par lethique de travail de lequipe, elle decide quelle ferait mieux de tout faire elle-meme, mais très vite, elle se rend compte que tout faire tout seul pour saverer trop difficile et intense.

programme.title: Abominable and the invisible city / Abominable et la cite invisible
programme.sub-title: Lili, la plus grande fan de Yi
programme.desc: While Everest goes through the typical stages of an adolescent crisis (not wanting to brush his teeth or clean his room...), the arrival of Lili, an adorable little nine-year-old girl totally obsessed with Yi, Everest and the activities of the Brigade, offers a welcome distraction. / Alors quEverest traverse les etapes typiques dune crise dadolescence (ne pas vouloir se brosser les dents ou ranger sa chambre...), larrivee de Lili, une adorable petite fille de neuf ans totalement obsedee par Yi, Everest et les activites de la Brigade, offre une distraction bienvenue.

programme.title: Abominable and the invisible city / Abominable et la cite invisible
programme.desc: Superstar mania sets in when the famous creature Qilin, bringer of prosperity, appears in front of Yi's building. Trying to protect Qilin from the crowds of people hoping for their wishes to be granted, the team is distraught when they lose track of the creature. Their dismay increases when they discover that this "Qilin" is not at all a mythical creature of good omen, but an evil robot sent by a mysterious character. / La manie de la superstar sinstalle lorsque la celèbre creature Qilin, porteuse de prosperite, apparaît devant limmeuble de Yi. En essayant de proteger Qilin de la foule de gens qui espèrent que leurs vœux seront exauces, lequipe est desemparee lorsquelle perd la trace de la creature. Leur desarroi saccroît lorsquils decouvrent que ce "Qilin" nest pas du tout une creature mythique de bon augure, mais un robot malfaisant envoye par un mysterieux personnage.

programme.title: Welcome to the Louds / Bienvenue chez les Loud
programme.sub-title: Querelles intestines / Le bal de laccuse
programme.desc: Lily is no longer wise. Mom and Dad think it's because of his new friends at preschool. / The Royal News team strives to exonerate Rusty, wrongly excluded from college. / Lily nest plus sage. Maman et papa pensent que cest à cause de ses nouveaux amis à la maternelle. / Lequipe de Royal News se demène pour innocenter Rusty, exclu à tort du collège.

programme.title: Welcome to the Mouche / Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: Louis and BA's big brother - who is also called Louis! - returns to live with his parents. But his presence quickly becomes unbearable: he devours all the provisions and breaks everything without wanting to... Louis and BA decide to do everything to ensure that he returns where he came from. / Le grand frère de Louis et BA - qui sappelle aussi Louis !- revient vivre chez ses parents.Mais sa presence devient vite insupportable : il devore toutes les provisions et casse tout sans le vouloir... Louis et BA decident de tout faire pour quil retourne doù il vient.

programme.title: Welcome to the Mouche / Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: Louis and Abacus encounter a bug while going to get the latest issue of Arachno-Mouche. When Louis understands that you can use his stench to get what you want, he doesn't hesitate to encourage Chuck to use it whenever he wants! / Louis et Abacus rencontrent une punaise en allant chercher le dernier numero dArachno-Mouche. Quand Louis comprend quon peut utiliser sa puanteur pour obtenir ce que lon veut, il ne se gene pas pour encourager Chuck à lutiliser quand bon lui semble !

programme.title: What's the weather like? / Quel temps fait-il ?
programme.desc: News magazine on the weather in Switzerland and the various news headlines. / Magazine dinfo sur le temps quil fait en Suisse et sur les differents titres de lactualite.

programme.title: Magnum / Magnum
programme.desc: Magnum seeks to exonerate a man accused of murder, but wakes up one morning in the heart of the 1930s, while Rick and Higgins, in the present, are worried about his behavior... / Magnum cherche à innocenter un homme accuse de meurtre, mais se reveille un beau matin en plein coeur des annees 30, tandis que Rick et Higgins, dans le present, sinquiètent de son comportement...

programme.title: Magnum / Magnum
programme.desc: An accident during a fencing match sees Higgins accused of murder. Magnum will do everything to save him... / Un accident survenu lors dun combat descrime voit Higgins se faire accuser de meurtre. Magnum va tout faire pour le sauver...

programme.title: Top models / Top models
programme.desc: Drama, glitz and glamor in the heart of Los Angeles. / Drames, paillettes et glamour au coeur de Los Angeles.

programme.title: More beautiful life, even more beautiful / Plus belle la vie, encore plus belle
programme.desc: Life has slowly taken a new start in the Basket. Indeed, a year after the collapse of the Mistral district, its former inhabitants had to start from scratch in a completely new district. New neighbors, new places and new habits. Everyone is very happy to get together for the inauguration of Thomas, Kilian and Barbara’s new bar. / La vie a doucement pris un nouveau depart dans le Panier. En effet, un an après l’effondrement du quartier du Mistral, ses anciens habitants ont dû repartir à zero dans un tout nouveau quartier. Nouveaux voisins, nouveaux lieux et nouvelles habitudes. Tout le monde est d’ailleurs très heureux de se retrouver pour l’inauguration du nouveau bar de Thomas, Kilian et Barbara.

programme.title: Tomorrow belongs to us / Demain nous appartient
programme.desc: The series “Tomorrow Belongs to Us” takes place in Sète, a city on the Mediterranean Sea. You will be able to follow the daily lives of several families and inhabitants of this city, where stories of love and friendship but also lies, betrayals or even heavy family secrets mingle... programme.desc: The little wolves are delighted to go to the cinema for the first time with Oua-Oua, who teaches them that they must respect three rules so that everyone enjoys the experience: stay silent, do not move or kick the chair in front and go to the toilet before the film starts. The little wolves quickly learn that the short films they enjoy are only trailers before the film begins. Let's hope that the little wolves will manage to stay focused in order to watch the film until the end credits and earn their cinema badge. / Les ptits loups sont ravis daller au cinema pour la première fois avec Oua-Oua, qui leur apprend quil faut respecter trois règles pour que tout le monde profite de lexperience : rester silencieux, ne pas remuer ni donner de coups de pied au fauteuil qui se trouve devant et aller aux toilettes avant le debut du film. Les ptits loups apprennent rapidement que les courts-metrages quils apprecient ne sont que des bandes-annonces avant le debut du film. Esperons que les ptits loups parviendront à rester concentres afin de regarder le film jusquau generique de fin et de gagner leur badge cinema.

programme.title: He, No-No / He, Oua-Oua
programme.desc: The Oua-Oua dog who runs the Squirrel Club, an extracurricular activity center, solves problems in a good mood with his group of friends. / Le chien Oua-Oua qui anime le Club des Ecureuils, un centre dactivites extrascolaires, règle les problèmes, dans la bonne humeur avec sa bande damis.

programme.title: He, No-No / He, Oua-Oua
programme.desc: Little wolves discover atoms, molecules and cells to better understand sizes when they try to sort a row of objects from smallest to largest. / Les ptits loups decouvrent les atomes, les molecules et les cellules pour mieux comprendre les tailles lorsquils essaient de trier une rangee dobjets du plus petit au plus grand.

programme.title: Millie the Magnificent / Millie la Magnifique
programme.desc: When Ben is disappointed at missing his plane flight with his grandfather, Mr. Lin, Millie and Maya do everything in their power to give him the most magnificent flight in the garden by transforming the swing into a plane. Calling all passengers, now is the time to board! Ben climbs in and is transported on an exciting and imaginative adventure, thanks to the girls, and they land on a beautiful island. / Quand Ben est deçu de manquer son vol d’avion avec son grand-père, M. Lin, Millie et Maya font tout en leur pouvoir pour lui offrir le vol le plus magnifique dans le jardin en transformant la balançoire en avion. Appel à tous les passagers, c’est maintenant le moment d’embarquer! Ben monte et est transporte dans une aventure excitante et imaginative, grâce aux filles, et ils atterrissent sur une île magnifique.

programme.title: Millie the Magnificent / Millie la Magnifique
programme.desc: When Millie wants to help Maya find a new home for her old toys, the kids end up creating their own sidewalk toy store. When no one comes to their kiosk to take the toys, the girls have the idea of ​​creating a life-size game on the sidewalk to guide potential customers straight to them. / Quand Millie veut aider Maya à trouver un nouveau chez-soi à ses vieux jouets, les enfants finissent par creer leur propre magasin de jouets sur le trottoir. Quand personne ne se presente à leur kiosque pour prendre les jouets, les filles ont l’idee de creer un jeu grandeur nature sur le trottoir pour guider les clients potentiels droit vers elles.

programme.title: Millie the Magnificent / Millie la Magnifique
programme.desc: When Mom hears the cry of a cricket somewhere in the house, Millie and Maya set out to look for it, like great wildlife explorers. Soon, they discover the little locust hiding under Mom's bed and with a spark of creative genius, Millie and Maya create their own tool to save the little locust. / Quand maman entend le cri-cri d’un criquet quelque part dans la maison, Millie et Maya se mettent à sa recherche, telles de grandes exploratrices de la faune sauvage. Rapidement, elles decouvrent le petit criquet cache sous le lit de maman et avec une etincelle de genie creative, Millie et Maya creent leur propre outil pour sauver le petit criquet.

programme.title: Audrey's refuge / Le refuge dAudrey
programme.desc: Audrey and Tommy are about to go on a school trip, but Audrey doesn't want to leave Jack and the Shelter at all. When Jack falls ill and catches a cold, it's the perfect alibi to stay: Jack needs her... Audrey embarks on a pampering mission that ends short when Jack recovers. How far will Audrey go to miss the school trip? / Audrey et Tommy sappretent à partir en voyage scolaire, mais Audrey na pas du tout envie de quitter Jack et le Refuge. Quand Jack tombe malade et attrape un rhume, cest lalibi parfait pour rester : Jack a besoin delle... Audrey se lance dans une mission dorlotage qui tourne court quand Jack se retablit. Jusquoù Audrey ira-t-elle pour rater le voyage scolaire ?

programme.title: Audrey's refuge / Le refuge dAudrey
programme.desc: While Tommy digs a hole in the plain, he discovers a dinosaur bone! In order not to disturb the animals of the plain during the excavations, the giraffes, saigas and Przewalski's horse are relocated to the greenhouse. The kids are tasked with caring for them but instead of helping, Tommy is obsessed with dinosaur bones. Audrey thinks that Tommy is no longer interested in animals, or in her. Will Tommy stop caring for animals for good? Is their friendship in danger? / Alors que Tommy creuse un trou dans la plaine, il decouvre un os de dinosaure ! Afin de ne pas perturber les animaux de la plaine durant les fouilles, les girafes, les saïgas et le cheval de Przewalski sont relocalises dans la serre. Les enfants sont charges de soccuper deux mais au lieu d’aider, Tommy est obsede par les os de dinosaure. Audrey pense que Tommy ne sinteresse plus aux animaux, ni à elle. Tommy va-t-il arreter de soccuper des animaux pour de bon ? Leur amitie est-elle en danger?

programme.title: Audrey's refuge / Le refuge dAudrey
programme.desc: Audrey and her parents go away to rescue an animal, and Tommy finds himself spending the day alone with Jack. Tommy is delighted, but the gorilla quickly gets bored of the activities he offers him. Tommy then decides to let Jack choose their activities. But Tommy wants to prove to Jack so much that he can be as funny as Audrey, that he says yes to everything the gorilla wants to do... even when Jack decides to enter the house! / Audrey et ses parents sabsentent pour aller secourir un animal, et Tommy se retrouve à passer la journee seul avec Jack. Tommy est ravi, mais le gorille sennuie vite des activites quil lui propose. Tommy decide alors de laisser Jack choisir leurs activites. Mais Tommy veut tellement prouver à Jack quil peut etre aussi drôle quAudrey, quil dit oui à tout ce que veut faire le gorille... meme quand Jack decide d’entrer dans la maison !

programme.title: Modern Family / Modern Family
programme.desc: Claire takes up her position as director in the family business. Jay takes a flying lesson and takes Cameron into his confidence. Haley and Alex go to Sanjay's house so Alex can move on for good. / Claire prend ses fonctions de directrice dans lentreprise familiale. Jay prend, lui, une leçon de pilotage et met Cameron dans la confidence. Haley et Alex se rendent chez Sanjay pour quAlex puisse tourner definitivement la page.

programme.title: Magnum / Magnum
programme.desc: A young man needs urgent surgery to remove the bullet lodged in his chest, but he is nowhere to be found. Ethan (Jay Ali) asks Magnum and Higgins to find him before it's too late. At the same time, TC advises a young person who wishes to join the army. / Un jeune homme doit etre opere de toute urgence pour retirer la balle logee dans sa poitrine, mais il est introuvable. Ethan (Jay Ali) demande à Magnum et Higgins de le retrouver avant quil ne soit trop tard. Dans le meme temps, TC conseille un jeune qui souhaite sengager dans larmee.

programme.title: Here it all begins / Ici tout commence
programme.desc: Filmed in the Camargue, “Here it all begins” is the story of a dynasty of great chefs. Viewers will immerse themselves in the life of a school that will train the future big names in gastronomy. Ready for a new plot? / Tourne en Camargue, "Ici tout commence" est lhistoire d’une dynastie de grands chefs. Les telespectateurs plongeront dans la vie d’une ecole qui formera les futurs grands noms de la gastronomie. Pret(s) pour une nouvelle intrigue ?

programme.title: This is my question / Cest ma question
programme.desc: A general culture game reflects the diversity and passions of the French-speaking people. It is in fact the public, represented on the set by a wall of images, which will question the duo candidates in the running. Everyone can ask a question related to their profession, their region or their centers of interest. Faced with a multitude of portraits, who to choose? A game presented by Sebastien Pasche / Un jeu de culture generale reflète la diversite et les passions des Romands. Cest en effet le public, represente sur le plateau par un mur dimages, qui interrogera les candidats duo en lice. Chacun peut poser une question en relation avec son metier, sa region ou ses centres dinterets. Face à une multitude de portraits, qui choisir ? Un jeu presente par Sebastien pasche

programme.title: Doc Nature / Doc Nature
programme.desc: In the heart of the Alps, an animal has made this ecosystem its kingdom: the ibex. A goat and his herd wage a fierce struggle to survive in a changing environment, as majestic as it is pitiful. Will their instinct be enough to save them? / Au cœur des Alpes, un animal a fait de cet ecosystème son royaume: le bouquetin. programme.title: Cinema classics / Les classiques du cinema
programme.desc: Dominique appears at the assizes for the murder of her lover, Gilbert, fiancée of his sister Annie. She must fight against the lawyer, who tries to tarnish, against her will, Gilbert's memory, and against the prosecutor, who tries to make her look like a heartless monster in the eyes of the jury. / Dominique comparaît aux assises pour le meurtre de son amant, Gilbert, fiance de sa soeur Annie. Elle doit se battre contre lavocat, qui tente de ternir, contre son gre, la memoire de Gilbert, et contre le procureur, qui essaie de la faire passer pour un monstre sans coeur aux yeux du jury.

programme.desc: They (and they) are dedicated, empathetic, present in any circumstance... Ce documentaire rend hommage aux femmes et aux hommes qui exercent l’un des plus beaux metiers au monde. Il retrace leur histoire à travers les epoques et met en lumière leurs revendications legitimes.

programme.title: Switzerland on stage / Suisse en scène
programme.desc: Polymorphic artist (visual artist, photographer, director, musician, editor, writer) Augustin Rebetez sees his works as so many injections of doses of art intended to regenerate us and make us see differently a world which, according to him, is going on its head. programme.title: Signs / Signes
programme.desc: Signes found a rare RTS archive, filmed in 1967 at the Moudon school for the deaf. In the images, an entire class of deaf students, all wearing headphones. At that time, there was no question of sign language at school. Deaf students were re-educated to speech, by all means possible. Carole Prekel went to meet some former students present in the images and rekindled a lot of emotions. At the end of the program, the section on the history of the deaf will tell us how an American deaf artist contributed to the return of sign language in Europe. / Signes a retrouve une archive rare de la RTS, tournee en 1967 à l’ecole des sourds de Moudon. Sur les images, une classe entière d’elèves sourds, tous equipes de casques sur les oreilles. A cette epoque, il n’etait pas question de langue des signes à l’ecole. Les elèves sourds etaient reeduques à la parole, par tous les moyens possibles. Carole Prekel est allee à la rencontre de quelques anciens elèves presents sur les images et a ravive beaucoup d’emotions.En fin d’emission, la rubrique sur l’histoire des sourds nous racontera comment un artiste sourd americain a contribue au retour de la langue des signes en Europe.

programme.title: A word to the wise / A bon entendeur
programme.desc: Cutting, cooking, unmolding... Our daily actions in the kitchen are made easier by a multitude of modern utensils. But behind their practicality sometimes lie composite materials with little-known effects on our health. What are the risks associated with microplastics and PFAS found in our cutting boards, our pans or our spatulas? Can they migrate into our food? Scientific explanations and practical advice, in the show A bon oreille, Tuesday at 8:10 p.m. on RTS1 / Couper, cuire, demouler… Nos gestes du quotidien en cuisine sont facilites par une multitude d’ustensiles modernes. Mais derrière leur praticite se cachent parfois des materiaux composites aux effets meconnus sur notre sante. Quels sont les risques lies aux microplastiques, aux PFAS qu’on retrouve dans nos planches à decouper, nos poeles ou nos spatules ? Peuvent-ils migrer dans nos aliments ? Explications scientifiques et conseils pratiques, dans l’emission A bon entendeur, mardi à 20h10 sur RTS1

programme.title: Mama For Ever / Mama For Ever
programme.sub-title: Enfant, j’ai connu une dizaine de familles d’accueil
programme.desc: As a child, Matthew grew up with a mother addicted to cannabis and an absent father. When things were too bad at home, he would go back and forth to his grandparents. At the age of 7, the situation deteriorated sharply and he was placed in a foster family. Until he turns 18, he will experience around ten host families. Even if in some of these homes cohabitation went well, these substitute families never compensated for the lack of love from his biological parents. Today Matthew is a resilient young adult. Despite everything, he managed to gain self-confidence and live life to the fullest. Sandrine is the mother of two biological children. Barely married, with her husband, they decided to adopt 3 other children. In recent years, they have even taken the step of becoming a host family. A little boy has come to complete the family home. Regardless of their status, these 6 children have the same place in Sandrine's heart. Matthew and Sandrine do not know each other. Mama Forever instigated the meeting. / Petit, Matthew a grandi avec une maman accro au cannabis et un père absent. Lorsque ça allait trop mal à la maison, il faisait des allers-retours chez ses grands-parents. A 7 ans, la situation se degrade fortement, il est place en famille d’accueil. Jusqu’à ses 18 ans, il connaitra une dizaine de familles d’accueil. Meme si dans certains de ces foyers la cohabitation s’est bien passee, ces familles de substitution n’ont jamais compense le manque d’amour de ses parents biologiques. Aujourd’hui Matthew est un jeune adulte resilient. Il a malgre tout reussi à prendre confiance en lui et à croquer la vie à pleines dents. Sandrine, elle, est la maman de deux enfants biologiques. A peine maries, avec son mari, ils decident d’adopter 3 autres enfants. Depuis quelques annees, ils ont meme fait le pas de devenir famille d’accueil. Un petit garçon est venu completer le foyer familial. Peu importe leur statut, ces 6 enfants ont la meme place dans le cœur de Sandrine. Matthew et Sandrine ne se connaissent pas. Mama Forever a provoque la rencontre.

programme.title: Small disorders in the family / Petits desordres en famille
programme.desc: Lisa, 16, is an excellent student whose parents hope she will have a more beautiful and easier life than theirs. But Lisa is pregnant with Osman, a young Turkish immigrant and does not want to hear about abortion. Everything will therefore be played out between Osman and Lisa, but also between the parents of the two lovebirds who all have a lot to learn from each other. / Lisa, 16 ans, est une excellente elève dont les parents espèrent quelle aura une vie plus belle et facile que ne fût la leur. Mais Lisa est enceinte dOsman, un jeune immigre turc et ne veut pas entendre parler davortement. Tout se jouera donc entre Osman et Lisa, mais aussi entre les parents des deux tourtereaux qui ont tous beaucoup à appprendre les uns des autres.

programme.title: A word to the wise / A bon entendeur
programme.desc: Oyster mushrooms, lion's mane or shiitake mushrooms, these so-called “noble” mushrooms are now also produced in Switzerland. We will meet several producers who have launched into this culture to satisfy ever-increasing consumers. Mushrooms that are now also found in drinks that promise iron health and a boost to the brain. Could so-called “adaptogenic” mushrooms added to breakfast drinks be the new magic potion? Or just a marketing stunt? A good listener invites you on a mycological journey and will sort the true from the false. Report in A good hearer on RTS 1, at 8:10 p.m. / Pleurotes, crinières de lion ou shiitakes, ces champignons dits «nobles» sont desormais produits aussi en Suisse. Nous irons à la rencontre de plusieurs producteurs qui se sont lances dans cette culture pour de satisfaire des consommateurs toujours plus nombreux. Des champignons qui s’invitent desormais aussi dans des boissons qui promettent une sante de fer et un cerveaux booste. Des champignons dits "adaptogènes" ajoutes dans des boissons de petit-dejeuner seraient-ils la nouvelle potion magique? Ou simplement un coup marketing? A bon entendeur vous invite à un voyage mycologique et triera le vrai du faux. Reportage dans A bon entendeur sur RTS 1, à 20h10.

programme.title: Objective World / Objectif Monde
programme.desc: A year ago, Donald Trump was re-elected president of the United States. Better prepared than at the start of his first mandate, he will very quickly put his team in place and introduce customs duties. It also reduces the American contribution to several international organizations and limits subsidies in certain sectors of research and in universities. In foreign policy, he tried to end the conflict in Ukraine by meeting Vladimir Putin in Alaska. He claims to have “ended 7 wars”. 8th, since he obtained the return of the last Israeli hostages from Gaza, return accompanied by a ceasefire, all accompanied by a peace plan supported by the Arab countries. Could the Trump method be bearing fruit? Are his opponents in the United States silent or just inaudible? How does the American population react to the attacks on science but also to the expulsion campaign against migrants? After new restrictions against the media, is freedom of information threatened? Questions asked on Thursday October 23 in Objectif Monde which will be broadcast live on TV5MONDE, in Paris. The show will also be broadcast on October 26 on RTBF3 and October 29 on RTS2. / Il y a un an, Donald Trump est reelu president des Etats-Unis. Mieux prepare qu’au debut de son premier mandat, il va très vite mettre en place son equipe et instaurer des droits de douane. Il reduit aussi la contribution americaine à plusieurs organisations internationales et limite les subventions dans certains secteurs de la recherche et dans les universites. En politique etrangère, il tente de mettre fin au conflit en Ukraine en rencontrant Vladimir Poutine en Alaska. Il affirme avoir “mis fin à 7 guerres”. 8 meme, depuis qu’il a obtenu le retour des derniers otages israeliens de Gaza, retour assorti d’un cessez-le-feu, le tout accompagne d’un plan de paix soutenu par les pays arabes. La methode Trump serait-elle en train de porter ses fruits ? Ses opposants aux Etats-Unis sont-ils muets ou juste inaudibles ? Comment reagit la population americaine aux attaques contre la science mais aussi à la campagne dexpulsion contre les migrants ? Après de nouvelles restrictions contre les medias, la liberte d’informer est-elle menacee ? Questions posees le jeudi 23 octobre dans Objectif Monde qui sera realisee en direct à TV5MONDE, à Paris. L’emission sera egalement diffusee le 26 octobre sur la RTBF3 et le 29 octobre sur la RTS2.

programme.title: The three from the pawn shop / Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Rick looks at a set of San Francisco 49ers Super Bowl rings. Then he and Corey inspect a harpoon that is used for hunting in the water. Meanwhile, Chum is offered a pair of 18th century shoe protectors. Rick is also interested in a miniature model of the Trader’s Bank of Canada. / Rick sieht sich einen Satz Super-Bowl-Ringe der San Francisco 49ers an. Dann begutachtet er gemeinsam mit Corey eine Harpune, die zur Jagd im Wasser benutzt wird. Unterdessen wird Chum ein Paar Schuhschutzer aus dem 18. Jahrhundert angeboten. Ausserdem interessiert sich Rick fur ein Miniaturmodell der Trader’s Bank of Canada.

programme.title: The three from the pawn shop / Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Rick is looking at a 1984 Ferrari 308 that he would like to take if he can negotiate the price down. Meanwhile, Corey is offered a telephone-operated music player from the 1930s. Then Rick makes an offer on a cowboy hat that belonged to actor Larry Hagman, known from “Dallas” and “Charming Jeannie.” Chum and Rick are also skeptical as to whether the autograph on a hockey jersey actually comes from Marc-Andre Fleury, the goalkeeper of the Las Vegas Golden Knights, until he himself confirms it to them. / Rick sieht sich einen Ferrari 308 von 1984 an, den er gern mitnehmen wurde, wenn er den Preis herunterhandeln kann. Corey wird unterdessen ein vom Telefon betriebener Musikspieler aus den 1930er-Jahren angeboten. Dann macht Rick ein Angebot fur einen Cowboy-Hut, der dem Schauspieler Larry Hagman gehorte, den man aus „Dallas“ und „Bezaubernde Jeannie“ kennt. Ausserdem sind Chum und Rick skeptisch, ob das Autogramm auf einem Hockey-Trikot tatsachlich von Marc-Andre Fleury stammt, dem Torwart der Las Vegas Golden Knights, bis er selbst es ihnen bestatigt.

programme.title: The three from the pawn shop / Die Drei vom Pfandhaus
programme.desc: Curiosities, historical valuables or just junk: In the Harrison family-run pawn shop in Las Vegas, different objects change hands day after day. Grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey have a trained eye and plenty of experience to recognize real treasures. Even if they don't always agree, their passion for the store always brings them together. / Kuriositaten, historische Wertgegenstande oder einfach nur Schrott: In dem familiengefuhrten Pfandhaus der Harrisons in Las Vegas wechseln tagaus tagein unterschiedliche Objekte ihren Besitzer. GroSSvater Richard, Sohn Rick und Enkel Corey haben ein geschultes Auge und reichlich Erfahrung, um echte Schatze zu erkennen. Auch wenn sie sich nicht immer einig sind - ihre Leidenschaft fur den Laden schweiSSt sie immer wieder zusammen.

programme.title: The aquarium professionals / Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: In this episode, Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer construct an aquarium for a themed hotel in Roxburry, New York. The domicile in question has, among other things, a Fred Feuerstein lounge and an Austin Powers room. However, the owners are particularly proud of their archaeological suite. There you can make yourself comfortable between Egyptian statues and ancient Mayan treasures. And the “aquarium professionals” go one better with their sarcophagus fish tank. / In dieser Episode konstruieren Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer ein Aquarium fur ein Motto-Hotel in Roxburry, New York. Das besagte Domizil verfugt unter anderem uber eine Fred- Feuerstein-Lounge und ein Austin-Powers-Zimmer. Besonders stolz sind die Besitzer jedoch auf ihre Archaologen-Suite. Dort kann man es sich zwischen agyptischen Statuen und alten Maya-Schatzen gemutlich machen. Und die "Aquarium-Profis" setzen mit ihrem Sarkophag-Fischbecken noch einen obendrauf.

programme.title: The aquarium professionals / Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: In this episode, the “Aquarium Professionals” stage a volcanic eruption. Your client, a restaurant owner from Las Vegas, wants a Hawaiian pool. Brett and Wayde construct a breathtaking South Sea landscape for their customer with 400 LEDs and colorful surgeonfish. And then the construction geniuses outdo themselves: their drum cymbal is absolutely awesome. Cardinalfish swim in the bass drum and goldfish cavort in the tom-toms. / Die „Aquarium-Profis“ inszenieren in dieser Episode einen Vulkanausbruch. Ihr Auftraggeber, ein Restaurantbesitzer aus Las Vegas, wunscht sich ein Hawaii-Becken. Brett und Wayde konstruieren ihrem Kunden eine atemberaubende Sudseelandschaft mit 400 LEDs und farbenprachtigen Doktorfischen auf den Leib. Und anschlieSSend ubertreffen sich die Konstruktionsgenies selbst: Ihr Schlagzeug-Becken ist der absolute Oberhammer. In der Bassdrum schwimmen Kardinalbarsche, und in den Tomtoms tummeln sich Goldfische.

programme.title: The last Knight Templar / Der letzte Tempelritter
programme.desc: The two Templar Knights Behmen von Bleibruck and Felson desert and return to Europe. There they are recognized and arrested. To avoid punishment, they accept a sensitive assignment from the cardinal. / Die beiden Tempelritter Behmen von Bleibruck und Felson desertieren und kehren nach Europa zuruck. Dort werden sie erkannt und festgenommen. Um ihrer Bestrafung zu entgehen, nehmen sie einen heiklen Auftrag des Kardinals an.

programme.title: Red Heat / Red Heat
programme.desc: The loyal Russian police officer Ivan Danko travels to Chicago to transfer the Georgian drug dealer Rosta, who shot his partner, to Russia. But the handover in the USA ends in a shootout and so suddenly the correct Russian and the not always completely legal American police officer Ridzik have to work together to find Rosta again. / Der linientreue russische Polizist Ivan Danko reist nach Chicago, um von dort den georgischen Drogendealer Rosta nach Russland zu uberfuhren, der seinen Partner erschossen hat. Doch die Übergabe in den USA endet in einer SchieSSerei und so mussen plotzlich der korrekte Russe und der nicht immer ganz legal operierende amerikanische Polizist Ridzik zusammenarbeiten, um Rosta wiederzufinden.

programme.title: Pure Switzerland / Schweiz pur
programme.desc: We explore Switzerland from above. programme.title: The aquarium professionals / Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: In this episode, the “Aquarium Professionals” stage a volcanic eruption. Your client, a restaurant owner from Las Vegas, wants a Hawaiian pool. Brett and Wayde construct a breathtaking South Sea landscape for their customer with 400 LEDs and colorful surgeonfish. And then the construction geniuses outdo themselves: their drum cymbal is absolutely awesome. Cardinalfish swim in the bass drum and goldfish cavort in the tom-toms. / Die „Aquarium-Profis“ inszenieren in dieser Episode einen Vulkanausbruch. Ihr Auftraggeber, ein Restaurantbesitzer aus Las Vegas, wunscht sich ein Hawaii-Becken. Brett und Wayde konstruieren ihrem Kunden eine atemberaubende Sudseelandschaft mit 400 LEDs und farbenprachtigen Doktorfischen auf den Leib. Und anschlieSSend ubertreffen sich die Konstruktionsgenies selbst: Ihr Schlagzeug-Becken ist der absolute Oberhammer. In der Bassdrum schwimmen Kardinalbarsche, und in den Tomtoms tummeln sich Goldfische.

programme.title: The aquarium professionals / Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: Anthias, pallet surgeonfish and shrimp: In this episode, the “aquarium professionals” construct a spectacular reef landscape with colorful ornamental fish and real corals. The cnidarians are very sensitive, so the salinity, temperature and pH value of the artificial ecosystem are regularly monitored by technical devices. Turbo snails and a goby goby also act as cleaning crews in the tank. These sea creatures feed on algae and clean the sand. / Fahnenbarsche, Paletten-Doktorfische und Garnelen: Die „Aquarium-Profis“ konstruieren in dieser Episode eine spektakulare Rifflandschaft mit farbenprachtigen Zierfischen und echten Korallen. Die Nesseltiere sind sehr empfindlich, daher werden Salzgehalt, Temperatur und pH-Wert des kunstlichen Ökosystems regelmaSSig von technischen Geraten kontrolliert. Turboschnecken und eine Schlafergrundel fungieren im Becken obendrein als Putzkolonne. Diese Meeresbewohner ernahren sich von Algen und reinigen den Sand.

programme.title: 1 against 100 / 1 gegen 100
programme.desc: 1 candidate, 100 opponents and tricky questions. Tactics, strong nerves and a great deal of general knowledge are important - because 100 opponents are just waiting to get into the ring! Only those who are clever and willing to take risks manage to leave the quiz island as a big winner. / 1 KandidatIn, 100 GegnerInnen und knifflige Fragen. Nur wer clever und risikofreudig ist, schafft es, die Quiz-Insel als grosser Sieger zu verlassen.

programme.title: Puls / Puls

programme.title: Eco Talk / Eco Talk
programme.desc: Billions of dollars in assets are inherited in Switzerland every year. Most people inherit a lot, late and often it involves real estate. But heirs are not just luck - socially, the last will also brings conflicts. How big are the differences in heirs? What do testators have to consider in the will? What role do inheritances play in the economy? What questions arise with regard to justice? And do inheritance taxes make economic sense? Andi Luscher discusses these questions in “Eco Talk” with ETH economist Isabel Martínez and HSG economist Reto Follmi. / Jedes Jahr wird in der Schweiz Vermogen in Milliardenhohe vererbt. Die meisten Menschen erben viel, spat und oftmals geht es um Immobilien. Doch Erben ist nicht Gluck allein – gesellschaftlich bringt der letzte Wille auch Konflikte. Wie gross sind die Unterschiede beim Erben? Was mussen Erblasser im Testament beachten? Welche Rolle spielen Erbschaften volkswirtschaftlich? Welche Fragen stellen sich mit Blick auf die Gerechtigkeit? Und sind Erbschaftssteuern okonomisch sinnvoll?Über diese Fragen diskutiert Andi Luscher im «Eco Talk» mit ETH-Ökonomin Isabel Martínez und HSG-Ökonom Reto Follmi.

programme.title: The Bay of Lubeck / Die Lubecker Bucht
programme.desc: Sun, romantic holiday beaches and a fresh breeze - that's how many people know the Bay of Lubeck. Germany's third largest Baltic Sea bay offers unique dune landscapes and rugged cliffs. Some unusual animals also live here, such as the otter and the wartbiter. / Sonne, romantische Urlaubsstrande und eine frische Brise – so kennen viele Menschen die Lubecker Bucht. Deutschlands drittgrosste Ostseebucht bietet einzigartige Dunenlandschaften und schroffe Steilkusten. Zudem leben hier einige aussergewohnliche Tiere wie der Fischotter oder der Warzenbeisser.

programme.title: Newsflash SRF 1 / Newsflash SRF 1
programme.desc: Up-to-date information in just a few minutes. The SRF Newsflash concisely summarizes the most important events of the day from Monday to Friday. / In wenigen Minuten aktuell informiert. Der SRF Newsflash fasst von Montag bis Freitag die wichtigsten Ereignisse des Tages pragnant zusammen.

programme.title: Oberstadtgass / Oberstadtgass
programme.desc: Postman Jucker (Schaggi Streuli) is the good soul in the neighborhood. He knows the concerns and needs of his neighbors and often brings good advice and a kind word in the mail. But at home the blessing goes wrong. Jucker's son Albertli died five years earlier. His wife Frieda (Margrit Rainer) can't get over it. She has become quarrelsome, bitter and addicted to cleaning and is making life difficult for Jucker. He sometimes looks after the neglected, fatherless Mani (Jurg Grau), who is constantly in trouble. And after a car accident, Jucker and Mani lie in the same hospital room and become friends. / Brieftrager Jucker (Schaggi Streuli) ist die gute Seele im Quartier. Er kennt die Sorgen und Note seiner Nachbarn und bringt mit der Post oft auch einen guten Rat und ein freundliches Wort. Doch zu Hause hangt der Haussegen schief. Funf Jahre zuvor ist Juckers Sohn Albertli gestorben. Seine Frau Frieda (Margrit Rainer) kommt nicht daruber hinweg. Sie ist zankisch, verbittert und putzsuchtig geworden und macht Jucker das Leben schwer. Er kummert sich manchmal um den verwahrlosten, vaterlosen Mani (Jurg Grau), der standig in Schwierigkeiten steckt. Und nach einem Autounfall liegen Jucker und Mani im selben Spitalzimmer und werden Freunde.

programme.title: To the table / Zu Tisch
programme.desc: In the Oldenburger Land, kale is the traditional winter vegetable. In the region in northwest Germany, cabbage copes well with the humid maritime climate. Kale used to be found in almost every garden in the area because it provided basic supplies during the cold season. The organic farmer Peter Kluin maintains this culinary heritage by growing rare varieties of kale and selling them at the weekly market. / Im Oldenburger Land ist Grunkohl das traditionelle Wintergemuse. In der Region im Nordwesten Deutschlands kommt der Kohl mit dem feuchten Meeresklima gut zurecht. Fruher stand Grunkohl in fast jedem Garten in der Umgebung, denn er sicherte die Grundversorgung in der kalten Jahreszeit. Dieses kulinarische Erbe pflegt der Biobauer Peter Kluin, indem er seltene Grunkohlsorten anbaut und auf dem Wochenmarkt verkauft.

programme.title: SFULD / SRF DOK
programme.desc: How does mountain weather affect life? What if the Alps weren't there? SRF meteorologist Thomas Bucheli and his counterpart from Servus TV, Sebastian Weber, set off on an adventurous journey across the Alpine arc and research weather phenomena. / Wie beeinflusst das Bergwetter das Leben? Was ware, wenn die Alpen nicht da waren? SRF-Meteorologe Thomas Bucheli und sein Pendant von Servus TV, Sebastian Weber, machen sich auf eine abenteuerliche Reise quer durch den Alpenbogen und erforschen Wetterphanomene.

programme.sub-title: mit der neuen Violinschlussel-Tragerin Nadja Rass

programme.title: Spring – a look into tomorrow / Fruhling – Blick ins Morgen
programme.desc: Christian Frankenthal (Andreas Thiele) is convinced that his father fell for a marriage scammer. Since father Alois (Hans Stadlbauer) is completely unreasonable and not even willing to talk, Christian turns to Katja (Simone Thomalla) - in the hope that she can bring the old man to some sense. But even despite the support of Pastor Sonnleitner, Alois doesn't let himself be deterred. Heidrun Niedermayer (Catalina Navarro Kirner) is also still in a love frenzy: her wedding to Leopold is imminent and it seems to be a real stroke of luck. It's completely different in Katja's private life: an argument between her and Tom (Jan Sosniok) escalates so much that Katja drives home in the middle of the night to sleep there. / Christian Frankenthal (Andreas Thiele) ist uberzeugt davon, dass sein Vater auf eine Heiratsschwindlerin hereingefallen ist. Da Vater Alois (Hans Stadlbauer) vollig uneinsichtig und nicht einmal gesprachsbereit ist, wendet Christian sich an Katja (Simone Thomalla) – in der Hoffnung, sie konne den alten Herrn ein wenig zur Vernunft bringen. Doch auch trotz Unterstutzung von Pfarrer Sonnleitner lasst sich Alois nicht beirren.Auch Heidrun Niedermayer (Catalina Navarro Kirner) ist immer noch im Liebesrausch: Ihre Hochzeit mit Leopold steht kurz bevor und der scheint ein wahrer Glucksgriff zu sein. Ganz anders bei Katja privat: Ein Streit zwischen ihr und Tom (Jan Sosniok) eskaliert so sehr, dass Katja mitten in der Nacht nach Hause fahrt, um dort zu schlafen.

programme.title: In all friendship / In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Heat wave in Leipzig. There is a huge rush in the emergency room. Vera Bader is admitted dehydrated and confused and hospitalized. Her dementia is now well advanced. In addition, the case of twelve-year-old Luis, who urgently needs a liver transplant, is keeping the team at the Sachsenklinik on their toes. / Hitzewelle in Leipzig. In der Notaufnahme herrscht riesiger Andrang. Vera Bader wird dehydriert und verwirrt eingeliefert und stationar aufgenommen. Ihre Demenzerkrankung ist inzwischen weit fortgeschritten. Daneben halt der Fall des zwolfjahrigen Luis, der dringend eine Lebertransplantation benotigt, das Team der Sachsenklinik auf Trab.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut – Hotel zum Gluck / SRF bi de Lut – Hotel zum Gluck
programme.desc: The festive season is one of the most beautiful but also the most stressful days in the hotel industry. Fortunately, the new hosts in the hotel also feel this. At Christmas the house blessing goes wrong. And on public holidays the hotel is full except for the last room. / Die Festtage gehoren zu den schonsten, aber auch anstrengendsten Tagen in der Hotellerie. Das spuren auch die neuen Gastgeberinnen und Gastgeber im Hotel zum Gluck. Zu Weihnachten hangt der Haussegen schief. Und an den Feiertagen ist das Hotel ist bis auf das letzte Zimmer besetzt.

programme.title: GESUNDHEITHEUTE – The health program with Dr. Jeanne Furst / GESUNDHEITHEUTE – Die Gesundheitssendung mit Dr. Jeanne Furst
programme.desc: The idea of ​​entering a psychiatric hospital causes fear in many people. A person affected provides information about the difficulties and advantages they experienced during their stay. The program also provides information about an inherited heart muscle disease. / Die Vorstellung, in eine psychiatrische Klinik einzutreten, lost bei vielen Ängste aus. Ein Betroffener gibt Auskunft uber die Schwierigkeiten und Vorteile, die er wahrend seines Aufenthalts erfahren hat. Die Sendung informiert auch uber eine vererbte Herzmuskelerkrankung.

programme.title: Rosamunde Pilcher / Rosamunde Pilcher
programme.desc: While riding together on the beach at Endellion Bay, Tom surprises Abby with a marriage proposal. Her great-grandfather, Viscount Alexander Combe, is very fond of the idea of ​​having a big celebration: there hasn't been a wedding on Endellion for over thirty years. However, the general joy is marred by the ongoing dispute between Alexander's sons Charles and Stephen. However, the Combe family is in for another surprise: Julia hears an interview with the pianist Lara Jones on the car radio and thinks she recognizes her supposedly dead daughter Charlotte. / Bei einem gemeinsamen Ausritt am Strand der Endellion Bucht uberrascht Tom Abby mit einem Heiratsantrag. Ihr UrgroSSvater, der Viscount Alexander Combe, ist sehr angetan von der Idee, ein groSSes Fest zu feiern: Auf Endellion gab es schon seit uber dreiSSig Jahren keine Hochzeit mehr. Getrubt wird die allgemeine Freude jedoch durch den andauernden Zwist zwischen Alexanders Sohnen Charles und Stephen. Allerdings steht der Familie Combe noch eine weitere Überraschung bevor: Julia hort im Autoradio ein Interview mit der Pianistin Lara Jones und glaubt in ihr ihre vermeintlich tote Tochter Charlotte zu erkennen.

programme.title: Bedtime story / Guetnachtgschichtli
programme.desc: The squirrel is happy. It has lined its tree hollow with all sorts of found objects and made it winter-proof. His nest is now comfortably warm. But then a flood breaks out. Forest animals flee Lena's farm and are cold. / Das Eichhornchen ist glucklich. Es hat seine Baumhohle mit allerlei Fundsachen ausgekleidet und winterfest gemacht. Sein Nest ist nun wohlig warm. Doch dann bricht eine Flut aus. Waldtiere fluchten auf Lenas Hof und haben kalt.

programme.title: Beyond the Spree / Jenseits der Spree
programme.desc: 21-year-old Asadh is found dead in a parking lot. He was killed with a knife stab in the heart. programme.title: Cash collapse / Kassensturz
programme.sub-title: Die Sendung uber Konsum, Geld und Arbeit
programme.desc: Swiss dating platforms – millions with lonelinessFunf dating platforms promise love and eroticism to lonely hearts all over Europe. SRF Investigative reveals that the opaque companies are based in the canton of Zug and turn over millions. A self-experiment shows that instead of real contacts and sensual dates, the reporters find fake profiles and sex workers. If you really long for a new relationship, look into the pipes. The State Secretariat for Economic Affairs SECO is of the opinion that what the dating companies do is forbidden. “Dry Bags” test – the laundry usually stays dry. Swiss rivers are so clean that you can confidently jump into the cooling waters. But where should you take your clothes, wallet or beach towel while swimming in the river or on a boat tour? Dry bags are the robust companions for this: they keep all utensils dry, even when swimmers use them as a swimming bag. At least that's what the promises say. “Kassenrutsch” tested nine dry bags both in practice and in the laboratory. Not all products were completely convincing. New broadcast concept from August On June 24, 2025, “Kassenrutsch” will be broadcast live from Studio 8 for the last time. From August 19, 2025, the show will no longer be recorded in the studio, but on site. In the future, the “cash collapse” will be even closer to consumers and strengthen the digital offering. In the last broadcast before the summer break, “Kassenrutsch” looks back on highlights of the studio’s 50-year history. / Schweizer Dating-Plattformen – Millionen mit der EinsamkeitFunf Dating-Plattformen versprechen einsamen Herzen in ganz Europa Liebe und Erotik. SRF Investigativ deckt auf, dass die undurchsichtigen Firmen im Kanton Zug sitzen und Millionen umsetzen. Ein Selbstversuch zeigt: Statt echte Kontakte und sinnliche Dates finden die Reporter Fake-Profile und Sexarbeiterinnen. Wer sich wirklich nach einer neuen Beziehung sehnt, guckt in die Rohre. Das Staatssekretariat fur Wirtschaft SECO ist der Meinung, dass es verboten sei, was die Dating-Firmen machen.Test «Dry Bags» – Die Wasche bleibt meist trockenSchweizer Flusse sind so sauber, dass man getrost den Sprung in die kuhlenden Fluten wagen kann. Doch wohin wahrend dem Fluss-Schwumm oder einer Bootli-Tour mit Kleidern, Portemonnaie oder Badetuch? Dry Bags sind dafur die robusten Begleiter: Sie halten alle Utensilien trocken, sogar wenn Schwimmerinnen und Schwimmer sie als Schwimmsack benutzen. So zumindest die Versprechen. «Kassensturz» hat neun Dry Bags sowohl in der Praxis wie auch im Labor getestet. Nicht alle Produkte konnten vollumfanglich uberzeugen.Neues Sendekonzept ab AugustAm 24. Juni 2025 wird der «Kassensturz» zum letzten Mal live aus dem Studio 8 gesendet. Ab dem 19. August 2025 wird die Sendung nicht mehr im Studio, sondern vor Ort aufgezeichnet. So ist der «Kassensturz» kunftig noch naher bei den Konsumentinnen und Konsumenten und starkt das digitale Angebot. In der letzten Sendung vor der Sommerpause blickt «Kassensturz» zuruck auf Highlights der 50-jahrigen Studio-Geschichte.

programme.desc: Falling asleep gently at the end is what everyone wants. But very few people die like that. programme.title: Rosamunde Pilcher / Rosamunde Pilcher
programme.desc: While riding together on the beach at Endellion Bay, Tom surprises Abby with a marriage proposal. Her great-grandfather, Viscount Alexander Combe, is very fond of the idea of ​​having a big celebration: there hasn't been a wedding on Endellion for over thirty years. However, the general joy is marred by the ongoing dispute between Alexander's sons Charles and Stephen. However, the Combe family is in for another surprise: Julia hears an interview with the pianist Lara Jones on the car radio and thinks she recognizes her supposedly dead daughter Charlotte. / Bei einem gemeinsamen Ausritt am Strand der Endellion Bucht uberrascht Tom Abby mit einem Heiratsantrag. Ihr UrgroSSvater, der Viscount Alexander Combe, ist sehr angetan von der Idee, ein groSSes Fest zu feiern: Auf Endellion gab es schon seit uber dreiSSig Jahren keine Hochzeit mehr. Getrubt wird die allgemeine Freude jedoch durch den andauernden Zwist zwischen Alexanders Sohnen Charles und Stephen. Allerdings steht der Familie Combe noch eine weitere Überraschung bevor: Julia hort im Autoradio ein Interview mit der Pianistin Lara Jones und glaubt in ihr ihre vermeintlich tote Tochter Charlotte zu erkennen.

programme.title: In all friendship / In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: There is still no solution for twelve-year-old Luis. Luis' mentally ill mother is not an option as a liver donor. The father Daniel, on the other hand, is excluded from being an organ donor under German law due to his HIV infection. The opinion of the medical profession is divided. / Fur den zwolfjahrigen Luis gibt es nach wie vor keine Losung. Die psychisch erkrankte Mutter von Luis kommt als Leber-Spenderin nicht in Frage. programme.title: SRF bi de Lut – Hotel zum Gluck / SRF bi de Lut – Hotel zum Gluck
programme.desc: The strict holidays are still deeply in the bones of hoteliers. Coach Aschi surprises her with an excursion. In addition, the hoteliers face the end of the adventure and the final decision as to who can stay in the hotel until the end of the season. / Den Hoteliers stecken die strengen Feiertage nach wie vor tief in den Knochen.
